title: Partnerships Manager
description:
Who we are:

Sardine is the leading agentic risk platform for fighting financial crime. Our integrated solution unifies data across risk teams to help organizations stop fraud in real time, prevent AI-driven attacks, and automate fraud and AML operations. Sardine’s platform is strengthened by one of the fastest-growing fraud consortiums in the market, spanning more than 6 billion profiled devices, 800 million consumers, and 3 million businesses worldwide. Leading companies including FIS, GoDaddy, Intuit, Edward Jones, ZoomInfo, and Checkout.com rely on Sardine to secure and grow trust in their products.



Our culture:

 - We hire talented, self-motivated individuals with extreme ownership and high growth orientation. 

 - We value performance and not hours worked. We believe you shouldn't have to miss your family dinner, your kid's school play, friends get-together, or doctor's appointments for the sake of adhering to an arbitrary work schedule.

 - We're a remote-first team spread across time zones, so no office to report to - work from wherever helps you do your best work. Just a couple of things to keep in mind: pay is based on where you're located, and you'll need to keep a home base in the country you're hired in. So while we love the "coffee shop today, mountains tomorrow" life, this isn't a passport-optional, work-from-anywhere-on-Earth kind of remote - think flexible within your country, not borderless.



Location:

 - Remote - London, UK

 - We are a remote-first company with a globally distributed team. You can find your productive zone and work from there.



About the Role:
As the Partnerships Manager at Sardine, you’ll report directly to our Head of Partnerships. This is a quota-carrying role that combines growing and activating our signed partners with bringing new partners into the ecosystem.  You will own a portfolio of strategic partners and drive revenue through them. Additionally, you will help lead partner recruitment efforts from inception.

You’ll work closely with Sardine and partner-side sales teams to drive revenue, and collaborate with our Product, Sales Engineering, and Marketing teams to make sure partners are equipped to succeed. You’ll also help shape our channel strategy and position Sardine as the premier fraud and compliance platform within our partners’ customer bases.

This is a high-impact role that will drive meaningful revenue over time and help make partnerships one of the largest channels for Sardine. You’ll work directly with the Head of Partnerships, Sales leadership, and other members of the leadership team, and play a key role in taking Sardine to the next level.



What You’ll Be Doing:

 - Drive revenue: Own a partner portfolio and carry a quota across straight reseller, co-sell, and referral relationships, working with partner and Sardine sales teams to close deals

 - Grow across three motions: Partner with Platforms including Payments, Networks, Processors, Banking, AI Ecosystem and other players that embed Sardine, SIs and consultancies that resell, and advisory firms, data partners and VCs who refer prospects

 - Enable partners: Enable partner sales and customer support teams to effectively pitch and demo Sardine through training, material creation, and more.

 - Generate demand: Collaborate with partners to build and execute joint marketing and BDR campaigns directed at their prospects and clients.

 - Recruit and expand: Recruit, onboard, and launch new partners from outreach through first deal, and broaden the scope of signed partners over time

 - Plan and optimize: Set targets, build channel strategies, and report on performance, including product gaps and pricing considerations to optimize distribution

 - Collaborate cross-functionally: Work with Product, Sales Engineering, Marketing, and Sales to ensure Sardine is ready on partner platforms, including embedded deployments



What You’ll Need:

 - 6+ years of partnership management or years of related experience in B2B software/SaaS, with a record of consistently exceeding quota

 - Experience managing a mix of partner types such as resellers, SIs, platform partners, and referral partners

 - Executive presence and the ability to build long-term partner relationships

 - Hands-on experience with CRM/Salesforce, reporting, and analytics

 - Strong project management, communication, and strategic thinking, with the ability to collaborate in virtual, matrixed teams

 - Avid user of Agentic AI tools to optimize performance with a lifetime learning mindset

 - Highly preferred: Background in financial services, fintech, AI or fraud and compliance software

 - Highly preferred: Existing network within the financial services or partner ecosystem





Benefits we offer:

 - Generous compensation in cash and equity

 - Early exercise for all options, including pre-vested

 - Work from anywhere: Remote-first Culture

 - Flexible paid time off and Year-end break

 - Health insurance, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents - US and Canada specific

 - 4% matching in 401k / RRSP - US and Canada specific

 - MacBook Pro delivered to your door

 - One-time stipend to set up a home office — desk, chair, screen, etc.

 - Monthly meal stipend

 - Monthly social meet-up stipend

 - Annual health and wellness stipend

 - Annual Learning stipend



Join a fast-growing company with world-class professionals from around the world. If you are seeking a meaningful career, you found the right place, and we would love to hear from you.



To learn more about how we process your personal information and your rights in regards to your personal information as an applicant and Sardine employee, please visit our Applicant and Worker Privacy Notice https://www.sardine.ai/applicant-and-worker-privacy-notice.

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Sierra was co-founded by Bret Taylor https://www.linkedin.com/in/brettaylor/ and Clay Bavor https://www.linkedin.com/in/claybavor/ who first met while working together at Google over 20 years ago. • 3+ years of B2B account management experience, with a demonstrated track record of growing a portfolio through a consultative and data-driven approach

 Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. 
 Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. 
 About the role:

title: Account Director - TX
description:
UNLEASH AI INNOVATORS, SECURELY

Software is being rewritten in real time. AI agents are starting to write more code than humans do, at a speed no security team has ever had to match, and that single shift is opening up the biggest opportunity our industry has seen in a decade. We're not bracing for it, we're building the company that owns it.

Snyk is building the next generation security platform where security isn't a set of tools people operate.  It's a team of security agents working alongside your engineers, finding, fixing, and governing risk at the speed software is now built. These agents work alongside both the company build and the agents they adopt. Security stops being a queue of work waiting for people, and becomes a coordinated workforce companies direct and trust.


WHY THIS ROLE?

As an Account Director at Snyk, you’ll be responsible for the end-to-end sales and success cycle for prospective and existing Enterprise customers who are focused on Digital Transformation. You will have the privilege of interacting with customers at the most senior level of the Security and Engineering organizations.

You’ll join a team that is resilient, business savvy, and curious, where we see the value our product offers and want it to be part of every software development process. Capitalizing on your territory knowledge, you will utilize connections in the market to grow your account base and help drive our mission to embed security into every part of the AI-native development lifecycle.




WHAT YOU’LL DO:

 - Own the end-to-end sales cycle for large Enterprise customers, responsible for prospecting, selling, and retaining customers.

 - Build and nurture strong relationships with key stakeholders and C-Level Executives within Security and Engineering organizations.

 - Collaborate cross-functionally with leadership, customer success, channel partners, marketing, product, and finance to drive deals and ensure customer success.

 - Develop complex account plans that incorporate multiple lines of business, channel ecosystems, and executive coverage models to build a dual-speed business of smaller/faster-moving accounts and larger/complex accounts.

 - Manage renewal and expansion for your customer base, ensuring long-term outcomes and partnership growth.

 - Forecast with accuracy and detail for both short and long-term opportunities while proactively mitigating close-lost rates.




WHAT YOU BRING:

 - Significant Enterprise Sales Experience: You have a minimum of 5 years experience owning the entire sales cycle for a technical product on Enterprise level accounts (Fortune 1000).

 - Proven Track Record: You are self-motivated and hard-working with a history of exceeding your quota and closing million-dollar+ ARR transactions.

 - Domain Expertise: You’ve excelled at selling into Cybersecurity, DevOps, or DevSecOps groups, or have significant enterprise software sales experience generating and closing large & complex transactions.

 - Strategic Collaboration: You leverage your ecosystem internally and externally, understanding that selling is a team sport at Snyk where managing virtual resources is a must-have skill.

 - Executive Presence: You practice extreme ownership, are skilled in navigating complex organizations, and possess the ability to engage confidently with C-Level Executives.

 - Consultative Approach: You possess strong consultation skills to work with multiple levels within a customer organization to address business challenges.


ABOUT SNYK

Snyk is committed to creating an inclusive and engaging environment where our employees can thrive as we rally behind our common mission to make the digital world a safer place. From Snyk employee resource groups, to global benefits that help our employees prioritize their health, wellness, financial security, and a work/life blend, we aim to support our employees along their entire journeys here at Snyk.




EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

Snyk is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

title: Company Operations Lead
location: London, United States, New York, United Kingdom
description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE

ElevenLabs moves fast - by design. We run lean, we bias toward action, and we trust our people to figure things out. That's how we've built world-leading AI products in three years with a fraction of the headcount of our peers. But speed at 200 people and speed at 1,000+ people are different challenges, and the systems, habits, and connective tissue that let a company move fast without breaking things don't build themselves.

As our Company Operations Lead, you'll own the infrastructure that lets ElevenLabs keep its velocity as it scales. Not by adding process for process's sake - but by building the right systems, in the right places, at the right time, so that the rest of the company can focus on what they do best. You'll establish the operating layer that keeps a 50-country, hybrid organization coherent; drive the strategic planning cadence that keeps leadership aligned; and deploy a lean team of strategic generalists against the company's most urgent cross-functional challenges.

You’ll be responsible for:

 - Operating Cadence: Running the planning and alignment cycles that keep the company pointed in the right direction. This includes OKR planning, workforce, and headcount planning.

 - Operating System: Building and maintaining the infrastructure layer that lets the company move faster. Systems of record, org taxonomy and governance, and the knowledge management systems that ensure information flow effectively across our remote-first team.

 - AI Enablement & Agentification: Ensuring every team at ElevenLabs has the tools, access, and knowledge to work effectively with AI. You'll own the internal AI enablement framework - managing tool access and rollout, identifying where agents and automation can accelerate how functions operate, and building the learning opportunities and champions programmes that drive deep adoption. You'll work closely with Security, IT, and the Automations team to ensure what gets built is built right.

 - Operations Centre of Excellence: Defining what great operations looks like at ElevenLabs and embedding it across the company. You'll set the blueprint that makes operational excellence repeatable and deploy the team as embedded operators inside other functions, standing up best practices, up-skilling teams, and handing off cleanly once the work is done.


REQUIREMENTS

We do not require formal experience, certifications, or degrees. We do require:

 - Proven experience building and leading a Strategy & Operations or BizOps function at a high-growth technology company - ideally through a meaningful scaling inflection (Series B–D trajectory or equivalent).

 - Track record of standing up functions and systems from scratch and handing them off, rather than owning a permanent queue.

 - Structured problem-solving background - strategy consulting, a BizOps or Chief of Staff seat with genuine strategic scope, or an operator role that required both systems-building and executive influence.

 - Strong AI and tooling fluency - you should be pushing the organisation on what's possible with AI enablement, not chasing it.

 - Exceptional stakeholder management: you can partner with founders and Leads and earn trust quickly in a flat, high-velocity environment.

Bonus:

 - Experience inside a company that scaled through a 200 → 2,000+ person

Here, you’ll have the chance to shape the kind of experiences people never forget – and help us build connections that truly matter.
 


Gift Cards Partnerships Manager |📍London – Hybrid ( 2 days in office) | 💰Competitive Salary + Benefits

 AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. title: Analyst, Banking Operations (Domestic)
location: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States
description:
Why join us 
 Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.
 Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.
 Operations at Brex 
 Operations is the backbone of Brex’s mission to power businesses through our Intelligent Finance Platform. We own credit, fraud, money movement, and payments, protecting our customers and our company. From product operations that ensure flawless launches to scalable systems that drive innovation and precision, we operate at the intersection of product, design, engineering, and customer success. If you want to work at the heart of the business, Operations is where you belong.
 What you’ll do 
 Brex is building the operating system for growing companies, and reliable funds movement is at the core. As a Banking Operations Analyst on our Domestic Payments team, you will work the US payment rails (ACH,checks, domestic wires, stablecoin) and investigate returns and exceptions, and keep our customers’ money moving accurately and on time. You’ll combine precision and rigor in controls with cross-functional collaboration to keep customers’ funds safe, timely, and accounted for. If you meet most, but not all, of the qualifications, we encourage you to apply.
 Where you’ll work 
 This role will be based in our Salt Lake City office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!
 Responsibilities 
• Work the domestic payments queue across ACH, checks, domestic wires and stablecoin, resolving cases in Salesforce with clear, customer-safe explanations.
• Monitor ACH and wire returns, interpreting return codes and running the right procedure for each.
• Watch for trends before they become incidents and escalate with clear context and urgency.
• Work exceptions with external banking partners, bringing the right identifiers and evidence to speed resolution.
• Keep the queue healthy by maintaining Salesforce routing and hygiene, balancing case quality and attention to detail.
• Write and maintain documentation (SOPs, training materials) and help onboard and cross-train new analysts.
• Leverage data and AI (Hex, SQL/Snowflake, Retool, LLMs) to investigate cases faster, build monitoring and dashboards, and automate repeat work.
• Identify process gaps, determine whether each is a manual error, data break, or process gap, and bring clear requirements to Engineering and Product.
• Collaborate cross-functionally with CX, CSMs, AEs, Accounting, Compliance, Engineering, Product, Design, and external banking partners to resolve exceptions and prepare for new flows.
• Participate in the coverage rotation on some holidays for urgent cases.
 Requirements 
• 1+ year of experience in banking, fintech, payments, or operations (CX/Support, Operations, or Treasury) at a fintech, broker-dealer, or bank. Relevant internships count.
• Exposure to payments, returns, reconciliations, or settlements.
• Strong control discipline: follows SOPs, maintains audit-ready documentation, and escalates anomalies with clear context.
• Clear communicator and high-velocity collaborator under time pressure: responsive, decisive, and highly effective at partnering cross-functionally with CX, Engineering, Accounting, Compliance, and banking partners to drive swift resolutions.
• Proactive self-starter with strong communication skills and a commitment to continuous feedback and improvement.
• AI-native operator mindset, using LLMs/copilots to draft SOPs, triage exceptions, and generate first-pass analyses with strong output validation.
 Bonus points 
• 2+ years of experience in banking, fintech, payments, or operations (CX/Support, Operations, or Treasury) at a fintech, broker-dealer, or bank. Relevant internships count.
• Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Economics or Information Systems. 
• Working knowledge of ACH and NACHA rules, return codes, and the lifecycle of wires and checks (including Reg CC and UCC 4A basics).
• Data fluency: intermediate Excel/Google Sheets (lookups, pivots) and comfort analyzing operational dashboards (e.g., Hex) to monitor volumes, returns, and exceptions.
• Comfort with SQL/Python for operational analytics, building checks and alerts, or automating workflows (e.g., Retool, Zapier).
• Experience with Salesforce case management and queue routing.
• Exposure to audits or control testing
• Experience with fraud, OFAC, or compliance-adjacent investigations.
 Compensation 
 The expected salary range for this role is $58,700 - $73,375. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.
 Brex LLC is a wholly owned subsidiary of Capital One, N.A.

title: Revenue Operations Manager
description:
About the role 
 Databricks bills customers on usage. Every month, millions of usage records turn into commit drawdowns, invoices and revenue. The Revenue Operations team within Order to Cash organization makes sure that happens accurately and on time.
 We’re hiring a Revenue Operations Manager to oversee usage operations and improve how contracts move from booking to invoicing. A key focus is Universal Commitment, our cloud-agnostic commit model. Reporting to the Senior Manager of Revenue Operations, you’ll lead key month-end close activities for our billing and rating platform, oversee a team based in India, and drive process and automation improvements across Revenue Operations. 
 You'll work closely with the Order to Revenue Process Compliance team. That team sets usage policy, leads root-cause analysis and owns governance. Your team carries out the work: applying adjustments, keeping usage and billing in balance, and making sure each correction is documented, reviewed and fully reflected in our systems.
 What you'll do 
 Revenue operations and contract setup 
• Own the booking review process. Validate orders in the booking queue and serve as the escalation point for upstream teams on complex contract structures.
• Make sure contract and usage settings are correct across our billing and rating platform, ERP and CPQ, so that Universal Commitment and other contract type invoice as intended.
• Advise Deal Desk and Revenue Assurance on whether non-standard terms can be billed (e.g., GPU reservations, per-hour pricing, custom SKUs) before deals close. Provide guidance on new product offerings and ensure operational feasibility prior to finance sign off.
• Define and report Revenue Operations KPIs, such as adjustment volume, close timeliness, and billing accuracy.
 Usage operations and adjustments 
• Oversee and approve usage adjustments, billing corrections and customer credits in DBAR and the ERP. This covers billing errors, SLA credits and customer satisfaction (CSAT) credits, in line with Usage Compliance policies and approval levels.
• Serve as the escalation point for manual usage processing, including manual usage uploads, reservation and non-standard billing, ledger entries, and retract-and-restate corrections, with a full audit trail.
• Make sure usage-to-contract mapping, including customer workspace moves, PAYG-to-commit conversions and mid-term contract changes, with the correct effective dates.
• Act as the Revenue Operations owner of the refund and credit process, from intake, and validation through execution.

title: Senior Risk Investigator - Fraud Incident Management & Partner Response
location: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within United States
description:
About the Team 
 Mercury* is building a complete financial stack for startups, and Risk is how we protect our customers, Mercury, and the broader financial ecosystem. You'll join Fraud Operations, part of the Fraud & Disputes organization. The team investigates and prevents fraud across every Mercury product, and works hand in hand with Risk Strategy, Product, Engineering, Compliance, and our bank partners. Our investigators, Fraud Enablement team, and BPO partners handle the volume. This role makes sure that when something goes wrong, or when a regulator or bank partner asks hard questions, we respond quickly, consistently, and with evidence.
 *Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC. 
 Role Summary 
 This is a senior individual contributor role for an investigator who thrives in the hardest, least defined problems in fraud. You will own fraud incident response from detection to postmortem across first-party and third-party fraud, write the memos and responses that our partners and auditors rely on, and be the operational voice of Fraud Operations in partner-bank conversations. You will lead Fraud Operations' response to audit and regulatory observations, and you will help Mercury get ready to operate as a bank, translating what examiners and partner banks expect into the processes, evidence, and documentation our teams need every day.
 You don't need to be the deepest domain expert in every fraud typology. You need to be able to hold your own in an incident, ask the right questions, bring the right people in, and turn a messy channel full of data into a clear, defensible, and actionable narrative. You'll work closely with Fraud Investigations and Enablement, Risk Strategy, Compliance, Legal, Partnerships, Product, and Engineering.
 What You'll Do 
 Lead fraud incident management 
• Act as incident lead or operational DRI for fraud incidents across all Mercury products, including account takeover, card testing and BIN attacks, mule and ring activity, spikes in fraud behavior, and first-party fraud trends.
• Mobilize incident response, size impact, pull the right people from Fraud Investigations, Enablement, Strategy, Product, and Engineering, and keep everyone aligned on what we know, what we don't, and who owns what.
• Make or tee up decisions with a recommendation attached: containment, customer communication, reimbursement and credit decisions, account actions, and when to escalate.
• Run postmortems and retros for first-party and third-party fraud incidents: root cause, control gaps, remediation owners and dates, and track statuses of each.
• Spot patterns across incidents and turn them into durable fixes in alerts, rules, SOPs, product or tooling change requests, and training instead of one-off responses.
 Write the memos and responses partners and auditors rely on 
• Draft incident and retro memos for bank partners and internal risk governance: what happened, impact, root cause, controls in place, remediation plan, and timelines.
• Use AI tools to get from raw incident data to a strong first draft quickly, then verify every number and claim against source data before it leaves the team.
• Prepare accurate, concise responses to partner-bank questions, suspicious activity and investigation inquiries, and requests for information.
 Coordinate with bank partners 
• Be a day-to-day operational point of contact for partner-bank risk, AML, and investigations teams, working alongside Partnerships and Compliance.
• Track open partner requests, commitments, and change-management items, and make sure Fraud Operations responds consistently and on time.
• Bring partner feedback and expectations back to Fraud Operations, Strategy, and Product so controls and processes are built with the partner in mind.
 Support audit and exam response for the Fraud domain 
• Be Fraud Operations support for audit and regulatory observations: validate accuracy, provide program context, push back where ratings or facts are off, and agree action plans with realistic dates and owners.
• Keep evidence, SOPs, and decision records current so that an audit or exam never becomes a scramble.
• Track issues through governance systems in partnership with Enablement until closure, and confirm the fix worked.
 Raise the bar for the team 
• Mentor teammates on how to escalate: bring a recommendation and the facts, not just a question.
• Work with Enablement and QC to feed incident learnings into training, scorecards, and playbooks.
• Partner with Strategy and Engineering on tooling and reporting that make incident response faster.
 What You'll Bring 
• 6+ years of experience in fraud investigations, risk operations, or financial crimes at a bank, fintech, or other regulated financial services company, including hands-on investigation of both first-party and third-party fraud.
• Experience leading or serving as a key operator in fraud incidents or similar high-severity events: sizing impact, driving cross-functional response, making decisions with incomplete information, and running the postmortem.
• Strong writing. A track record of producing incident reports, regulatory or partner-bank memos, or audit responses that were precise, defensible, and read by executives or examiners.
• Working knowledge of how a regulated institution runs, with direct experience working with sponsor or partner banks, regulators, examiners, or auditors.
• Solid understanding of US payment rails and fraud typologies, such as ACH, wires, checks, cards, account takeover, mule accounts, and synthetic or first-party fraud.
• Comfort with data: you can pull and interpret volume, loss, and rate data (SQL or dashboard tools), and explain what the numbers mean and where they could mislead.
• Proven ability to influence people who don't report to you and to drive decisions to closure across Operations, Strategy, Product, Engineering, Compliance, and Legal.

• Software sales or sales enablement experience, preferably with expertise in DevOps and/or Open Source.

title: Global Payments Partner Lead
description:
TL;DR: We’re looking for a Global Payments Partners Lead to co-own Lovable's global payments strategy. You’ll lead payment partnerships and work closely with Engineering, Product, and Finance to make payments seamless, improve conversion, and strengthen our payment economics.




WHY LOVABLE?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - You’ve owned payments at scale across multiple markets, with a track record of improving acceptance, costs, and recurring payment performance.

 - Deep expertise in card payments, acquiring, local payment methods, and subscriptions.

 - An exceptional negotiator with a proven track record of securing better pricing and commercial terms from payment providers.

 - Technical and analytical depth, with the ability to turn payment data into clear priorities and shipped improvements.

 - A senior, hands-on operator who sets direction, aligns teams, and takes responsibility for results.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Set the strategy. Co-own the global payments roadmap and prioritize investments across providers, markets, and payment methods.

 - Own & Improve performance. Increase successful checkouts and renewals, recover failed payments, and reduce processing costs while managing fraud and disputes.

 - Lead payment partnerships. Own provider relationships and performance reviews. Lead negotiations on pricing, contract terms, and service commitments.

 - Ship improvements. Partner with Product and Engineering on payment experiences, integrations, and migrations across subscriptions and credit purchases.

 - Build for scale. Establish reporting, monitoring, and operational processes. Work with Finance, Legal, and Security on reconciliation, compliance, and reliability.




ABOUT YOUR APPLICATION

Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.

Tell us about a payments initiative you’ve led: the problem, your contribution, and the measurable result.

 

We treat all candidates equally. If you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal.

description:
What we're all about.

Do you ever have the urge to do things better than the last time? We do. And it’s this urge that drives us every day. At Quantexa, you’ll experience autonomy and support in equal measures allowing you to form a career that matches your ambitions. 41% of our colleagues come from an ethnic or religious minority background. We’re heading in one direction: the future. We’d love you to join us.

title: Solutions Lead
description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Solutions Lead to help build Ramp’s solutions function for our international business, starting with the UK and Europe. This is a hands-on builder role. You’ll be a trusted technical partner to prospects, customers and channel partners, shaping how we sell, implement and support complex solutions as the business grows.

This is broader than a traditional pre-sales role. Winning complex opportunities is central to the job, but your impact won’t end at signature. You’ll connect technical discovery with implementation readiness, help resolve high-stakes customer challenges, enable partners, and build the demos, playbooks and technical expertise that make the wider team more effective.

You’ll combine technical depth, commercial judgement and a strong understanding of finance workflows to solve the most important problems yourself and build repeatable approaches so the business becomes less dependent on any one person. You don’t need an engineering background; what matters is your ability to understand systems, solve technical problems and communicate clearly.

You’ll also have the opportunity to help customers navigate an evolving platform, including areas such as Accounts Receivable, Stack and our AI-powered products: Router, Glass and Inspect.




WHAT YOU’LL DO:


WIN COMPLEX OPPORTUNITIES AND PREPARE THEM FOR IMPLEMENTATION

 - Partner with Account Executives and Account Managers to lead technical discovery, tailored demos and solution design, translating finance and procurement requirements into practical workflows and integrations.

 - Communicate capabilities, gaps and trade-offs clearly; identify implementation risks early and establish clear ownership and dated handoffs to the implementation team.


LEAD TECHNICAL RESOLUTION OF COMPLEX CUSTOMER CHALLENGES

 - Diagnose high-impact product, configuration, accounting and ERP issues, coordinating with customer-facing and technical teams to drive a clear resolution path.

 - Turn recurring issues into better guidance and evidence-backed product feedback, rather than a permanent stream of one-off interventions.


ENABLE PARTNERS AND BUILD THE INTERNATIONAL SOLUTIONS FUNCTION

 - Act as the technical counterpart to channel and accounting partners, supporting joint opportunities and equipping them with reusable knowledge and resources. Partnerships retains ownership of commercial relationships and partner strategy.

 - Work with Demo Architecture and Solutions teams to build market-relevant demos, playbooks and enablement for AEs, AMs and partners. Use lightweight intake and prioritisation to focus effort on customer risk, revenue impact and opportunities for leverage.




WHAT YOU NEED

 - A strong track record, typically 5–7 years, in solutions consulting, sales engineering, solutions architecture or technical consulting for complex B2B software, or in accounting or an in-house finance role with relevant systems and technical problem-solving experience.

 - Experience leading discovery, explaining complex workflows or systems, and influencing decisions across multiple stakeholders; experience delivering tailored demos is valuable.

 - Strong understanding of finance and accounting workflows, with hands-on experience working with ERP or accounting systems and their integrations.

 - The ability to reason through APIs, data flows and configuration dependencies, investigate technical problems and translate your findings for technical and non-technical audiences.

 - Evidence of working beyond the sale: designing implementable solutions, navigating complex customer issues and collaborating effectively across commercial and technical teams.

 - A builder’s mindset, with examples of creating reusable tools, documentation, demos or enablement that improved how others work.

 - Sound judgement about where to go deep, when to bring in specialists and how to set boundaries across competing priorities.

 - Comfort operating independently in an evolving market while building strong relationships with regional colleagues and central teams.




NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with fintech, spend management, procurement or procure-to-pay platforms.

 - Familiarity with UK and European accounting practices, multi-entity structures and multi-currency workflows.

 - Experience enabling accounting firms, channel partners or implementation partners.

 - Experience building or scaling a solutions motion in a new market.

 - SQL, scripting or other practical technical problem-solving skills.




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

In your first 6–12 months, you’ll establish a trusted technical path for complex opportunities and customer escalations; clearer procurement scoping and implementation handoffs; and stronger technical capability across our partner ecosystem.

You’ll also build reusable demos, enablement and playbooks that let the region scale without requiring you in every conversation, supported by clear visibility into solutions demand and outcomes.




BENEFITS AVAILABLE TO ALL FULL-TIME RAMP EMPLO

The role / impact

At Xero, we are here to make running a business beautiful by helping small businesses thrive and building a stronger economy. As Director of Partner Retention for Xero Canada, you will guide our Enterprise and Field Partner channel and the people within it, shaping our post-sales growth, utility, expansion, and account management strategy across Canadian regions.

In this role, you will coach a team of Partner Success Managers (PSMs) and Enterprise PSMs to deliver meaningful outcomes for our accounting and bookkeeping partners while hitting revenue, subscription, and activation targets. By nurturing strong relationships with key enterprise and field stakeholders, refining our sales motions, and mitigating churn, you will directly expand recurring revenue and strengthen Xero's market presence across Canada.

The team / how they connect

You will manage a dedicated team of Partner Success Managers and Enterprise PSMs who look after our existing field and enterprise accounting and bookkeeping partners across Canada. Together, your team supports partner onboarding, product adoption, account expansion, and long-term retention through regular business reviews and tailored territory planning. You will also collaborate closely with the Director of Partner Services, the Post PDR team, and cross-functional colleagues across sales enablement, product, marketing, legal, and operations to create a seamless partner experience.

The team is currently working on / Initially, you will focus on

 - Maintaining strong CRM discipline and using operational tools for accurate month-over-month forecasting, pipeline coverage, and sales execution.

 - Delivering quarterly and bi-annual business reviews with key enterprise and field partners across Canada to uncover growth opportunities and retention levers.

 - Spending time in the field coaching team members throughout the retention and growth cycle to lift activation velocity, upsell and cross-sell revenue, and conversion rates.

 - Partnering with the Director of Partner Services and the Post PDR team to refine post-sales motions, expand key enterprise accounts, and build repeatable processes that protect market share.

Where and how you can work

This role is based in Canada and supports partners and team members across Canadian regions. We offer a flexible hybrid working approach that blends remote work with in-person connection days at our Canadian offices, alongside regular time in the field coaching your team and attending partner channel events.

Here are some of the things we are looking for

 - You bring proven experience in sales or relationship management with field and enterprise clients, alongside a strong track record of achieving revenue, retention, and growth targets.

 - Coaching and mentoring people comes naturally to you, with a people-focused mindset that builds accountability, product knowledge, and a supportive team culture.

 - Your background includes shaping repeatable sales processes, managing pipeline forecasting with strong CRM habits, and guiding long enterprise sales cycles.

 - Collaborating across departments is one of your strengths, allowing you to work smoothly with product, marketing, legal, customer success, and sales operations teams.

 - Clear, empathetic communication and confident public speaking skills help you build trust with senior partner stakeholders and represent Xero at industry events.

At Xero, we value the impact and skills you bring to the team. We believe in a Total Package philosophy - ensuring your value is recognized through a holistic lens that includes base salary, performance incentives, and world-class benefits.

The expected base salary range for this role is $136,000 to $150,000

Individual pay is determined by various factors, including geography, level of experience, and the specific skills you bring to the role.

In addition to base pay, Xero’s roles are eligible for the following forms of variable compensation:

 - Variable Pay: Permanent employees are eligible to participate in our annual bonus and equity (RSU) programs. You may also be eligible for performance-based cash or equity (RSUs) incentives depending on your role level, and company performance.

 - Comprehensive Benefits: World-class health, wellness, and retirement programs. Xero Perks https://careers.xero.com/inside-xero/benefits-wellbeing/ including Wellbeing days, generous leave, and dedicated professional development budgets.

description:
Our Global Structure 
Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
 The Team 
 The Enterprise restaurant team is responsible for the strategic vision, acquisition, management and growth of our partnerships with the world’s largest restaurant groups. In the UK & Ireland, this means the local arms of our largest global brands. Given the scale of these partners, this team is a critical piece of Deliveroo’s growth and success.
 3 days in our London HQ is required.
 The Role 
 As a Client Partner, you will lead the relationship, strategy, project planning and account management for one or more of our largest global restaurant partners in the UK & Ireland. You will own the past and future of those relationships: building the annual joint business plan, leading contract negotiations and renewals, and working cross-functionally with marketing, finance, legal, analytics, operations and product to deliver it. You will also work with the partner’s EMEA and global counterparts, and partner closely with the DoorDash and Wolt EMEA and Global team to bring world-class technology and best practices to your accounts.

 ● Own the overall off-premise strategy for your partners across every phase of the relationship (piloting, rollout, support and growth)
 ● Lead contract negotiations and renewals, agreeing terms that unlock mutual value and grow like-for-like sales and take rate
 ● Use data and insights (SQL, dashboards and analysis) to find growth opportunities, build the business case for recommendations and sell Deliveroo’s suite of products and services into strategic clients
 ● Oversee partner-specific needs such as POS integrations, customised reporting, menu optimisation, merchant marketing and operational improvements
 ● Lead business reviews and present to partner executives and Deliveroo senior leadership, handling challenging questions with confidence
 ● Work cross-functionally and serve as a working team lead across marketing, finance, legal, analytics, operations, product and support

• Requiring a high level of commercial skills, you will demonstrate excellence in selling, negotiation and account management, combined with the passion and drive to shape the culture of an inclusive, sustainable and successful team.
• You have 5+ years of experience in management consulting, business strategy and analytics, strategy and operations, investment banking, account management, business development or other analytically-intensive and client-facing roles
• You have strong SQL skills: you can pull, read and manipulate large data sets yourself and turn them into insight (other forms of data experience can be considered)
• You have a track record of end-to-end problem solving: spotting a problem, ideating a solution and taking it all the way to a measurable, high-value outcome with cross-functional teams 
• You are an excellent data storyteller who can build a clear narrative from data and present it, and defend it, to senior executives
• You have proven success working in cross-functional teams to build creative solutions, with strong project management, organisation and presentation skills
• You are a problem solver at core with a strong bias for action, you like rolling up your sleeves as much as you like the big picture, and you are comfortable with a fast pace and several moving parts
• You know how to take very broad challenges or opportunities and turn them into actionable projects with clear milestones and goals, with minimal guidance
• You have well-developed negotiation skills and the ability to flex your style to all levels and situations
• You are comfortable using AI tools day to day to work faster and smarter
• Nice to have: experience with global or US brands, tech or startup exposure, marketplace, logistics or unit economics knowledge, and prior people leadership or hiring experience.
 Why Join Us? 
 At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving. We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

 Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.

 Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.

 🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture 
 Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best.

title: Partner Manager, Consulting Alliances
description:
ABOUT US

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

 - We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

 - We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

 - We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.


THE ROLE

You'll own a portfolio of Legora's consulting and SI partner relationships across Europe, working closely with their alliance leads, practice heads, and delivery teams, and with Legora's own sales and engagement teams, to turn those relationships into successful client outcomes.

We're building this program from the ground up in Europe — there's no inherited playbook here. You'll be one of the founding members of Legora's partnerships team on the ground, helping shape how we go to market with consulting partners in the region, what we ask of them, and what we give them in return. You'll work alongside the Director of Consulting Alliances and the broader partnerships team in New York, and closely with Sales, Engagement Management, and Legal Engineers in Europe.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Manage day-to-day relationships with a portfolio of consulting and SI partners across Europe, from practice leads through to alliance stakeholders.

 - Map account and pipeline opportunities with partners, and get deals moving through co-sell and co-working motions with Legora's European sales team.

 - Get embedded with Legora's sales and customer teams so you understand the product well enough to demo it and speak to it credibly with partners.

 - Keep partner teams enabled and current as Legora's product evolves.

 - Identify issues in the partnership and team up with the Director to work through them.

 - Help shape the partnership model — what services partners provide, what Legora provides — working with the Director and internal teams.

 - Track partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline and revenue, and bring partner and market feedback back into Legora.


WHAT YOU BRING

 - Experience in alliances, partnerships, or business development at a SaaS or AI company. This means actual pipeline built, deals closed, and partner relationships that held up over time.

 - Firsthand experience with how consulting firms or SIs operate: how they make decisions and team with technology partners. We're looking for people who've been close to the strategy and delivery side of these relationships, not primarily an admin or coordination role within a large firm.

 - Comfort building a partner program rather than inheriting one. This means you're fine when the structure doesn't exist yet.

 - Good commercial judgment: you can work through multi-party deal complexity and know when to push and when to step back.

 - Ability to run multiple things at once (relationship, pipeline, enablement) across several partners simultaneously.

 - Strong communication across levels, from partner leadership to field teams.

 - Comfort with a product that ships fast — you'll stay current and help your partners do the same.

 - Willingness to travel to support partner relationships and joint customer work across Europe.

Nice to have:

 - Background in legal tech, professional services, or experience selling into law firms or in-house legal teams.

 - Familiarity with AI products and how to position them to buyers who are cautious about risk and care a lot about accuracy — this doesn't need to come from having worked at an AI company specifically; being a genuine, curious user of AI products counts.

 - Experience as an early hire on a partner team that scaled.

Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer

At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. 
 An overview of this role 
 As a Staff Product Manager on the Tenant Scale area within Infrastructure Platforms, you’ll set product direction for how GitLab supports large, complex customers as they grow across departments, projects, and regions. This role focuses on the product choices needed to make tenant data more portable, scalable, and ready for a unified deployment model across GitLab.com, Dedicated, and, over time, Self-Managed. You’ll work on problems that sit at the intersection of product strategy, infrastructure, and customer needs, including how we build a platform to horizontally scale our SaaS architecture, how to enable tenant movement between environments, how isolation and regional requirements are handled, and what needs to be in place to support a more cellular architecture.
 At the Staff level, your scope extends beyond a single group. Your direction will inform the broader Infrastructure Platforms direction, you’ll make the investment case for unified deployment capabilities, and you’ll be a recognized authority, inside and outside GitLab, on multi-tenant and cellular SaaS architecture. In your first year, you’ll partner closely with engineering and product peers to define requirements, drive alignment, and move this work from concept into a deployment model teams can build on, while coaching fellow product managers as they pick up work from the shared pool.
 What you’ll do 
• Drive product strategy and direction for tenant scale and unified deployment capabilities across GitLab.com, Dedicated, and future deployment models, informing the broader Infrastructure Platforms direction and moving this work from concept into a deployment model teams can build on in your first year.
• Set quarterly and annual plans for tenant portability and platform unification, breaking large epics into issues and minimal valuable changes (MVCs) and practicing iteration across multiple groups.
• Define requirements for our unified deployment platform, including the capabilities needed before tenants can be hosted in a unified deployment unit.
• Partner closely with engineering counterparts and highly technical teams to turn infrastructure constraints and platform needs into clear product direction.
• Collaborate with product peers across the platforms organization, including teams working on GitLab.com and adjacent infrastructure areas, and manage with influence to align work that spans more than one group.
• Engage with internal and external customers to understand needs related to isolation, regional deployment, compliance, and operational readiness, using qualitative interviews to find patterns and sharpen problem statements.
• Build business cases for investment in tenant scale and unified deployment, including build, buy, and partner options, the cost of isolation, regionality, and compliance, and the expected benefits.
• Facilitate tradeoff discussions around scalability, tenant encapsulation, deployment consistency, and platform unification, and escalate cleanly to the right level of leadership when decisions or progress are blocked.
• Translate complex technical concepts into product plans, priorities, and documentation that align distributed teams on delivery milestones for tenant portability and platform unification, using error budgets and other performance indicators to inform direction.
• Represent GitLab as a trusted voice on cellular architecture and tenant scale in customer calls, events, and other external forums.
• Coach fellow product managers on direction updates, customer validation, and GitLab’s architecture and tech stack, and support a collaborative team model where product managers share ownership across a common pool of work and step into the areas where they can have the most impact.
 What you’ll bring 
• Experience managing product work in technical domains such as infrastructure, scalability, platform architecture, software delivery, or cloud services, with results delivered across a range of product areas rather than a single one.
• Ability to work effectively with deeply technical engineering teams and build credibility in discussions about system design, deployment models, and platform constraints.
• Knowledge of how SaaS or platform-based systems scale, including concepts such as multitenancy, horizontal scalability, autoscaling, workload isolation, and production readiness, and the ability to build a deep understanding of GitLab’s architecture and tech stack and coach others on it.
• Comfort working with customers or internal stakeholders on complex requirements, including operational, compliance, or regional deployment

We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here https://faculty.ai/impact.



We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.



Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.



AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.


ABOUT THE TEAM



Our Retail and Consumer team is dedicated to helping clients deliver their strategic objectives through the successful application of Data Science and Frontier AI.

Our work spans the full spectrum of AI capabilities from machine learning to computer vision, simulation, optimisation, generative AI, agentic systems, and bringing these capabilities together in decision intelligence applications. Our solutions help clients understand and better engage with customers, improve commercial and trading decisions, improve the efficiency of end to end operations, and improve colleague experience.




ABOUT THE ROLE



As a Customer Director, you’ll play an influential role in growing our most impactful accounts and shape our go-to-market strategy in order to achieve our ambitious growth targets.



You will act as a strategic partner to our Retail clients, helping them reinvent the way they engage with customers, and the way they operate across commercial, supply chain, stores, online and support functions with AI. You will build enduring relationships with senior stakeholders, drive commercial strategy, and oversee multidisciplinary delivery teams to ensure cutting-edge AI deployments are secure, reliable, and grounded in real-world impact.



This is an opportunity to help build a distinctive practice inside a company with world-class technical depth and the ambition to set the standard for AI in the Retail sector.



The ideal candidate will be T-shaped: broad enough to advise across AI for a range of firms including adjacent consumer facing sectors, with deep experience in Grocery and/or Fashion & Apparel sectors. We are particularly interested in candidates who have delivered enterprise AI solutions that have enabled real world impact.





WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:



 - Driving revenue growth; identifying strategic opportunities to expand current accounts and identifying new clients within the Retail sector (specifically Grocery and Fashion & Apparel)

 - Leading complex AI transformation programmes for major Retail clients, moving from strategic thinking to production-grade software delivery

 - Building trusted, long-term relationships with C-suite leaders and partners, acting as a strategic advisor on how AI can automate knowledge work and drive operational efficiency

 - Ensuring the successful delivery of high-quality client work by guiding multidisciplinary teams and helping them navigate the ambiguity and pace of the sector

description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE 

Productions is the 'done for you' managed services wing of ElevenLabs made for creators and media businesses. We bring together our AI audio tools and human experts to unlock human-edited dubs, audiobooks, and more in 15+ languages directly on the ElevenLabs platform.

 


HERE ARE A FEW RECENT PROJECTS PRODUCTIONS HAS HELPED BRING TO LIFE:

 - Dubbing for some of the world's biggest creators (DudePerfect, Lex Fridman, Andrew Huberman), media businesses (Headspace) and broadcasters (Mediaset)

 - Audiobook production for leading publishers and digital storytelling platforms

 - Voice creation, sound design, and other audio engineering services for ElevenLabs' largest customers

 - You can learn more about Productions here: https://elevenlabs.io/productions
   
   


JOINING US IN MARKETPLACE OPERATIONS, YOU WILL DRIVE THE SUCCESS OF OUR OPERATIONS ORG, INCLUDING:

 - Own end-to-end processes across hiring, training, turnaround times, pricing, quality control, producer engagement and more

 - Expand our hiring engine to ensure we always have the capacity we need to meet our (growing!) demand

 - Improve our quality control and monitoring systems to ensure the dubs, audiobooks, and other content we deliver sound natural and professional-grade

 - Build your own data pipelines and dashboards to inform decision making at scale

 - Find new efficiency levers through process (e.g. new onboarding flow), automation (e.g. Python scripts) or collaboration with Engineering (e.g. new dispatch or pricing function)

 - Work with the rest of the Productions org (Engineering, Production Managers, Content Ops, Sales) to make Productions the greatest audio marketplace on the planet!




REQUIREMENTS

 - Ops fluency - you have experience managing and scaling complex Ops processes, e.g. in a marketplace or logistics environment

 - Problem solving  – you’re talented at breaking down complex problems into atomic pieces, then formulating the right plan to tackle each

 - Data & analytics - you’re comfortable running your own queries, small scripts and crunching data

 - Pace - you enjoy operating in an early‑stage, high‑growth environment, including implementing new ideas and iterating quickly

 - Team collaboration - you’re skilled at collaborating across various functions and driving the best possible team outcome

 - Bonus points for:
   
   - Experience managing/growing freelancer teams
   
   - Experience in the localization, data labelling, or audio production industry




LOCATION

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in Bangalore, Dublin, London, New York, San Francisco, Tokyo, and Warsaw.

 An overview of this role 
 What does software planning look like when people and artificial intelligence agents work together? As a Staff Product Manager for Planning at GitLab, you'll help answer that question and lead the team toward a clear product direction. This isn't just about improving traditional agile planning. You'll rethink how intent becomes actionable work, how that work moves through software development, and where human involvement is needed.
 You'll develop a point of view on planning's future and turn it into product decisions with engineering, design, and product leadership. That includes exploring how planning could connect work to business priorities and budgets, rather than assuming the answer is already decided. Alongside that strategic work, you'll share ownership of existing planning capabilities with another product manager.
 We're opening this role at Staff level, with flexibility to consider Principal level based on your experience and scope of impact.
 What you'll do 
• Define a clear direction for planning as software development shifts toward collaboration between people and artificial intelligence agents, and help the team move from open questions to concrete priorities.
• Shape how users capture intent, break it into actionable work, and determine which work can proceed autonomously and which needs human involvement.
• Evaluate whether and how planning should connect software delivery to company priorities, business objectives, and budgets.
• Share ownership of planning capabilities, including work items, boards, specifications, and portfolio planning, with a fellow product manager. Help define how that scope is divided.
• Work with engineering and design to translate product direction into a roadmap and improvements to planning workflows across GitLab.
• Communicate your recommendations clearly to senior leaders, challenge assumptions constructively, and lead the team through changes in direction.
 What you'll bring 
• Experience leading product strategy and execution for software development, developer tools, or planning products, with the depth to make decisions in a specialized product area.
• A strong understanding of software development and development and operations (DevOps) workflows, including how planning decisions affect downstream delivery.
• The ability to form and defend a product point of view in an uncertain, changing market, while staying open to different ideas.
• Clear communication with technical teams and senior executives, including experience challenging leadership decisions constructively and building support for a direction.
• The ability to connect a forward-looking strategy to practical product decisions and work collaboratively across product, engineering, and design.

 The Planning team builds the capabilities at the start of GitLab's software development workflow, including work items, boards, specifications, and portfolio planning. Decisions here affect how work moves through the rest of the platform, so the team's scope extends beyond standalone project management tools.
 You'll work alongside another product manager and partner with engineering and design across this product area. The division of product ownership is still being shaped, and you'll help define it. The hiring manager wants you to bring a different perspective, question established approaches, and challenge senior leaders constructively, with room to influence decisions beyond your immediate product scope.

ClearBank was built on the belief that banking infrastructure should enable progress, not slow it down. Our clients, from fintechs and digital asset businesses to banks and financial institutions, use our technology and APIs to power innovative banking and payment propositions.

But we wouldn’t be ClearBank without our people. They’re what powers our technology and the reason we love what we do every day. We’re a group of ambitious, curious people who aren’t afraid to challenge the status quo. We believe in fairness, autonomy and choice, empowering our people with the tools and opportunities to learn, grow and contribute to the success of ClearBank and our clients.



About you

You’ll be joining the Product team as a Product Manager – Cross-Border Payments & Digital Assets, reporting to the Head of Product, Cross-Border Payments and Foreign Exchange.

This is an exciting opportunity to help shape ClearBank’s next generation of international payments and digital asset propositions.

We’re looking for an experienced, hands-on Product Manager who can operate at the intersection of cross-border payments, banking infrastructure and digital assets. You’ll be comfortable taking complex opportunities from discovery through to launch, working across Product, Engineering, Operations, Treasury, Financial Crime, Compliance, Risk and Commercial teams.

title: Partner Manager, Education Partnerships
description:
ABOUT US

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

 - We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

 - We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

 - We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.


THE ROLE

You'll own Legora's partnerships with top law schools across Europe, working closely with faculty, school administration, and Legora's own sales and engagement teams, to get the next generation of lawyers trained on and excited about Legora.

We're building this program from the ground up in Europe — there's no inherited playbook here. You'll be one of the founding members of Legora's partnerships team on the ground, shaping how we bring Legora into legal curricula and how we build lasting relationships with the schools that matter most. You'll work alongside Legora's broader partnerships team in New York, and closely with Sales, Engagement Management, and Legal Engineers in Europe.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build and manage relationships with top law schools across Europe, getting students access to Legora through complimentary licenses.

 - Go beyond access — make sure students are genuinely learning on Legora, so they graduate as trained users and evangelists for the platform.

 - Team up with professors to embed Legora into the curriculum, identifying the faculty who are the real movers and shakers and figuring out what will get them excited about building a partnership around Legora.

 - Get embedded with Legora's sales and customer teams so you understand the product well enough to demo it and speak to it credibly with schools.

 - Track engagement and outcomes across your school partnerships, and report on progress.

 - Bring feedback from schools and faculty back into Legora to inform product and go-to-market decisions.


WHAT YOU BRING
