title: Communications Lead
description:
Attio is the CRM for agentic revenue. Designed for the most ambitious go-to-market teams, it gives companies the power to understand every customer, automate at scale, and build their go-to-market motion exactly as they need. We've raised $116M from some of the world's best investors: GV (Google Ventures), Redpoint, Balderton, Point Nine, and 01A.

We hire builders who thrive on complex technical challenges, hold themselves to a high bar, and genuinely care about delighting the people who use what they build. The team here brings sharp judgement, real craft, and the drive to do exceptional work. We're obsessed about the details and energized by the frontier.

If you want to do the best work of your career, this is the right place.



ABOUT THE ROLE

Our Marketing team shapes how the world sees and experiences Attio. We think strategically, move fast, and obsess over quality — from acquisition to brand to product marketing. We experiment constantly, craft clear narratives, and focus relentlessly on what drives growth.

CRM is entering a new era. AI is changing how companies go to market, and Attio is building the platform at the centre of that shift.

We’re looking for a Communications Lead to shape how Attio tells that story — defining the narratives, ideas, and perspectives that build our position as the category evolves.

Your primary focus will be shaping Attio’s narrative and building the communications strategy that brings it to life — across our own channels and through the people and platforms that influence how Attio is understood.

You’ll work across the company to uncover what’s interesting, turn complex ideas into compelling stories, and build a communications engine that grows Attio’s influence alongside the business.

The ideal candidate is an exceptional storyteller with strong editorial instincts, a deep understanding of technology and culture, and the ambition to help define how a new generation thinks about CRM.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

Narrative & positioning: Own Attio’s company narrative and the stories, ideas, and perspectives we want to be known for.

Content: Turn our narrative into distinctive content and programs across Attio’s owned channels.

Founder & executive communications: Shape the voices and external presence of our founders and leadership team across social, content, media, and events.

PR & earned media: Build relationships with journalists and media, creating opportunities for others to tell Attio’s story.

Employee & internal comms: Help our team understand and tell Attio’s story through internal communications, employer brand, and employee advocacy.

Company announcements: Lead communications for major moments including fundraising, company news, launches, and other key milestones.




WHAT YOU’LL BRING

Communications experience: 7+ years across communications, content, editorial, PR, or brand, ideally within high-growth startups.

Exceptional storytelling: You can turn complex ideas into simple, distinctive, and compelling narratives.

Editorial judgement: You have strong instincts for what makes a great story, what audiences will care about, and where it should be told.

Executive partnership: You’re comfortable working directly with founders and senior leaders to shape their voice and external presence.

Media understanding: You understand the modern communications landscape across press, social, creators, podcasts, events, and emerging channels.

Strategic judgement: You can move between long-term narrative building and high-stakes, fast-moving communications with confidence.

Builder mindset: You’re comfortable creating the strategy and doing the work — from developing the narrative to writing the final copy.

Eye for quality: You hold a high bar for everything Attio puts into the world and know what great communications looks like.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - UK benefits
   
   - Equity in an early-stage tech company on an incredible trajectory
   
   - 25 days holiday plus local public holidays
   
   - Apple hardware
   
   - Private medical insurance through AXA
   
   - Pension contribution through Hargreaves Lansdown
   
   - Enhanced family leave
   
   - Team off-site in fun places! (We've been to Barcelona, Lisbon, Malta, and Split so far)




WHAT DOES THE HIRING PROCESS LOOK LIKE?

 - Initial conversations
   
   - 30-minute intro with a member of our Talent team
   
   - 30-minute track record interview with our VP Marketing

 - Core interviews
   
   - A set of working sessions exploring your approach to narrative creation and editorial judgement, understanding of the media and AI landscape, executive partnership, and your ability to develop and execute impactful communications strategies.

 - Final stage
   
   - 30-minute closing conversation with a member of our leadership team
   
   - Offer call (if it's a mutual fit)

title: Lead Data Scientist
description:
WHY FACULTY? 


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here https://faculty.ai/impact.



We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.



Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.



AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.





ABOUT THE TEAM 

 

Our Energy, Transition and Environment business unit is pioneering meaningful change in the clean energy revolution. Our vision is to accelerate the transition to net-zero emissions and drive efficiencies for a new era of utility companies.

 

We believe that the responsible, and intelligent, deployment of AI is critical to the success of this mission. We partner with a wide range of clients - from major energy operators, to GreenTech startups, and national infrastructure providers - to build solutions which return measurable impact and move us towards a smarter, cleaner, and more sustainable world.

 




ABOUT THE ROLE

 

As a Lead Data Scientist, you'll take on a pivotal, entrepreneurial role, functioning as the technical expert who thrives on complexity and commercial impact. You will be responsible for setting the technical direction and ensuring the high-quality, scalable delivery of our most challenging, high-impact projects. 


This position combines deep expertise in machine learning with strategic oversight to define project roadmaps, manage technical risk, and architect reliable solutions. Your focus will be on driving innovation, mentoring cross-functional teams, and actively shaping both our technical standards and long-term customer relationships.

 



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:

 

 - Setting the technical direction for complex, business-critical projects and expertly balancing trade-offs between speed, innovation, and reliability.

 - Designing and implementing reliable, production-grade technical solutions, ensuring comprehensive documentation of architectures and specifications.

 - Defining project problems, developing clear roadmaps, and overseeing end-to-end delivery across multi-disciplinary workstreams.

 - Leading technical scoping and feasibility studies for high-value sales opportunities and strategic customer engagements.

 - Managing relationships and communications with demanding clients, fostering trust and aligning technical solutions with shared long-term commercial goals.

 - Driving the adoption of best practices, shared resources, and robust technical processes across the wider Data Science craft.

 - Mentoring and developing other data scientists and team members, actively contributing to the growth and technical excellence of the organisation.

 


WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

 

 - You bring depth of expertise in at least one machine learning domain and strong technical breadth across the entire data science landscape.

 - You are a skilled technical leader, proficient in mentoring individuals, managing teams (including other managers), and rolling out impactful tools and workflows.

 - You have proven project management expertise, capable of dividing complex, ill-defined problems into actionable, clearly defined workstreams with timelines you can defend.

 - You are adept at managing ill-defined, high-risk tasks, consistently delivering innovative and practical outcomes under commercial pressure.

 - You possess strong customer leadership skills, able to act as a trusted technical advisor and drive long-term strategic relationships with demanding clients.

 - You excel at cross-functional collaboration, effectively aligning technical strategy with Engineering, Commercial (BD), and Infrastructure teams.

 - You have experience extending technical oversight to business unit-level initiatives, using your vision to influence and contribute to organisational success.

 


OUR INTERVIEW PROCESS

 

 1. Talent Team Screen (30 minutes)

 2. Introduction to the team (45 minutes)

 3. Technical Interview (90 minutes) 

 4. Commercial Interview (60 minutes)






OUR RECRUITMENT ETHOS




We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.



If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours. 



A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

title: Solutions Consultant, Mid-Market, UKI
description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is shaping the future of Go-To-Market, and as a Solutions Consultant (SC), you’ll bring that future to life by building alongside customers and turning their biggest challenges into measurable outcomes. As a customer-facing, quota-carrying SC, you’ll bring together technical fluency and commercial ownership to grow your book of business. You’ll build pipeline with BDRs, engage key stakeholders, lead discovery, co-build workflow solutions live with customers, and guide opportunities through close. You’ll connect each solution to a clear business case and stay engaged through adoption, expansion, and renewal so customers realize the value of what they buy.

You’ll partner with BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists while maintaining clear ownership of customer relationships, opportunity momentum, and next steps. If you’re a builder who loves to sell—and want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, and enterprise—this is the role.

This role will be based in Dublin. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Create pipeline across your book of business. Build target-account plans with BDRs and initiate outreach to priority stakeholders to generate qualified opportunities, alongside BDR-sourced pipeline.

 - Own opportunities from first conversation through close. Lead discovery, qualify business needs and urgency, align stakeholders, shape the solution and business case, and drive the evaluation and commercial decision. Navigate commercial sizing, proposal construction, procurement, legal, and security review to close deals with the right scope, credits, and implementation path.

 - Design and validate workflow solutions that deliver measurable value. Map current- and future-state workflows, co-build solutions live in Notion, and define realistic scope, success criteria, and an implementation path. Translate customer needs and validated outcomes into a clear business case, commercial recommendation, and decision path. Treat discovery as an opportunity to build and validate.

 - Orchestrate the right partners while maintaining ownership. Engage BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists at the right moments, with clear context and asks, while owning opportunity momentum, customer communication, and next steps.

 - Drive customer value and commercial growth after signature. Partner with Outcomes Architects, guide the initial path to value with a clear adoption plan, on onboarding and ongoing multi-workflow adoption, and own expansion strategy and renewal planning. Stay accountable for translating credits sold into credits consumed, and surface risks or expansion opportunities as customer workflows mature.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Commercial ownership and pipeline generation. You can demonstrate how you created or advanced business, influenced customer decisions, and owned measurable outcomes. Relevant experience may come from quota-carrying sales or adjacent customer-facing roles.

 - Technical fluency and builder mindset. You are comfortable building live in software and can demo, co-design, and troubleshoot with a customer without needing a specialist in the room.

 - AI fluency. You are excited about AI, build with new tools, and continually learn new ways of working.

 - Discovery, qualification, and value articulation. You can uncover customer needs, map workflows, qualify business impact and urgency, and translate what you learn into commercial outcomes, adoption plans, and clear success criteria.

 - Agency, urgency, and learning velocity. You set clear goals, take initiative, learn from customer interactions, and apply those learnings to improve outcomes. You bring new ideas and workflows to customers and make complex problems easier to solve.

 - Complex customer engagement. You can lead multi-stakeholder interactions and navigate procurement, legal, and security review cycles.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Full-cycle B2B software sales experience or solutions engineering experience, with a consistent track record of exceeding quota across new-logo acquisition and expansion motions.
   
   - Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based pricing models and the ability to structure credit-based commercial proposals.

 - Prior experience selling to mid-market and enterprise accounts in productivity, collaboration, or workflow software.

title: Head Of Data Protection & DPO
description:
💬 ACCURX IS SOLVING HEALTHCARE PRODUCTIVITY FOR THE NHS.

For decades, the NHS has struggled with fragmented systems that make simple tasks feel impossible. At Accurx, we’re changing that by building a single, system-wide platform that helps every patient get gold-standard, efficient, and joined-up care.

What started as a way for GPs to text a patient has now evolved into an all-in-one digital toolkit used by 98% of GP practices.

Our platform now powers Total Triage https://www.accurx.com/primary-care to manage patient demand, and Self-Book, https://www.accurx.com/booking which lets patients schedule their own appointments in seconds. We’ve automated routine care with Patient Questionnaires https://www.accurx.com/questionnaires for long-term conditions, while Accumail https://www.accurx.com/accumail finally allows staff-to-staff communication to happen instantly across different care settings. We’re now pushing the boundaries of the consultation itself with Accurx Scribe https://www.accurx.com/scribe, our AI-powered note-taker that drafts medical notes in real-time.

We’re not just shipping features. We’re giving clinicians their time back and ensuring every patient journey is as smooth as it should be.



THE OPPORTUNITY:

We're on a journey to steward AI into the NHS safely and responsibly. We've already deployed ambient voice technology to write up consultations, released our first AI triage products to help practices read and route hundreds of patient requests a day, and we're now working on deploying agents in healthcare settings.

The next few years will define how AI is used with patient data in the NHS. As Head of Data Protection and our in-house DPO, you'll help set that standard nationally: building the frameworks that let us move quickly and safely, and earning the trust of the patients, clinicians and organisations who rely on us.

This role is about building and shaping, not just running. You'll own data protection at Accurx end to end: the strategy, the statutory role, the team and the calls. You'll be a key leader in our Technology division, working as a trusted partner to our Chief Product Officer and Head of Legal.





CHALLENGES YOU'LL SOLVE...

 - Steward AI into the NHS: set Accurx's positions on how we build, deploy and monitor AI products at scale, from controllership and assistive vs automated, to retention of AI inputs and outputs, sub-processors and model hosting, without ever undermining the trust we've built with our users

 - Set guardrails, not gates: define clear guardrails so product teams can move fast inside them without asking permission each time, and make our positions public and credible so NHS DPOs can rely on them rather than starting from scratch

 - Bring privacy into product design: work with product, design and engineering to embed privacy by design. Much of what we're building hasn't been seen in the health system before, so you'll need to be unapologetically forward-looking and comfortable taking informed, calculated risks

 - Turn decisions into reusable patterns: with our in-house privacy team, build governance templates, pre-approved data flows and plain-English privacy notice wording that healthcare organisations can pick up and use, and shape how we responsibly use our data to improve products and patient outcomes

 - Hold the statutory DPO role with independence: inform, advise and monitor compliance under UK GDPR, including our record of processing, DPIAs, training and audits. You'll be our named contact for the ICO, NHS customers and data subjects, and lead testing, breach assessment and reporting

 - Run corporate privacy: own our core privacy obligations and registrations, keep the evidence current for regulators, customers and bids, lead privacy due diligence on suppliers, partners and corporate transactions, and oversee how we handle employee and corporate data as well as patient data

 - Build a function that moves at product speed: lead and grow a small, bar-raising privacy and data function, and make it easy for 200+ colleagues to get fast, consistent answers to privacy questions


YOU SHOULD APPLY IF...

 - You're product-minded about privacy: you've worked inside a product company and helped ship things, finding an approach that's both more private and better for the user. You've guided technology organisations through responsible innovation, especially where AI/ML meets sensitive data

 - You're AI-fluent with deep UK data protection expertise: you apply UK GDPR, the Data Protection Act 2018, the Data (Use and Access) Act 2025 and the common law duty of confidentiality in practice, understand how modern AI systems actually handle data, and have a view on ICO AI guidance and where regulation is heading

 - You've built and led privacy teams: you grow capability, bring your team into decisions, delegate real ownership and build trust across functions

 - You're confident externally: you can represent the business to regulators, NHS organisations and partners, and communicate complex positions clearly

 - You know health and the NHS, or have a fast route to it: controller and processor roles in primary care, DSPT, DTAC, the Caldicott Principles and the national data opt-out. You learn the NHS by going to see it

 - You challenge the status quo: you stay ahead of changes in digital health, AI and data ethics, and see privacy as something that enables the business to move at pace





WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?

You’ll join a high-performing team on a mission to solve healthcare productivity, building a platform used by around 300k NHS staff every week, supporting the care of over 50 million NHS patients every year. We set a high bar, move fast, and give people the ownership and support to do the best work of their careers

 - £110,000 - £140,000 salary, plus a discretionary recognition bonus for exceptional performance and impact, nominated by managers and awarded by our leadership team

 - Equity: £100,000 in equal share options,

 Organisations rely on us to establish trust, through sharing their security maturity and visualising the risks posed by their supply chain ecosystem. And we’re already trusted by customers like British Airways, BAE Systems and the NHS.
 We are putting together an amazing and talented team from a diverse set of backgrounds and skillsets to drive us towards our vision. Risk Ledger is built on the respect we have for one another and our users, united by our shared values and mission.
 Every one of us is still learning: it’s how we grow as individuals. We’re curious. We’re ambitious. And we’re humble and honest. At Risk Ledger, we aim high to find the best solutions we can and always put our users first.
 The team 
You'll join the Security & IT team, led by the Director of Information Security and IT Operations, which owns information security, IT operations and GRC across Risk Ledger in the UK and US.
 Risk Ledger helps security and risk teams manage third-party and supply chain risk, so our customers hold us to the same standard they hold their own suppliers to. Our own assurance is part of the product promise: we are ISO 27001 certified, hold Cyber Essentials Plus and have achieved SOC 2 Type 1.
 The team works closely with Engineering, Product, Sales, Customer Success, People and Finance, making security and compliance something that helps the business win and keep customers rather than slowing it down.
 This role 
As GRC Lead you'll own Risk Ledger's governance, risk and compliance work day to day: our certifications, our enterprise risk management, our policies, and the assurance we give customers.
 This is a hands-on role for someone who likes to do the work, not delegate it. There's no team to inherit. You'll be the person who keeps ISO 27001 running, takes us from SOC 2 Type 1 to Type 2, and owns the risk framework the leadership team relies on.
 It's a highly collaborative role: expect to spend around half your time working with people across the business, from engineers to Sales to leadership. You'll often be given a problem rather than a plan, so you'll be comfortable turning loose direction into something that works. 
 Because GRC is what our customers do, you'll also get to feed your expertise into our product.
 In this role you will, 
• Run our certifications. Maintain our ISO 27001 ISMS year round and lead our external audits. Take us from SOC 2 Type 1 to Type 2 by building and maintaining the evidence, then keep SOC 2 running.
• Own enterprise risk management. Own our enterprise risk management framework and risk register, run risk reviews with owners, and give the leadership team clear reporting on our risk posture.
• Lead our compliance tooling. Manage our automated security and compliance software platform implementation, then help us move to an in-house solution within the year, so evidence collection is continuous rather than a scramble before each audit.
• Support customer assurance. Help Sales and Customer Success answer security questionnaires and due diligence, so security reviews speed deals up rather than slowing them down.
• Keep policies current. Keep our policies up to date, owned and followed, and support our own supplier risk programme using the Risk Ledger platform.
Bring people with you. Work with control owners across the business, explaining why controls matter and getting things done through influence rather than authority.
 You'll have 
• At least 3 years' hands-on GRC experience.
• Hands-on experience maintaining an ISO 27001 certification and working on SOC 2 audits from the organisation's side. Both are essential.
• Experience in a startup or scale-up, ideally in B2B SaaS, fintech or security.
• Hands-on experience of risk management, and turning risk data into clear reporting for senior leaders.
• A pragmatic, risk-based approach: you favour real security outcomes over box-ticking and can explain why a control matters.
• A self-starter mindset: you take ownership, work well with loose direction and move at pace.
• Strong communication and people skills, adapting to audiences from engineers to auditors to leadership.
• AI and automation experience
 Nice to have 
• Experience with Cyber Essentials or Cyber Essentials Plus.
• Experience with ISO 42001, the EU AI Act or other AI governance frameworks.
• Experience with GRC automation platforms, or building compliance tooling in house.
• Working knowledge of UK GDPR and awareness of US privacy and security expectations.
• Experience supporting sales through customer security reviews and questionnaires.
• Experience with third-party or supply chain risk management, or a strong interest in the problem we solve.
• Relevant certifications such as ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor, CISA, CISM, CRISC or CISSP.
 Why join us 
• Work on GRC at a company whose customers are GRC and security teams, and help shape the product they use.
• Real ownership from day one, with room to grow into leadership as the company scales.
• A differentiated vision and a unique community-based approach to supply chain risk.
• Hybrid working from our new London office near Old Street.
 Salary range
 £70,000 — £80,000 GBP

title: Senior Partner Operations Manager
description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.
 About Us 
 Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.
Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.
Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.
As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.
During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.
 About the Role 
 We're looking for a Senior Partner Operations Manager to join our Global Revenue Operations team and make sure the partner programs for both Fivetran and dbt Labs run like a well-oiled machine.
 You'll be the operational backbone of our partner ecosystem, covering resellers, cloud marketplaces, global and regional system integrators, and technology alliances. Your work will keep partner programs scalable, measurable, and easy for partners and internal teams to work with.
 This is a full-time remote position based out of the US.
 Technologies You'll Use 
 Salesforce, a Partner Relationship Management (PRM) platform (such as Impartner, ZINFI, PartnerStack, or Salesforce Experience Cloud), Looker, Google Sheets, Slack, Jira, Gong, and cloud marketplace consoles (AWS, Azure, GCP), Clari.
 What You'll Do 
• Own the day-to-day operations of the Fivetran and dbt Labs partner programs, including onboarding, tiering, certification, and renewals
• Design and continuously improve partner processes so they are scalable, consistent, and easy for partners and internal teams to follow
• Manage partner data and systems in Salesforce and our PRM platform, including deal registration, lead routing, and partner-sourced and influenced attribution
• Build and maintain dashboards and reports that give Partner, Sales, and executive leaders clear visibility into partner pipeline, bookings, and program health
• Partner with Partner Management, Sales, Marketing, and Finance to define and track program KPIs, goals, and incentives
• Administer partner incentive programs, including MDF, rebates, and SPIFFs, in coordination with Finance and Legal
• Support the integration of Fivetran and dbt Labs partner programs by aligning policies, processes, and tooling across both organizations
• Run regular business reviews and forecasting cadences with partner teams, surfacing risks, trends, and opportunities
• Document processes, policies, and playbooks, and keep program guidelines current and accessible
• Mentor junior team members and collaborate with Sales Ops, Marketing Ops, and Process & Systems on cross-functional initiatives
 Skills We're Looking For 
• 7-10 years of experience in partner operations, channel operations, or revenue operations, with deep expertise in B2B SaaS partner programs (reseller, referral, marketplace, SI, and technology alliance models)
• Strong working knowledge of Salesforce and PRM platforms, including partner data models, deal registration, and attribution
• Proven ability to design, document, and scale processes across multiple teams and regions
• Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn partner data into clear insights, dashboards, and recommendations for leaders
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience influencing without direct authority across Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Legal
• Experience with partner incentive and compensation structures, such as MDF, rebates, and partner discounts
• Understand how to use conversational AI systems (like Claude, ChatGPT, and internal chatbots) to support research, analysis, process documentation, and reporting, and how to apply AI to automate routine partner operations work
 Bonus Skills 
• Experience supporting partner programs through a merger or acquisition, or integrating two go-to-market organizations
• Familiarity with cloud marketplace listings and co-sell programs (AWS, Azure, GCP)
• Background in data, analytics, or developer-focused products such as data integration, transformation, or warehousing
• Experience with partner enablement and certification programs
• Salesforce Administrator certification, or hands-on experience configuring Salesforce workflows and reports

title: Community Lead
description:
ACCURX IS SOLVING HEALTHCARE PRODUCTIVITY FOR THE NHS

At Accurx, we’ve supported thousands of healthcare organisations to deliver care for over 60 million patients. We’re used by 98% of GP practices and in 68% of NHS Trusts - that’s over 200,000 NHS staff each week.

For decades, the NHS has struggled with fragmented systems that slow everything down and leave patients waiting. We're changing that. We’re transforming how NHS staff triage and prioritise patient demand, cut the admin that eats into clinical time, and work as one team across the system.

We've spent eight years proving care doesn't always need to happen in an appointment. In the best triage practices today, 40% of patient demand is resolved without one. Now we're taking that model system-wide – using AI to automate the work that slows healthcare down, connecting every part of the NHS and building the platform on which the future of healthcare work gets done.




ABOUT THE ROLE

You’ll support and scale one of the most engaged clinical communities in the UK. Our users already talk to each other every day. They share what works, solve problems together and advocate for better ways of working. But those conversations are spread across WhatsApp groups and Facebook channels, with no platform or structure behind them. Our ambassador programme is also ready to be taken further.

As our Community Lead reporting to the Head of Marketing, you’ll shape how healthcare professionals connect, learn from one another and drive change across the NHS. You’ll turn organic momentum into a scalable community that measurably drives product adoption, peer-to-peer learning and brand trust.




THE CHALLENGES YOU’LL TAKE ON

 - Building strategic and large-scale communities: Shaping and delivering the long-term vision for our primary and secondary care communities, with community playing a clear role in driving product adoption and brand advocacy, not just engagement. You'll be actively running community initiatives, as well as setting the strategic direction.

 - Turning unstructured clinical conversations into scalable content: Creating repeatable ways to transform high-volume community conversations into user-led content, learning assets and programmes, using strong storytelling to make Accurx's value clear and compelling across the market.

 - Scaling advocacy through ambassadors and peer influence: Owning and evolving our ambassador programme that enable clinicians to influence their peers authentically, and aligning it closely with product and marketing priorities.

 - Owning our community platform and programmes: Choosing and implementing the right long-term platform to bring our community together, and deciding when existing tools are “good enough”. You’ll help Accurx invest in the right processes and operating models for a growing, multi-product, multi-care-setting community.




YOU SHOULD APPLY IF...

 - You have proven experience building and growing communities in the thousands, ideally in SaaS, tech or healthcare. This is essential for the role.

 - You've used community as a core driver of commercial growth, product adoption or brand advocacy, rather than it being primarily focused on support, account management or research.

 - You have a strong track record of designing, running or scaling ambassador programmes and super-user initiatives that drive peer-to-peer learning and influence.

 - You can point to clear examples of turning unstructured community conversations into scalable, user-led content, with strong written communication and storytelling skills.

 - You bring a data-informed and tool-savvy mindset, using signals, feedback and AI to scale insight capture and content without losing authenticity.

 - You're a strong cross-functional collaborator, comfortable partnering closely with Product, User Research, Implementation, Product Marketing and Events.




WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?

You'll be joining an established but fast-growing Tech for Good movement, where we're led by our Principles https://www.notion.so/accurx/How-we-work-Accurx-Principles-211640edee304821b4480d3f9c30e051 and our mission https://accurx.notion.site/Mission-and-Vision-fe9b12ff78bd4a7996682fc5c09c2d8e to Solve Healthcare Productivity.

 - £65,000 - £85,000 salary + £30,000 share options

 - Benefits to suit you: https://accurx.notion.site/Perks-Benefits-f1e9148b71be486791aa2c503e5d775a?pvs=74 adjust your healthcare cover, your pension or life insurance, whatever stage you're at in life

 - Flexible Working: We are an office first culture and ask that you're in our (dog-friendly) Shoreditch office 3 days a week, with core hours of 10am–4pm

 - Time off: You'll get 28 days of holiday (plus bank holidays) and up to 4 weeks to work from anywhere per year

 - Family matters: We offer enhanced parental leave, fertility support and parental loss support

 - We have our very own Chef! Free healthy breakfasts, snacks and lunches will be provided, with the occasional sweet treat!

Want to know more about the company or the hiring process? Check out our Careers page https://www.accurx.com/careers and Candidate hub https://accurx.notion.site/Candidate-Hub-764ee56d9cb74ff9a97a5104ed7f0707?pvs=4. Find us across social media: LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/12892742, and YouTube https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCrLJDyngP4p0G0JtgEoT66Q.

description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
 The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. 
 An overview of this role 
 As a Lead Investor Relations team member at GitLab, you'll help rebuild our investor relations (IR) processes and shape how we communicate GitLab's strategy and performance to the public markets. Working closely with our VP of Finance Strategy & Operations, Chief Financial Officer (CFO), and executive team, you'll be a senior individual contributor with broad ownership of investor communications and relationships. You'll connect insights from across the business to explain our technical products, evolving business models, and long-term investment thesis.
 What You’ll Do 
• Lead key workstreams of the quarterly earnings process, including messaging, scripts, questions and answers, data collection and synthesis, and conference call preparation; build repeatable processes with Finance, Legal, and executive leadership.
• Gather insights from research and development, Product, Sales, and other business leaders to explain GitLab's strategy, technical products, and business model transitions in investor communications and board materials.
• Own relationships with sell-side analysts and the investment community, monitor analyst models and consensus against our forecast, and flag gaps or risks to the head of IR and CFO.
• Prepare the Chief Executive Officer (CEO), CFO, and other executives for investor meetings, conferences, and roadshows; lead investor calls independently when executives aren't available, explaining how GitLab's business works and answering investor questions.
• Analyze peer and competitor earnings, Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) filings, and investor days; maintain benchmarking analyses and deliver quantitative and qualitative insights for executive and board discussions.
• Track GitLab's shareholder base and recommend investor targeting strategies to expand and maintain key ownership positions.
• Draft and review earnings decks, shareholder letters, fact sheets, and IR website content; partner with Finance, Legal, Communications, and Strategy to keep messaging consistent, accurate, and compliant with disclosure requirements, including Regulation Fair Disclosure (Regulation FD).
• Plan and deliver Investor Day with the head of IR to communicate GitLab's long-term story, alongside investor outreach, non-deal roadshows, and corporate access events.
 What You’ll Bring 
• Experience evaluating software businesses from a buy-side or sell-side investment perspective, gained through investing, equity research, investor relations, or a related field.
• Financial modeling, valuation, and quantitative analysis skills, with the ability to identify the business drivers that shape investor expectations.
• Experience producing or analyzing earnings materials and investor presentations, and explaining technical software products, evolving business models, and financial performance clearly in writing and conversation. You can work directly with senior executives and offer an informed point of view.
• Working knowledge of SEC reporting, Regulation FD, and public company disclosure practices.
• Proficiency with presentation and spreadsheet tools, experience with IR and market data platforms, and experience using artificial intelligence (AI) to improve workflows or a willingness to develop that capability.
• The ability to work independently and manage competing priorities in an all-remote, asynchronous-first environment, with an approach that reflects GitLab's values, especially transparency and efficiency.
• Nice to have: prior experience building an internal IR function.
 About the team 
 GitLab’s Investor Relations team drives the strategy and long-term market positioning of GitLab in the public financial markets. We are a small team, so each member has broad ownership and visibility across all aspects of IR.

description:
WHO ARE WE?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company.  We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.



Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:



 - Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

 - Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

 - Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register http://app.n8n.cloud/register.



We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

 

Your main goal will be to make n8n's Core Platform ready for the company's next stage of growth: more scalable, reliable, secure, and flexible as customer usage and technical complexity increase. You'll own the foundations that everything else, including our AI and agent capabilities, is built on.

 

To do so, here are your responsibilities:

 

OWN THE CORE PLATFORM STRATEGY & ROADMAP

 - Define and communicate the product strategy and roadmap for the Core Platform in partnership with Engineering and Product leadership.

 - Prioritize foundational investments based on customer impact, enterprise needs, technical risk, and engineering effort, and make trade-offs between near-term customer needs, technical debt, and long-term architecture explicit.

 - Lead product discovery for technically complex problems, engaging directly with enterprise customers and internal customer-facing teams.

 

SCALABILITY, RELIABILITY & EXECUTION ENGINE

 - Drive work on the scalability and reliability of n8n's execution engine, including areas like worker pools and distributed execution.

 - Improve the reliability of triggers and execution behaviour across complex deployment setups, from multi-main Cloud environments to self-hosted enterprise installations.

 - Shape a more secure and flexible approach to executing code within n8n.

 

MAJOR RELEASES & CROSS-ORG ALIGNMENT

 - Drive the planning and release of major or breaking platform versions, including migration strategy, stakeholder communication, and risk management.

 - Establish clear success measures and keep the squad accountable for outcomes, not only delivery.

 - Act as the bridge between the Core team and the wider org: Product, Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and Support, making platform trade-offs legible without oversimplifying them.

 - Treat internal product teams as customers of the platform: proactively mine their roadmaps for implicit platform requirements and turn cross-cutting needs into explicit Core Platform work before they become blockers.

 


REQUIREMENTS

 

Must-haves

 - Platform product experience: You have 5+ years in Product, with at least 2 to 3 years on platform, infrastructure, developer-facing, or backend/API products.

 - Technical depth: You're credible with senior engineers. You can reason about distributed systems, execution models, and reliability/scalability trade-offs, and hold your own in an architecture discussion. You're at home with non-functional requirements, where the details are the product.

 - Complex delivery track record: You've led cross-team technical initiatives with real delivery risk, ideally including a migration or breaking change.

 - Prioritization under ambiguity: You make trade-offs explicit and connect foundational or technical-debt work to customer and commercial outcomes.

 - Ownership and autonomy: You grab problems without being asked, fix what you see broken, and drive outcomes without waiting for direction.

 - Exceptional communication: You make complex platform topics understandable for technical and non-technical audiences alike.

 - Enterprise platform reality: You understand what running software in customer-controlled environments means, including self-hosted, air-gapped, and restricted deployments

 

Nice-to-haves

 - Hands-on ability: You can read code or prototype, even if you're not shipping it.

 - Enterprise exposure: You've worked with B2B SaaS requirements like security, compliance, or deployment complexity.

 - Security partnership: You're comfortable working with security teams on code execution, isolation, or compliance topics.

 - Domain familiarity: You know workflow automation, orchestration, or open-source / developer-community products.

 - Writing culture: You default to writing things down to create clarity and alignment.

 Join us on our mission to make a better world of work. 
 Culture Amp is the world’s leading employee experience platform, revolutionizing how 25 million employees across more than 6,000 companies create a better world of work. Culture Amp empowers companies of all sizes and industries to transform employee engagement, drive performance management, and develop high-performing teams. Powered by people science and the most comprehensive employee dataset in the world, the most innovative companies including Canva, On, Asana, Dolby, McDonalds and Nasdaq depend on Culture Amp every day.
 Culture Amp is backed by leading venture capital funds and has offices in the US, UK, Germany and Australia. Culture Amp has been recognized as one of the world’s top private cloud companies by Forbes and most innovative companies by Fast Company.
 For more information visit cultureamp.com .
 How you can help make a better world of work 
 We're looking for a Director, Commercial Sales to lead our Commercial (Mid-Market) segment sales team, working with customers and prospects up to 1,000 employees. As a first line leader, you'll set the strategy and operating rhythm for our team of London and Berlin-based Account Executives and Account Managers, while staying close enough to the field to coach the deals that matter. 
 This is a genuine team-building role: You will build the team, not just carry a number. Recruit, develop, and retain sellers who become better sellers and leaders. You'll also be the sales half of a close partnership with your Customer Experience counterpart, working together so wins in the sales cycle turn into long-term customer success.
 As part of this team of amazing humans,
 You will: 
• Coach and develop your Account Executives and Account Managers: through 1:1 feedback, performance reviews, and by getting into deals alongside them when it matters most
• Recruit, hire, onboard, and develop AEs and AMs who who bring both the right skills and the right values to the team
• Be the sales half of a true partnership with your CX Director counterpart in our Pod Model, aligned on strategy, accountable together for the customer's experience across the full lifecycle\Set the vision for your team and translate it into a strategy that gets you to quota, sustainably, quarter over quarter
• Own the rhythm that makes the rest possible: forecasting that leadership can trust, pipeline that's actually worked, and performance tracking that surfaces problems early
 You have: 
• A genuine track record of building teams, not just managing headcount, but recruiting, developing, and retaining people who grow into better sellers and leaders under you
• 3+ years leading a sales team, ideally in B2B SaaS
• Real fluency with the mechanics: Salesforce, Gong, forecasting discipline, and a working command of MEDDPICC or an equivalent qualification framework
• The instinct and credibility to work well across functions, especially with Customer Experience and SDR, where influence matters more than authority
• Experience growing revenue in more than one way, landing new logos and expanding current customers, because at Culture Amp, both matter to the number
 You are: 
• Driven by your team's success as much as your own, you lead because you want to build something, not just hit a number
• A natural collaborator: you'd rather build the plan with your CX partner than hand them a plan you already made
• Drawn to Culture Amp's mission because you've felt the difference a great workplace makes, and you want to help build more of them
 Perks & Benefits 
 At Culture Amp, our people are at the heart of our success. We offer competitive pay and a total rewards package designed to support you at work and in life. This includes:
• Equity through our Employee Share Option Program, so you can share in our long-term success
• Learning programs and coaching to help you thrive and grow
• Quarterly refresh days, an extended end-of-year break and a monthly allowance to support your wellbeing and lifestyle
• Inclusive parental leave from day one
• A MacBook and budget to set up your home workspace, enabling flexibility
• Five annual social impact days to to give back to causes that matter to you
• Medical insurance coverage for you and your family (Available for US & UK only)
 Our rewards are designed to support different needs and life stages, recognising that what matters most can vary from person to person.
 Research shows that candidates from underrepresented backgrounds may hesitate to apply if they don’t meet every requirement, but your unique experience matters. If you’re interested in joining us, we strongly encourage you to apply and help us build a more diverse and impactful team.

 About Fivetran 
 Fivetran is the global leader in automated data movement, helping organizations centralize data from hundreds of sources into the destinations that power their analytics and AI. Our Databases product area is core to that mission: we build the connectors and underlying engine that reliably, securely, and efficiently move data out of the systems enterprises run their business on, and into the modern destinations they analyze it in. 
 About the Role

title: Design Operations Manager
description:
ABOUT US

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

 - We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

 - We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

 - We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

The role

At Legora, we're building the category-defining AI product for legal work. Our design team is growing fast across Stockholm, London and New York.

Design is being rebuilt for the AI era: new tools, new workflows, humans and agents building together, and a higher bar on both speed and craft. The Design Operations Manager is the operator who makes that change land at Legora. You will partner with design and product leadership to structure the org, set the operating rhythms and lead the cross-functional initiatives that free designers to spend their time on product and craft.

You own org structure, planning, prioritisation and the systems that keep everything moving. Your job is to make sure the right things happen at the right time, across every team.

You will report to the Head of Design. This is a hands-on senior role: you design the systems and you run them.

This position can be based in Stockholm, NYC, or London.


What you will be doing

 - Keep a live, accurate map of how design is organised against what it needs to deliver. Flag structural gaps before they show up as missed deadlines or duplicated work, and make sure every headcount decision has a clear rationale tied to what the team actually needs.

 - Own how design hires. Tie every open role to a named strategic priority before it is approved, agree the archetype and level before the loop starts, run the process end to end with our Talent team, and own onboarding and offboarding for designers.

 - Put design on a stable planning cadence and make reviews produce decisions and unblock work. Give design clear goals and bets that ladder to company-wide OKRs, and when priorities shift, make the tradeoffs visible so they get made on purpose.

 - Be the DRI for cross-team programmes and move them from vague problem to shipped outcome on a visible timeline. Product, Engineering and PMM should be able to see where design work stands at any point without asking.

 - Help move the team to more agentic ways of working and keep documentation and process current as they change. Track adoption and impact so the org can tell what is working from what is still an experiment.

 - Make sure a written quality bar exists for design work and gets applied consistently, and build the reporting that shows, cycle over cycle, whether speed gains are costing us quality, so that tradeoff gets decided early.


Who you are

 - 4–6+ years of experience running operations, programmes or a chief-of-staff function inside a product or design organisation, ideally through a period of rapid growth.

 - A track record of building org structures, planning cadences and hiring processes from scratch, and the judgment to know which ones earn their keep.

 - A systems thinker who is comfortable with ambiguity: you see the structural gap before it becomes a missed deadline, and you close gaps that are technically someone else's problem.

 - Fluent in how modern product teams build, and an early adopter of AI-native and agentic ways of working who brings others along.

 - A strong communicator who makes tradeoffs legible and gets product, engineering and leadership behind a decision.

 - Line management experience is a plus. Caring about design, and the people who do it, is required.

Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer

At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

As an Senior Account Executive, Upmarket [French], you'll be one of the key contributors to establishing Vanta's footprint in this market, converting both outbound and inbound pipeline into long-term customers and helping define how we sell to upmarket companies across the region.

 - Proven experience self-sourcing pipeline through outbound prospecting and cold calling into Upmarket accounts

 - Strong background in B2B SaaS, with experience across EMEA and Upmarket segments

We are on a mission to build machines that understand the world and make them safely accessible to all. Data quality is foundational to this process. Machines (or Large Language Models to be exact) learn in similar ways to humans - by way of feedback. By labelling, ranking, auditing, and correcting text output, you will improve Large Language Model’s performance for iterations to come, thus having a lasting impact on Cohere’s tech.


Cohere seeks dynamic and dedicated Data Annotators with exceptional Modern Standard German Writing, Translation, and Data Manipulation skill.



Please Note: This is a part-time independent contractor position available within Canada. We seek candidates who are able to commit to 16 hours per week minimum at a 30 CAD/hour contract rate. This role is BYOD 💻 - Bring Your Own Device (laptop). Remote work within Canada. 12 months contract. Performance incentives included!



As a Data Annotation Specialist, you will:

 - Label and Rank: Accurately label and rank machine learning data with advanced proficiency in German, ensuring data integrity and quality.

 - Audit and Correct: Scrutinize and rectify any inaccuracies in language data (may include text, image, JSON, TSV/CSV, Markdown), maintaining the highest standard of data accuracy.

 - Reading and Text-Based Tasks: Efficiently complete reading and text-based assignments, with high attention to detail.

 - Preference-Based Tasks: Evaluate and complete tasks, assessing which responses in German best conform to project guidelines.

 - Recommend Optimizations: Identify and suggest opportunities for improving data quality and model performance in German language tasks.

 - Provide Feedback: Collaborate and communicate effectively, providing feedback to cross-functional team members, particularly on German language-related matters.

 - Detail-Oriented Execution: Maintain meticulous attention to detail while performing repetitive and precise tasks, particularly when working with language data.



You may be a good fit if you have:

 - Language Proficiency: Native or near-native proficiency in German; excellent command over English.

 - Expert reading and writing skills - which you are ready to prove on our written test.

 - Basic familiarity with JSON/TSV/CSV/Markdown data manipulation.

 - Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy - you’re the type to proofread all of your emails!

 - High tolerance for repetitive and monotonous work.

 - Ability to follow complex instructions, navigate ambiguity and work independently.

 - Superb sense of urgency and time management.

 - Curiosity about technology and a knack for tackling problems in creative ways.

 - A reliable laptop.



The Candidate Journey:
Initial Screening - Once you have submitted your application our Talent Team will review your resume and writing samples.
Virtual Annotation Test -  This assignment will test your written skill through various language-based tasks, such as a a writing sample, interacting with a chat bot, and more.
Video Screen - If selected to move forward, you will have a short video call with a member of our Operations Team!
Offer - Independent Contractor Agreement


As an independent contractor, you maintain control over how you complete your work and may work with multiple clients simultaneously, although we ask you to declare if any of these are with a direct competitor of Cohere and maintain IP confidentiality of the Cohere project. Independent contractors are not eligible for health benefits or other benefits provided to employees. Compensation for services is provided to contractors by contractors invoicing for services provided pursuant to the terms of our agreement with the contractor.

It is important to understand that as an independent contractor, continuous work is not guaranteed. The client-contractor relationship is fundamentally project-based, meaning engagements may be temporary, periodic, or intermittent based on our organizational needs and project availability. As an independent contractor, you should anticipate fluctuations in workflow and therefore compensation for services when Cohere does not require as many hours of services in a week.

Prospective candidates, please be advised: this role involves working with human generated and model generated tasks that may involve exposure to not safe for work (NSFW) text content as part of data annotation tasks, including explicit, offensive, or other inappropriate material.

Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.



Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:



 - Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

 - Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

 - Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register http://app.n8n.cloud/register.



We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.



Your main goal will be to make it simple and reliable for customers to buy, pay for, and grow their use of n8n. You'll own the foundations of how n8n's commercial system works: licensing and entitlements, customer accounts, and the metering and billing platform for both Cloud and Enterprise. Today these live across several teams and two billing stacks; you'll bring them into one stable home that the rest of the company builds on.



This is a foundations role. You build the system that pricing and packaging decisions run on, rather than running price experiments yourself. To do so, here are your core responsibilities:



OWN THE LICENSING & BILLING STRATEGY & ROADMAP

 - Define and communicate the product strategy and roadmap for Licensing & Billing in partnership with Engineering, Product leadership, Finance, and go-to-market.

 - Prioritize foundational investments based on revenue integrity, enterprise needs, data correctness, and engineering effort, and make trade-offs explicit.

 - Lead discovery with enterprise customers, Sales, Customer Success, Finance, and RevOps to understand how n8n is bought, renewed, and grown today, and where that breaks.



LICENSING, ENTITLEMENTS & ACCOUNTS

 - Own the license server and entitlement model: issuance, renewal, and validation across Cloud, self-hosted, air-gapped, and OEM deployments, with one source of truth for which plan or deal grants which features.

 - Introduce "account" as a first-class product primitive (accounts, purchases, license keys, activations) and expose it as the API contract our customer-facing console and multi-instance management are built on.

 - Productize the deal-to-entitlement flow so a closed deal in Salesforce creates or updates entitlements without manual steps.



METERING & BILLING PLATFORM

 - Own usage metering and billing for Cloud and Enterprise, including subscription billing: what counts as a billable execution, quota consumption, and overage charging.

 - Lead the migration off Paddle Classic and unify Cloud and Enterprise billing into one platform.

 - Build the mechanics for usage-based enterprise billing and reliable overage charging.



CROSS-ORG ALIGNMENT

 - Make the architecture and mechanism decisions (entitlement model, billing platform, enterprise invoicing path) and align closely with Finance and go-to-market on each of them. Every decision here touches money; you bring people along rather than inform them afterwards.

 - Hold clear boundaries with adjacent teams: the customer console, execution limits, and access control live elsewhere; you own the data and mechanics they rely on.

 - Establish clear success measures and keep the squad accountable for outcomes, not only delivery.




REQUIREMENTS



Must-haves

 - Billing or licensing product experience: You have 6+ years in Product, with a substantial part spent owning a billing, licensing, entitlement, or quote-to-cash system at a B2B SaaS company.

 - Shipped through Finance and RevOps: You've driven a cross-functional systems change where Finance, Sales Ops, and Engineering all had a say, and you got it live.

 - Systems and data-model depth: You can design or critique an entity model, reason about reconciliation and idempotency in a sync, read an API contract, and explain why two systems reading the same events end up with different numbers.

 - Attention to detail: You know that if the billing data is wrong, everything built on it inherits the error, and you sequence work accordingly.

 - Prioritization under ambiguity: You make trade-offs explicit and connect foundational or data-quality work to commercial outcomes.

 - Ownership and autonomy: You grab problems without being asked, fix what you see broken, and drive outcomes without waiting for direction.

 - Exceptional communication: You're equally at home with engineers, the Finance team, and Sales, and you can make billing trade-offs legible to all of them.

 - Enterprise reality: You understand what self-hosted, air-gapped, and OEM deployments mean for licensing and metering.



Nice-to-haves

 - Usage-based billing: You've owned usage-based or hybrid (subscription plus usage) billing.

 - Vendor billing stacks: You've worked hands-on with Paddle, Stripe, Chargebee, Zuora or similar, and know where they break at enterprise contract volume.

 - Migration experience: You've run a billing-provider migration.

 - Hands-on ability: You can read code, query data, or prototype, even if you're not shipping it.

 - CRM integration: You've worked on Salesforce or CRM-to-billing integrations.

 - Domain familiarity: You know workflow automation, agent orchestration, or open-source / developer-community pro

description:
Our Global Structure 
Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
 Join us in shaping the experience millions of customers worldwide land on every time they open DoorDash, Wolt or Deliveroo.
 You’ll be embedded in our global Discovery team, part of the Core Consumer organisation, working side by side with US product managers on a shared global tech stack. Together, we own how customers search, explore and discover everything we have to offer, from their favourite local spot to something they didn’t know they wanted.
 Your roadmap will be a mix of consumer problems felt most in EMEA but worth solving globally, global capabilities we’re accelerating into EMEA, and EMEA-specific problems where speed matters.
 We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager who loves consumer products end to end, from spotting the customer problem to shaping the experience, shipping it and measuring the impact.
 What You'll Be Doing 
• Own vision and strategy: Define and drive the roadmap and OKRs for your area of discovery, from early problem discovery through to scaled impact.
• Build end-to-end experiences: Shape how customers find everything on DoorDash, Wolt and Deliveroo, partnering closely with Design and Ux Research and holding a high bar on the details.
• Shape AI-powered discovery: Work with Engineering, Data Science and ML on ranking, personalisation and recommendations, and define how GenAI and agentic experiences come to life for customers.
• Customer first, business-aware: Start with what’s right for the customer, and find solutions that work for the business too, so wins don’t come at the customer’s expense.
• Build for scale: Understand customer problems across EMEA markets and beyond, spot the patterns, and build solutions that scale globally rather than one-off fixes.
• Combine data with strong judgment: Lead experiment-driven development, make clear ship decisions, and know when to optimise incrementally versus rethink an approach entirely.
• Align stakeholder: Communicate strategy, trade-offs and learnings clearly to build conviction across the wider team and senior leadership.
 What You'll Need to Thrive
 Essential Requirements 
• Customer-first thinking: You start with the customer, always. You seek out customer insight, empathise deeply with real needs and frustrations, and spot opportunities others miss.
• Consumer product ownership: A proven track record of delivering measurable outcomes on B2C, consumer-facing products at scale.
• End-to-end generalist: You care as much about the UX and UI customers see as about the systems underneath: the data, ML models and platform capabilities that power the experience. You grasp technical concepts quickly and partner effectively with Engineering and ML.
• Analytical and commercial rigour: Strong quantitative skills, comfort with experimentation, and sound business instincts to make consequential calls.
• High-velocity execution: Demonstrated ownership of shipping at pace, with a sharp eye for detail.
• Stakeholder leadership: You build trust with people whose priorities differ from yours, and align senior stakeholders on difficult trade-offs: collaborative, with a clear point of view.
• Resilience in ambiguity: You thrive in a high-ownership environment where the problems are big and the industry is changing fast.
 Nice to Have 
• Experience with discovery, homepage, feed, ranking or recommendation products.
• Hands-on experience building GenAI or LLM-powered consumer experiences.
• Experience in a multi-sided marketplace or a global/regional product setup.
 Why Join Us? 
 At Deliveroo, Wolt and DoorDash, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving. We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:
• Solve meaningful problems at real scale: Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.
• See your impact, fast: Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.
• Grow through challenge and ownership: Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

title: Principal Product Manager Agents and Context - Elasticsearch
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
 What is The Role 
 Elastic, the Search AI Company, is looking for a Principal Product Manager to guide the vision, strategy, and execution for the Elastic Agent Builder. As organizations shift from traditional data retrieval to autonomous, agentic workflows, the Agent Builder serves as the critical context layer that enables users to make Agents faster, lower cost, and more accurate. In this high-impact role, you will be responsible for defining how enterprises build, manage, and scale context for AI agents. You will work at the cutting edge of the AI ecosystem, working with senior leadership and partnering with hyperscalers and evangelizing our solutions to a global community of AI developers.
 What You Will Be Doing 
• Work directly with enterprise customers, sales teams, and solution architects to understand requirements, negotiate priorities, clarify product needs 
• Build, socialize and align a roadmap for core context engineering capabilities built on top of Elastic powered retrieval and relevance for AI Agents 
• Deeply understand the AI Agent market, major players, trends and how it may impact our strategy 
• Work directly data science and engineering to build out the strategy for benchmarking and evaluations of agent capabilities 
• Work with design to build user experiences that address gaps in how agents show and refine context as they work
• Be the product expert and evangelize capabilities for Agent Builder through content like blog posts and open source projects 
• Work with a broad ecosystem of AI partners including cloud service providers (Google, Amazon, Microsoft) and community developers 
 What You Bring 
• Extensive Experience: 10+ years of experience in product management or solution delivery for technical, cloud infrastructure, or platform products. A consistent record of leading sophisticated, data-intensive products from inception through launch and iterative growth.
• AI and ML Fluency: Deep technical understanding of the AI/ML landscape, including LLMs, RAG architectures, vector databases, and context engineering. You are comfortable working closely with engineers and data scientists to solve intricate technical challenges. 
• Bias to action: You are able to move fast and quickly learn from experiments and tests. You utilize AI tools to help accelerate your processes and bring clarity to your decisions. 
• Leadership and Influence: Demonstrated ability to lead across a matrixed organization, align multiple stakeholders toward a common vision, and drive execution in a fast-paced, remote-first environment. 
• Communication Excellence: Outstanding spoken and written communication skills. You can distill complex engineering details into compelling narratives for both technical and non-technical audiences, including executive leadership. 
• Customer Obsession: A passion for industry trends and a commitment to solving real-world customer problems. You are an advocate for the developer persona and are dedicated to building products that empower users to innovate.
 Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People 
 As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.
 We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.
• Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary
• Health coverage for you and your family in many locations
• Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles
• Generous number of vacation days each year
• Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service
• Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love
• Embracing parenthood with minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave
 Different people approach problems differently. We need that. description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required.
