ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

title: Lead Product Manager
description:
WHY FACULTY? 


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here https://faculty.ai/impact.



We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.



Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.



AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.




ABOUT THE ROLE



In Faculty’s Applied AI group, we partner with ambitious organisations across private and public sectors to help them reinvent how they work, compete and serve people with AI. We bring them our extensive expertise in using AI in real-world situations and a track record of delivering serious impact.

Product managers in Applied AI provide strategic leadership for Faculty’s clients, guiding stakeholders through discovery, decision-making and execution. We help our clients to achieve the greatest impact for their organisations with the very latest AI advancements and we teach bleeding-edge product development practices.

As a Lead Product Manager at Faculty, you’ll take on large strategic client engagements, leading teams that include top-flight Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers and Product Designers, among others. You’ll help to drive the strategic direction of high-impact AI products for our clients, balancing complex technical considerations and user needs to achieve real commercial outcomes.




WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:



 - Building and shipping impactful products that realise the potential of frontier AI.

 - Acting as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders at big-name clients on their product and AI strategies.

 - Leading discovery to identify the right problems to solve, using clear hypotheses and success measures to decide what gets built.

 - Keeping teams focused on outcomes, not just outputs by defining clear goals, shaping prioritisation and articulating trade-offs.

 - Embedding innovation culture among our clients, guiding and inspiring them.

 - Collaborating with your cross-functional teammates including Data Scientists, Engineers, Product Designers and Delivery to set the quality bar for AI products, including the eval strategy to ensure they continue to work as intended.

 - Building lasting product development capability in client organisations, from the habits of individual teams to the product operating model as a whole.

 - Advising clients on how AI can accelerate and improve their product development lifecycle, from research and discovery through to delivery and measurement.

 - Contributing to Faculty's product practice through developing case studies, thought leadership and repeatable methods that scale across clients.

 - Partnering with Delivery leads on planning and execution, including supporting business development and fostering strong client relationships.

 - Coaching and developing other product managers.




WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR:



 - You have substantial experience conceiving, building and launching products at scale, including at least 2 years in a product leadership role.

 - You’ve routinely worked directly with C-suite or equivalent senior leaders at significant, successful organisations.

 - Exceptional commercial acumen: you've made the case for new products or services - whether for revenue, savings or public benefit - and defended it with senior budget holders.

 - You relish unstructured problems and can turn them into clear plans that teams can execute.

 - You can comfortably converse with experts in how AI models are created, evaluated and operationalised.

 - You have demonstrable experience in rolling out cutting-edge AI-accelerated product development processes.

 - You have a clear track record of mentoring team members and fostering a collaborative, ambitious culture.

 - You show forward-thinking initiative to spot new client opportunities, solve ambiguous problems, and build enduring organisational value.




DESIRABLE EXPERIENCE



 - You have meaningful professional services or consulting experience, ideally with large enterprises.

 - You’ve held a product leadership position in at least one scaled-up, fast-moving product-led organisation, owning significant scope and achieving meaningful impact.

 - You're an active voice in the product community, speaking at conferences or contributing to panels and publications.
   
   




OUR RECRUITMENT ETHOS




We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.



If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

 - Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

To do so, you’ll design and lead acquisition, activation, and expansion programs across all channels, backed by strong analytics, experimentation, and cross-functional collaboration.




PIPELINE CREATION & OWNERSHIP

 - Drive pipeline creation targets across paid media, SEO, content, events, ABM, and partner/community co-marketing

 - Instrument lifecycle journeys with onboarding, trial nurturing, and PQL warming


TEAM LEADERSHIP & OPERATING RHYTHM

TECH STACK & PERFORMANCE MANAGEMENT

 - Own the demand tech stack (HubSpot/Marketo, Segment, Clearbit/6sense, enrichment/routing) in collaboration with RevOps

 - Establish guardrails for CAC payback, shutoff rules, and ROI discipline

 - Forecast and report on performance across ROI, velocity, coverage, and funnel health

title: Head of Field Sales
description:
Hello. We’re Teya.

Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better.

They are the cafés, restaurants, salons, shops and entrepreneurs that bring character to our high streets, create jobs and keep communities moving. Yet for too long, financial services has made life harder for them - with clunky tools, poor support and complexity that gets in the way of running a business.

Teya exists to change that.

We’re building a financial platform for local businesses across Europe - one built around simple tools, thoughtful design and real human support. Our Members rely on us to help them run their business with confidence, and that responsibility shapes the way we work.

We move fast. We care about quality. We stay close to the detail. And we believe great performance and genuine hospitality should go hand in hand.

If you want to build meaningful products, solve real problems and make a genuine difference for local businesses, we’d love to hear from you




ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for an exceptional Head of Field Sales to lead and scale our UK Field Sales organisation. This is a significant leadership opportunity at an exciting stage of Teya's growth.

Today, our Field Sales team consists of approximately 25 people across seven regions. Our ambition is to grow to around 80 sellers in 2027, building a high-performing, commercially disciplined sales organisation that can scale sustainably. You'll take full ownership of the channel's performance, from customer acquisition and revenue growth to sales productivity, profitability and the development of our people.

A central part of your mandate will be scaling Teya Cities, our new approach to bringing together field sales, inside sales, local marketing and customer support within defined local markets. You'll help establish a repeatable model for entering new cities, building strong local teams and delivering sustainable commercial growth.

This isn't a role for someone who wants to manage from behind a desk. We're looking for a leader who combines strategic thinking with a hands-on approach, who understands what great field sales execution looks like and knows how to build the teams, systems and culture to deliver it. You'll be a member of the UK Leadership Team, reporting directly to our UK General Manager, and will play an important role in shaping the future of our UK business.





WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

Lead commercial performance

 - Take full accountability for the performance of our UK Field Sales channel, including new customer acquisition, revenue, sales volumes and profitability.

 - Establish clear commercial targets and performance expectations across regions, teams and individual sellers.

 - Drive improvements in sales productivity, conversion, pricing discipline and unit economics.

 - Build a high-performance culture grounded in accountability, coaching and consistent execution.

Build and scale our Field Sales organisation

 - Lead the expansion of our field sales presence across the UK, building the teams and capabilities needed to support our growth ambitions.

 - Play a leading role in scaling Teya Cities, establishing a repeatable and commercially sustainable model for launching and growing local markets.

 - Partner closely with Inside Sales, Marketing, Customer Relations and GTM Enablement to deliver a joined-up approach to customer acquisition.

 - Use commercial performance data to identify opportunities, optimise territories and inform investment decisions.

Develop exceptional sales teams and leaders

 - Build a strong leadership team capable of managing, coaching and developing high-performing field sales agents.

 - Work closely with the People team to strengthen recruitment, onboarding and sales capability development.

 - Establish clear expectations for new-starter productivity, ongoing performance and career progression.

 - Create a culture where great performance is recognised, underperformance is addressed and people are supported to reach their potential.

Drive operational excellence

 - Establish effective management routines, including performance reviews, pipeline management, forecasting, coaching and field visits.

 - Ensure our sales teams make effective use of CRM systems, sales tools and performance data.

 - Translate commercial strategy into clear priorities and measurable outcomes for teams across the country.

 - Work with central Product, Pricing and Sales Platform teams to continuously improve our proposition and the effectiveness of our sales organisation.

 - Maintain a strong presence in the field, staying close to our customers, managers and sales agents.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're looking for a proven commercial leader who has successfully built, led and scaled high-performing field sales organisations.
You'll bring:

 - Significant field sales leadership experience, ideally eight or more years, including experience leading managers and geographically distributed sales teams.

 - A strong track record of scaling field sales operations, ideally within payments, fintech, telecommunications, utilities or another high-volume B2B environment.

 - Experience selling to small and medium-sized businesses, with a strong understanding of face-to-face customer acquisition.

 - Demonstrable success in improving sales productivity, commercial performance and unit economics.

 - Experience building and developing sales leadership teams, including hiring, onboarding, coaching and performance management at scale.

 - Strong commercial and analytical judgement, with the ability to translate data into decisions and measurable results.

 - Experience establishing scalable sales processes, operating rhythms and performance management frameworks.

 - The ability to work effectively across functions and influence senior stakeholders.


Beyond your experience, we're looking for someone who leads from the front. You're ambitious, commercially sharp and comfortable taking ownership.

description:
🚀 About WRITER

WRITER is the AI platform built for the world’s most ambitious marketing and revenue teams, bringing the frontier of AI to the people who drive enterprise growth. With WRITER, autonomous agents work across the buyer journey, continuously executing on market signals and enterprise intelligence to grow revenue faster. Every agent action and asset is grounded in trust, built on an Enterprise Brain that unites brand, product, and company knowledge with fiduciary-grade governance and compliance. 



Fortune 500 companies are transforming how they go to market with WRITER, including 3 of the top 5 US banks, 2 of the 5 largest global CPG conglomerates, and 4 of the top 5 US healthcare insurers. Founded in 2020, WRITER is backed by investors including Insight Partners, ICONIQ, Radical Ventures, Premji Invest, Balderton, B Capital, Salesforce Ventures, Adobe Ventures, Accenture, Citi Ventures, IBM Ventures, WndrCo, and others. Learn more at WRITER.com http://WRITER.com.



📐 About the role

Join WRITER's sales team as a strategic account executive and help shape the future of work. You'll empower global enterprises (8,000+ employees) to transform their operations through our cutting-edge AI agent platform, enabling organizations to deploy AI at scale and unlock unprecedented productivity. This isn't just about hitting quota – it's about becoming a trusted advisor to some of the world's most influential companies as they navigate their AI transformation journey.

This role is perfect for high performers who thrive in fast-paced, intellectually stimulating environments where you have the autonomy to drive results and build lasting relationships with both clients and teammates. If you're energized by meaningful work, the opportunity to make a real impact, and the challenge of selling category-defining technology, we want to hear from you. You'll be selling solutions that fundamentally change how enterprises operate, working with executive buyers who are making multi-million dollar, multi-year commitments to AI transformation.

This is a hybrid role based out of our London hub. You'll be reporting to our regional vice president.



🦸🏻‍♀️ What you need

 - 7-10+ years of quota-carrying strategic SaaS sales experience with a proven track record of meeting or exceeding annual quotas in complex, value-based sales motions targeting Fortune 500 and Global 2000 financial services accounts

 - Deep understanding of the UK and European financial services landscape — banking, asset management, insurance, and fintech — including its regulatory environment, buying cycles, and communication standards

 - Demonstrated expertise in managing sophisticated enterprise sales cycles with multiple stakeholders, navigating procurement and security processes, and orchestrating cross-functional resources to drive deals through technical evaluations and executive approvals

 - Executive presence and communication skills that allow you to credibly engage with C-suite buyers (CIOs, CDOs, CTOs, COOs), translate complex technical concepts into business value, and build authentic relationships based on trust and strategic insight

 - Strong consultative selling skills with the ability to conduct discovery that uncovers underlying business challenges, connects AI capabilities to measurable outcomes, and creates urgency around transformation initiatives in regulated industries

 - Experience in outbound prospecting, account mapping, and territory planning, with a hunter mentality that drives you to consistently create new opportunities rather than waiting for inbound leads

 - Comfort with ambiguity and a bias for ownership — you thrive in fast-paced environments where you're expected to figure things out, make decisions with incomplete information, and drive your own success with minimal oversight

 - Deep alignment with WRITER's values: you naturally Connect across functions and build collaborative relationships, you Challenge the status quo and aren't afraid to have difficult conversations, and you Own your outcomes with accountability and a commitment to long-term impact



⭐️ Is this you?

 - You've sold into financial services institutions and understand what it takes to navigate complex, regulated buying environments — from security and compliance reviews to board-level approvals

 - You're a closer who has consistently carried and exceeded seven-figure quotas, and you can point to deals where you created the opportunity from scratch rather than working an inbound lead

 - You think like a consultant but sell like a hunter — your discovery uncovers pain buyers didn't know they had, and your storytelling connects AI to outcomes that matter to a CIO and a CFO alike

 - You understand the UK FS market specifically — the players, the regulators, the buying rhythms — and you have or can build a network that opens doors

 - You're comfortable in the boardroom and the back office — equally credible presenting an AI transformation vision to an exec team and working through the technical and procurement details with the people who sign off

 - You move fast, own your number, and don't wait to be told what to do next



Preferred skills

 - Existing network and relationships within UK or European financial services institutions

 - Background in management consulting, particularly with FS clients

 - Experience selling AI, data, or enterprise platform deals into regulated industries

 - Familiarity with the compliance, security, and governance requirements that shape FS buying decisions

 - Experience supporting or leading large-scale rollouts or change management programs

 - Strong storytelling and presentation skills for executive audiences



🍩 Benefits & perks (UK full-time employees):

 - Generous PTO, plus company holidays

 - Comprehensive medical and dental insurance

 - Paid parental leave for all parents (16 weeks)

 - Fertility and family planning support

 - Early-detection cancer testing through Galleri

title: Partner Sales Manager
description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.
 About Us 
 Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.
 Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.
 Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.
 As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.
 During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.
 About the Role 
 We’re looking for a Partner Sales Manager to drive North American sales execution with Snowflake and accelerate co-selling and go-to-market activities across our ecosystem.
 This is a full-time remote position in the US. 
 What You’ll Do 
• Build productive North American sales relationships with Snowflake
• Drive sales enablement & engagement with Snowflake & our sellers to grow pipeline and exceed revenue and consumption goals
• Drive joint sales & marketing plays to generate pipeline and closed revenue for Fivetran & dbt Labs
• Collaborate internally at Fivetran and dbt Labs with product, sales, and marketing functions to accelerate revenue impact for Fivetran and dbt through Snowflake
 Skills We’re Looking For 
• 5–8 years of experience as a partner sales or partner development manager, with a proven ability to build mutual success with large data and AI platform partners
• Experience partnering with & navigating hyperscaler/platform partner sales and marketing organizations
• Demonstrated ability to meet and exceed pipeline/revenue quotas through partners
• Well-developed commercial mindset with the ability to create partner-sourced pipeline
• Excellent verbal, written, and in-person communication skills to interact with internal and external sales leadership as well as Account Executives
• Ability to operate in a highly accountable, fast-paced work environment with integrity
• Passion for being an inclusive, collaborative teammate focused on business outcomes
 Bonus Skills​ 
• An existing Snowflake network of sellers, solutions architects, and leaders
• Track record of success in sales and alliances at technology companies; startup experience preferred, but not required
• The ability to articulate a clear strategy for growing and supporting your partner
• Ability to adapt quickly as product and platform partner strategies evolve
• Demonstrated expertise in data analytics, ETL, BI, and/or open-source software
 This position qualifies for Fivetran’s incentive plan, and it’s common for employees in this role to achieve the total on-target earnings.

 $168,587 — $202,313 USD 
 Perks and Benefits 
• 100% employer-paid medical insurance * 
• Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off.
• RSU stock grants*
• Professional development and training opportunities
• Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team-building activities
• Monthly cell phone stipend
• Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents.

 As an Enterprise Account Executive (f/m/d) for UKI , you’ll drive Contentful’s growth by spearheading the end-to-end sales process from prospecting to close. title: Federal Account Executive - USPS
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
 Elastic is seeking a dynamic Federal Account Executive . As an integral part of our growth strategy, you will play a key role in driving our expansion and net-new revenue within the United States Postal Service (USPS) and related logistics, operational, and civilian stakeholder ecosystems. This is an opportunity for a high-performing public sector sales professional passionate about empowering large-scale civilian operations through groundbreaking AI-powered search, analytics, and security technology, enabling them to unlock the full potential of massive, distributed mission data.

 Joining our GEO of the Year-winning Public Sector team, Elastic is seeking a results-oriented Federal Account Executive to lead and scale our footprint across the United States Postal Service (USPS) —one of the largest, most technologically complex, and highly distributed enterprise logistics networks in the world.

title: Account Executive
description:
About Flexport: 
 At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. 
 The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.
 The opportunity: 
 The Sales team at Flexport is critical to our mission, fostering deep, lasting relationships that drive client success and accelerate global trade. As an Account Executive, you own some of Flexport's most complex and highest-opportunity client relationships in North America. Your accounts span multiple shipping modes and trade lanes — ocean, air, trucking, customs — and require genuine supply chain expertise to navigate well. You don't just manage these relationships; you shape them. You bring a strategic point of view to every client engagement, lead business reviews that drive meaningful decisions, and connect the dots across Flexport's full product suite to unlock growth. You operate with full autonomy, deliver against a high bar on revenue and retention, and are increasingly the person junior teammates turn to when they need guidance.
 You will: 
 - Own end-to-end success for a portfolio of complex, multi-modal Flexport accounts in North America — including accounts with significant revenue potential and high operational intensity.
 - Lead RFP bids and renewals end-to-end
 - Serve as a true strategic partner to clients, going deep on their supply chain operations to identify where Flexport can unlock efficiency, reduce cost, or introduce new capabilities.
 - Lead high-impact business reviews (QBRs/MBRs) that go beyond reporting — you bring market context, multi-modal insights, and tailored recommendations that shift how clients think about their supply chain.
 - Drive cross-sell and upsell across Flexport's full product suite, consistently meeting or exceeding revenue and retention targets.
 - Collaborate with Operations, Pricing, Procurement, Product, and Sales on solutions that require internal alignment and creative problem-solving.
 - Help mentor and coach Account Executive I and Account Executive II teammates — sharing playbooks, joining key client calls, and helping the team raise its game.
 You should have: 
 - 5+ years of experience in account management, client success, or a similar client-facing role; logistics, supply chain, or SaaS background strongly preferred.
 - A proven track record of independently managing and growing a complex, multi-product book of business — your accounts are more demanding and your results reflect it.
 - Deep understanding of global trade and supply chain operations across multiple modes; you can speak fluently about ocean, air, trucking, and customs.
 - Demonstrated ability to operate without a playbook in ambiguous or novel situations — and the judgment to write the playbook for others after you've solved it.
 - Strong commercial instincts: you see growth opportunities before clients ask for them and you close them.
 - A natural tendency to develop others — peers and junior teammates get better from working alongside you.
 - A 'compliance first' attitude to keep our regulators happy and enthusiastic about Flexport since we operate in a heavily regulated industry.
 You will get: 
 - Ownership of Flexport's most complex and exciting client relationships — the accounts where the biggest impact gets made.
 - A visible role in shaping how the Sales team operates: your judgment and approach set the standard.
 - Opportunities to contribute to team playbooks, onboarding content, and process improvements.
 - Competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and a vibrant company culture.

 At Flexport, our ability to fulfill our mission of making global commerce easy and accessible relies on having a diverse, dedicated and engaged workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical and mental disability, health status, marital and family status, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
 The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. 
 An overview of this role
 As the Candidate Experience Team Lead for [Region], you'll own how candidates experience GitLab across your region by raising the capability of the specialists around you. You'll set the quality bar, balance workloads, onboard and develop specialists, and serve as the first escalation point when a process breaks down or a candidate situation needs judgment. You'll stay hands-on with interview coordination, background checks, and offers, while spending most of your time making the regional function run well. You'll use candidate experience data to surface patterns and risks to the Director, Talent Acquisition and Enablement, and partner with leads in other regions to maintain one global process. At GitLab, our mission is simple: to enable everyone to contribute to and co-create the software that powers our world.
 What you’ll do
• Lead Candidate Experience Specialists in [Region], setting and modeling standards for interview coordination, candidate communication, contract and offer accuracy, and data hygiene in the applicant tracking system.
• Balance coordination work across the regional team, monitor capacity against hiring volume, and flag resourcing gaps to the Director, Talent Acquisition and Enablement before they affect candidates.
• Resolve escalated scheduling conflicts, candidate issues, and process gaps, bringing clear recommendations to leadership when further support is needed.
• Own onboarding, ramp, and ongoing development for new specialists through documentation, shadowing, and direct feedback on work quality.
• Coordinate interviews, prepare offers and employment contracts, manage background and reference checks, and partner with People Operations on the handoff to onboarding.
• Build and maintain reporting on candidate satisfaction, specialist response times, scheduling turnaround, and data accuracy to identify patterns, bottlenecks, and risks.
• Partner with leads in other regions to maintain one global coordination process, contribute regional evidence to process and tooling improvements, implement agreed changes, and keep documentation accurate in the applicant tracking system and GitLab repositories.
• Collaborate with recruiters, hiring managers, Talent Acquisition leadership, Information Technology, and People Operations across time zones to keep hiring moving, modeling GitLab's values, culture, and all-remote approach in every interaction.
 What you’ll bring
• Substantial experience in candidate experience or recruiting coordination, covering interview scheduling, offer and contract preparation, background checks, and onboarding handoffs, including serving as a senior or go-to team member.
• Ability to lead and develop team members without formal authority through mentoring, onboarding, direct feedback, and influence.
• Attention to detail in scheduling, contracts, and candidate data, with a record of professionalism, responsiveness, sound judgment under pressure, and maintaining confidentiality.
• Experience anticipating risks, resolving scheduling and process problems early, prioritizing competing demands, and setting clear expectations about timelines, next steps, and trade-offs.
• Experience building and maintaining candidate experience or scheduling reports, using data to identify bottlenecks and make a case for change.
• Experience working across regions or functions to standardize processes, with the judgment to distinguish genuine regional requirements from inconsistent practices.
• Clear written and verbal communication with candidates and stakeholders at all levels, including executives, and the ability to build collaborative relationships across functions and time zones.
• Proficiency with an applicant tracking system or interview tool for scheduling, tracking, and stage management, plus Google Workspace and scheduling tools, and a willingness to learn additional tools. Greenhouse and ModernLoop experience is beneficial but not required.
 About the team
 Our Candidate Experience team supports candidates through interview coordination, offers and contracts, background and reference checks, and the transition to onboarding. As regional leads and specialists, we partner with recruiters, hiring managers, Talent Acquisition leadership, Information Technology, and People Operations to deliver a consistent global candidate experience. We work across time zones, using transparent documentation in the applicant tracking system and GitLab repositories to collaborate asynchronously. Our regional leads work together to resolve process differences and bring regional evidence into global improvements.

title: Senior Product Manager, Switchboard
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
 The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
 * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. 
 An overview of this role 
 As a Senior Product Manager for Switchboard, you'll shape how customers manage their GitLab Dedicated infrastructure and how our engineering teams operate a growing fleet of customer instances. Switchboard is the control plane for Dedicated: it helps internal teams scale upgrades and maintenance, while giving customers a place to configure their infrastructure, understand the health of their environment, and receive critical updates.
 You'll own the product vision and roadmap, balancing technical and operational needs with a clear, useful customer experience. Dedicated is GitLab's fastest-growing deployment option, and your work will help the business support more customers efficiently. You'll have the autonomy to identify the most important problems and decide where Switchboard should go next, with support from your manager and engineering partners.
 What you’ll do 
• Set the vision and roadmap for Switchboard, connecting customer needs and internal operational challenges to priorities for the engineering team.
• Work with engineering and site reliability engineering teams to improve the tools used to operate Dedicated instances, including upgrades and maintenance.
• Improve the customer-facing console so customers can manage infrastructure settings, configure private networking and authentication, and understand their instance's health.
• Talk directly with customers to understand their needs, explain product decisions, and use their feedback to shape the roadmap.
• Bring a strong user experience perspective to product decisions. Work hands-on with engineering to develop and refine workflows, including when a dedicated design partner isn't available.
• Explore opportunities to improve the tooling and experience for customers migrating from self-managed GitLab to Dedicated, how we help manage incidents, and to extend Switchboard to support GitLab.com as its architecture evolves.
 What you’ll bring 
• Experience owning a product vision and roadmap and working with engineering to deliver improvements for users.
• Technical understanding that helps you discuss infrastructure and operational tradeoffs with engineers and translate them into clear product decisions.
• A strong focus on user experience, with experience making complex technical workflows easier to understand and use.
• Clear communication and the ability and interest to work directly with customers. Experience with internal tools is relevant, provided you're comfortable taking on customer-facing product work.
• The ability to work independently, make sense of an evolving problem space, and prioritize across customer experience, operational efficiency, and business needs.
• You may also bring experience with control planes, cloud management consoles, infrastructure products, internal operational tools, customer migrations, or incident management, but these aren't required. 
 About the team 
 We work across product management, engineering, and site reliability engineering to solve technical, operational, and user experience problems.
 At GitLab, our mission is simple: to enable everyone to contribute to and co-create the software that powers our world.
 The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our benefits and equity . Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary. 
 United States Salary Range
 $139,200 — $235,200 USD 
 How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees 
• Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being 
• Flexible Paid Time Off 
• Team Member Resource Groups 
• Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan 
• Growth and Development Fund 
• Parental Leave 
 Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

title: Corporate Development Lead
location: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within Canada or United States
description:
Mercury is building the financial stack ambitious companies use to operate, from banking* to bill pay to forecasting, and everything in between. As we scale, the strategic choices we make about what we build, who we buy, and who we partner with are some of the highest-leverage decisions in the business. To help us make those bets well, we're hiring a Lead on our Corporate Development team. 
 This role reports to the Head of Corporate Development. You'll work on M&A, fundraising, investor relations, and strategic projects that shape where Mercury goes next, with a seat at the table on those decisions at a profitable, growth-stage fintech and direct exposure to our CEO, CFO, and executive team. 
 This is a function being built, so you'll have the chance to build the corp dev, IR, and strategy muscle at Mercury as we grow, with reps on real deals. We've closed two acquisitions and the M&A roadmap is active. We run Corp Dev as an AI-native, flat, and high-agency team.
 What You'll Do: 
 M&A and Strategic Investments: 
• Own M&A pipeline tracking and target sourcing - keep a living view of strategic and financial opportunities across our roadmap 
• Partner closely with Product and GTM leadership to surface where M&A or strategic partnerships could accelerate the roadmap - translating product strategy and GTM gaps into a live, prioritized M&A thesis
• Run Mercury's Market Intel function - maintain a steady flow of competitive and industry intelligence that informs exec decision-making (fintech peers, public comps, private market signals)
• Run M&A diligence - financial modeling, target evaluation, synergy analysis, working with legal/finance/product on deal execution
• Drive post-close integration: own the integration plan, run the cross-functional workstreams (Finance, Product, Engineering, People, Legal) and track the deal against the model it was bought on
 Investor Relations: 
• Drive preparation of Mercury's Board of Directors materials, alongside the Head of Corp Dev, partnering with the exec team on content and narrative
• Support investor relations: investor updates, KPI reporting, comps tracking, ad hoc requests from existing investors
• Build fundraising materials - pitch decks, data room, financial models, investor narrative - alongside the Head of Corp Dev and CFO
 You Might Be a Fit If You: 
• Have 5–8 years of relevant experience, with at least 2 years in an in-house Corporate Development seat at a tech company. Investment banking, PE, or growth equity experience before that is welcome but not required
• Have direct reps on live M&A deals - diligence, modeling and execution
• Have driven post-close integration on the company side: owned the plan after a deal closed, ran the cross-functional workstreams, and were accountable for whether the deal delivered what the model said
• Are highly analytical and comfortable with data: you can pull the numbers yourself, find what matters in them, and size the analysis to the decision, from a back-of-envelope estimate to a full model
• Work with AI every day : you have used AI to build your own workflows and scaled your output
• Write clearly. Can take a messy strategic question and produce a memo or board-ready slide that drives a decision
• Are comfortable operating across Product, Engineering, and GTM - you can hold a real conversation with a PM about roadmap tradeoffs and with a sales leader about pipeline gaps, and translate both into corp dev opportunities
• Have a point of view. Can disagree with senior leaders constructively and back it up with analysis
• Bonus for having experience ave or demonstrated interest in fintech, in banking/payments business models (interchange, NIM, deposit economics) or B2B SaaS pricing
 *Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC. 
 Mercury values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Mercury are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities or special needs. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.
 #LI-RQ1
 Total Rewards 
The total rewards package at Mercury includes base salary, equity (stock options/RSUs), and benefits.
 Our salary and equity ranges are highly competitive within the SaaS and fintech industry and are updated regularly using the most reliable compensation survey data for our industry. New hire offers are made based on a candidate’s experience, expertise, geographic location, and internal pay equity relative to peers.
 Our target new hire base salary ranges for this role are the following : 
 US employees in New York City, Los Angeles, Seattle, or the San Francisco Bay Area:
 $180,200 — $225,200 USD 
 US employees outside of New York City, Los Angeles, Seattle, or the San Francisco Bay Area: 
 $162,200 — $202,700 USD 
 Canadian employees (any location):
 $170,300 — $212,800 CAD

title: Select Major Account Executive, UK&I
description:
Who we are 
 Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. 
 Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. 
 About the role:
 The Select Major Accounts team is Samsara’s primary engine for enterprise growth, responsible for landing high-value, net-new logos across the UK & Ireland’s largest physical operations. In this role, you will lead multi-million-dollar, full-cycle sales processes from a cold start—executing a disciplined qualification playbook, building true C-suite champions, and closing strategic $1M+ ARR deals . This position is built for an elite, strategic Account Executive who thrives in complex, multi-stakeholder environments—equally comfortable navigating IT and lines of business to digitize industries traditionally reliant on legacy systems.
 Why Now? Samsara combines the agility of a high-growth startup, the market authority of a public company, and the momentum of a hyper-scale tech leader. Named a Best Place to Work for 3 consecutive years , we offer enterprise sellers a combination of unique differentiators:
• 
 Proven Leadership & Hyper-Growth: Founded by serial entrepreneurs with a history of building multi-billion-dollar companies, Samsara has scaled past $2.1B+ ARR with 30%+ YoY global growth.
• 
 Market-Dominating Platform: Backed by $2.8B+ in R&D investment, our Connected Operations Cloud makes us the Category Leader delivering class-leading AI, IoT, and telematics capabilities with a genuine AI moat.
• 
 Massive Untapped Market: Physical operations represent a $160B+ Global TAM, with EMEA remaining 99% greenfield opportunity .
 This brings strong upside earning potential on a winning trajectory, rapid professional growth alongside elite sales talent, and a massive, unpenetrated territory waiting to be captured.
 Whilst we do support remote working, flexibility is required to travel to visit customers onsite across the region as required.
 You should apply if: 
• You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
• Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara’s top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
• You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact. 
• You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work. 
• You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
• You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before. 
 In this role, you will: 
• Develop Executive-Level relationships within strategic, named accounts 
• Own customer engagements end-to-end, from prospecting and qualification to close
• Demonstrate excellent solution-based sales process in complex sales campaigns
• Mobilize a large matrix virtual team of business stakeholders to include Operations, Finance, IT, dedicated Solution Engineer and Account Development Representative
• Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices
 Minimum requirements for the role: 
• Min. 7+ years full-cycle Enterprise-level Account Executive closing expertise, winning complex SAAS deals
• Proven track record of consistent quota over-achievement in complex accounts and $1M+ ARR deal execution
• New Logo & Self-generated pipeline: Demonstrated ability to build and win deals through a repeatable outbound prospecting motion
• Structured Qualification: Mastery of Playbook methodology-led selling (e.g. MEDDPICC / Command of the Message / Force Management) to quantify genuine business pain
• Champion & Economic Buyer navigation: Proven ability to test and build true champions, access executive buying centres, and engineer compelling events
• A Team player used to winning as a team, collaborative and within a coachable growth mindset
 An ideal candidate also has: 
• Awards for elite achievement (particularly President’s Club, Winner’s circle, Top 10%)
• Passionate about transformational technology in the world operations 
• Excited about solving new problems in innovative ways 
 Total Rewards

title: New Business Account Executive
description:
Who we are 
 At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.
 Our dedication to remote-first work , and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
 . 
 Hiring and how we work 
 We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions! 
 Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
 . 
 See yourself at Twilio 
 Join the team as Twilio’s next New Business Account Executive UK/I/Northern Europe..
 About the job 
 This position is needed to sell into high value ISV, High Tech, AI Native and Enterprise companies. You will play a key role in further growing Twilio’s Communication business across UK/I/Northern Europe. You will be responsible for sourcing new, high value customers as well as driving the sales process from internal leads to qualifying new prospects and handling deals to closure.
 Responsibilities 
 In this role, you’ll:
• Be responsible for net new customer acquisition and driving ACV for a specific set of accounts while maintaining the highest levels of customer satisfaction.
• Work closely with your SDR and SE teams to own, drive and build intelligent outreach campaigns into new prospects
• Source new leads and drive sustainable pipeline growth each quarter
• Master creating pricing proposals, negotiating terms and managing the contract process. Ideally, you also have experience selling communications solutions to a technical and business audience, building trust and mutual respect with technical customers and peers.
• Are passionate about what you do and you are able to think outside of the box and have extraordinary interpersonal and communication skills to make complex contractual, technical, and financial details sound simple.
• Able to balance challenging priorities and handle multiple projects/deals at the same time.
 Qualifications 
 Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!
 *Required: 
• 6+ years of Enterprise Sales experience and a track record of personally selling and closing complex solutions to enterprise and software companies. 
• Strong experience identifying, mapping and prospecting enterprise accounts
• Proven success in selling complex, technical solutions such as cloud communications platforms, APIs, Conversational AI and/or enterprise software
• Experience in account management, developing large enterprise clients, and a history of meeting or exceeding sales targets
• Experience working with Fortune 500 or similarly large enterprises
• Background in working within a quota-driven environment with proven ability to close high-value deals (e.g., six to seven figures)
• Expertise in solution-based selling or consultative selling 
• Strong negotiation and contract management skills, including handling complex deals with long sales cycles.
• Prospecting and lead generation skills—ability to develop a pipeline through multiple channels, including direct sales, partnerships, and networking.
• Ability to build and nurture relationships with C-level executives, decision-makers, cross-functional partners and key stakeholders in large enterprises
• Strong presentation and negotiation skills
• Comfortable working in a dynamic / environment. 
• Familiar working with MEDDPICC sales qualification methodology and other Sales methodologies 
 Desired: 
• Ideally, you also have experience selling both to a business and technical audience
• Understanding of the CPaaS & Customer Engagement ecosystem and familiarity with:
• 
• Cloud communications (voice, SMS, chat, video, etc.).
• Contact centre agent productivity and Conversational AI
• APIs and integrations for communication services.
• Telecommunications industry dynamics.
• Knowledge of enterprise technology architecture and the technical needs of large organizations, including how CPaaS solutions integrate with existing systems.
 Location 
 This role will be remote and based in the UK or Ireland.
 Travel 
 We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, approximately 25% travel is anticipated to help you connect in-person in a meaningful way. 
 What We Offer 
 Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.
 . 
 Twilio thinks big. Do you? 
 We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic . Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.
 So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions. 
 . 
 Stay alert to recruitment fraud 
 We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, website

title: Enterprise Account Executive
description:
Amplitude is the leading AI analytics platform, helping over 5,200 customers—including Atlassian, Burger King, NBCUniversal, and Square—build better products and digital experiences. With powerful AI Agents embedded across our platform, teams can analyze, test, and optimize user experiences faster than ever. Ranked #1 across multiple categories in G2’s Winter 2026 Report, Amplitude is the best-in-class solution for product, data, and marketing teams. Learn more at amplitude.com http://amplitude.com.



As an organization, we deliver for our customers by living our values. We operate from a place of humility, take ownership of problems and successes, approach challenges with a growth mindset, and put our customers at the center of everything we do.

The UK is the fastest growing region in EMEA, and this year we are seeing bigger, more complex and more marquee logos being won than ever before! 

We offer a flexible work with beautiful office space by Borough Market for days to connect, as well as time at home and of course in the field meeting customers and partners. You'd join a close knit team of 7 hugely successful Account Executives who are taking this market by storm.  

Everyone who works at Amplitude has ownership; with complete autonomy to own your book of business with creativity and confidence. We're looking for a driver, an expert story-teller and uses AI to accelerate their impact. 

This is a role for someone who wants to build something, not just manage it.

What you'll be doing

 - Manage a mix of customers and prospects who are high growth enterprises (around 2k - 10k employees with a turnover of roughly 250 - 500m).

 - Running full enterprise sales cycles with a value-first mindset — discovery, demos, and exec presentations tailored to what you heard.

 - Evangelise and sell all components of our platform but also understand the dynamics of selling a complex platform solution. 

 - Educate customers on their AI product development maturity and journey, providing customer centric support and guidance. 

 - Building pipeline through outbound, AI-assisted tools, SDR partnership, marketing programmes, and the partner ecosystem

 - Driving wins with net new logos that will help you grow your territory for next year and beyond. 

 - Applying MEDDPICC with real rigour — qualifying hard, building Champions, getting to Economic Buyers early, and forecasting with confidence

 - Becoming a product evangelist across Marketing, Product, and Engineering personas — selling technical and commercial value at every level

 - Working the full internal village: SDRs, Solutions Consultants, Partners, Customer Success, Legal — everyone aligned around customer value

What we're looking for

 - Enterprise SaaS or AI sales experience, ideally with deals $50k - $400k ARR 

 - A genuine hunter — consistent pipeline generation and a land-and-expand mindset

 - MEDDPICC (or equivalent) applied in how you run deals, not just how you update your CRM

 - Strong C-suite presence — able to uncover business value beyond features and build relationships that last

 - Naturally curious and empathetic; someone who experiments with the sales process rather than just running the same play

 - The ability to multi-thread and to sell a complex platform solution. 

 
 


OUR VALUES:

At Amplitude, our values guide how we show up for one another and for our customers:

 - Humility: We operate from a place of empathy and openness, seeking to understand many points of view.

 - Ownership: We take the initiative to solve problems that drive our shared company success.

 - Growth Mindset: We’re tenacious in the face of challenges and seek feedback in order to grow ourselves and others.

 - Customer Centricity: We put the customer at the center of everything we do and are deeply committed to their success.



We care about the well-being of our team: We offer competitive pay and benefits packages that reflect our commitment to the health and well-being of our Ampliteers.

Some of our benefit programs include:

 - Excellent  M edical,  D ental and  V ision insurance coverages, with 100% employer-paid premiums for employee Medical,  Dental,   Vision on select plans

 - 401(k) retirement plan with an employer match of up to 1% of your eligible pay each pay period up to $2,000 annually

 - Flexible time off,  p aid holidays, and more

 - Generous stipends to spend on what matters most to you, whether that’s wellness (monthly), commuter transit/parking (monthly), learning and development (quarterly), new hire home office equipment, and much more

 - Excellent Parental benefits including :  12 weeks of Paid Parental Leave, Carrot Fertility Benefits/Adoption/Surrogacy support, Back-up Child Care support

 - Mental health and wellness benefits including no cost employee access to Modern Health coaching & therapy sessions

ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Ramp is building the future of work with AI. We’re bringing a new class of AI-native products to market that can understand business context, make decisions, and increasingly execute work on behalf of customers.

We’re looking for an AI Account Executive to help build the commercial motion for this emerging portfolio. You’ll own the full sales cycle, from creating pipeline and shaping the customer’s problem through evaluation, close, and activation. You’ll work across Engineering, IT, Security, and Procurement to turn complex AI capabilities into clear business outcomes.

This is a founding seller role. You’ll help define the market, qualification criteria, sales process, messaging, and playbooks that the broader organization will use. The right person is both a closer and a builder: someone who can win important early customers, learn quickly from the field, and turn those lessons into a repeatable system. We’re hiring AI Account Executives at multiple levels. The scope of the role, title, and compensation will reflect your experience and demonstrated ability to lead complex sales cycles and build new commercial motions.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own the full sales cycle: Source, qualify, develop, and close net-new opportunities for Ramp’s AI products, with accountability for pipeline creation, revenue, and forecast accuracy.

 - Create demand in an emerging category: Help customers identify high-value AI use cases, connect technical capabilities to urgent business problems, and build conviction before a mature buying process exists.

 - Navigate complex buying groups. Multi-thread across Finance, Engineering, IT, Security, Procurement, and executive stakeholders to align technical requirements, economic value, and organizational priorities.

 - Build the business case: Quantify ROI, total cost of ownership, operational impact, and risk reduction to earn executive sponsorship and create urgency.

 - Lead rigorous evaluations: Partner with Solutions, Product, and Engineering to scope demonstrations, pilots, security reviews, and implementation plans that establish a credible path to production.

 - Shape the commercial narrative: Pressure-test positioning, discovery, pricing, objection handling, and competitive messaging through direct customer engagement.

 - Turn field learning into a playbook: Document repeatable qualification criteria, buyer patterns, use cases, proof points, and deal strategies that improve the performance of future sellers.

 - Influence the product roadmap: Build a tight feedback loop with Product and Engineering by clearly communicating what customers value, where deals stall, and which capabilities will unlock adoption.

 - Operate as a founding team member: Help establish the standards, culture, tooling, and operating cadence for Ramp’s AI sales organization.

title: Account Executive I (Farmer)
description:
About Flexport: 
 At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. 
 The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.
 The opportunity: 
 The Sales team at Flexport is dedicated to fostering strong, lasting relationships with our existing clients, ensuring their success and maximizing the value they derive from our platform. As an Account Executive I (Farmer), you play a critical role in driving client success at Flexport — deepening your expertise on our platform, our clients, and the fundamentals of global trade. You will manage a portfolio of accounts where you develop the core skills every great Account Executive I (Farmer) needs: building relationships, running business reviews, and spotting early growth signals. You'll work with clear playbooks and close support from senior teammates as you build the instincts and product knowledge to grow into even more complex client work. 
 You will: 
 - Manage a portfolio of Flexport clients, developing trusted relationships and driving strong satisfaction and retention through consistent, proactive engagement.
 - Serve as the primary point of contact for day-to-day client communications, running regular business reviews (QBRs/MBRs) with support from structured templates and senior teammates.
 - Identify and surface early cross-sell and upsell opportunities within your accounts, partnering with senior Account Executives I (Farmer) and Sales to pursue them.
 - Collaborate with internal teams (Operations, Product, Implementation) to resolve client issues and deliver consistent service quality.
 - Review client performance data to identify trends and potential risks, bringing data-informed insights to your regular client conversations.
 - Build foundational knowledge of Flexport's product suite and global trade operations to credibly advise clients on core logistics challenges.
 - Work closely with Hunters from the beginning of the customer journey to ensure a seamless transition and long-term client success.
 You should have: 
 - 1+ years of experience in account management, direct sales, client success, operations, or a similar client-facing role; logistics, supply chain, or SaaS background a plus.
 - A demonstrated ability to build rapport and trust with clients, with a track record of strong satisfaction or relationship outcomes.
 - Strong communication and listening skills, you ask good questions and follow through on commitments.
 - Curiosity about how accounts grow and what drives client value; you're developing commercial instincts, not just executing tasks.
 - Comfort working within defined processes and seeking guidance when situations are new or ambiguous.
 - A 'compliance first' attitude to keep our regulators happy and enthusiastic about Flexport since we operate in a heavily regulated industry.
 You will get: 
 - Structured onboarding and mentorship from experienced Account Executives who invest in your development.
 - A clear growth path: Account Executive I (Farmer) is just the start of a career track with increasing scope, complexity, and earning potential.
 - Hands-on experience with a global platform moving $19B+ of merchandise across 112 countries.
 - A collaborative team environment where asking questions and learning from mistakes is encouraged.

GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

 An overview of this role
 As a Major Account Executive on our FINS Enterprise team, you'll help large, regulated organizations adopt, implement, and expand their use of GitLab’s AI-powered DevSecOps platform. You’ll focus on major enterprise prospects and customers, guiding them through complex DevSecOps and software delivery transformations across areas like CI/CD automation, secure development, and infrastructure modernization. • Support GitLab’s strategic large prospects and customers as a trusted advisor throughout their DevSecOps journey.
• Drive the full sales cycle in large, complex enterprises, including prospecting, qualifying, developing, and closing new opportunities across your assigned accounts.
• Provide strong account leadership and direction in both the pre-sales and post-sales process to ensure customers realize value from GitLab’s AI-powered DevSecOps platform.
• Coordinate closely with Solutions Architects, Customer Success, Support, and strategic channel partners to design and execute account strategies that drive adoption, expansion, and retention.
• Develop and execute structured account plans based on customer business needs, including opportunity mapping, stakeholder alignment, and multi-threaded engagement across technical and business teams.
• Ensure successful rollout and ongoing adoption through proactive account management activities, regular business reviews, and clear alignment on customer outcomes.
• Prepare and deliver accurate activity and forecast reports, and contribute to root cause analysis on wins and losses while sharing lessons learned with account managers, marketing, and technical teams.
• Act as the voice of the customer by sharing feedback and product ideas, and use a consultative approach to create proposals, quotes, and presentations that clearly link GitLab’s solutions to customer business objectives.
 What you'll bring
• A true desire to see customers achieve meaningful outcomes and long-term value from their investment in GitLab.
• Experience driving complex B2B software sales cycles with large enterprises, ideally in DevSecOps, software development tools, or adjacent SaaS solutions.
• Proven success selling into large, strategic organizations, with the ability to build trusted relationships with C-level and senior stakeholders across business and technical teams.
• Able to provide a high degree of account management and control, working under minimal supervision on complex opportunities while maintaining clear communication and alignment.
• Ability to generate new business and expand existing accounts through consultative, multi-stakeholder sales motions that result in sustainable, long-term partnerships.
• Experience collaborating with strategic channel partners to develop opportunities, co-sell, and support successful customer adoption.
• Excellent negotiation, presentation, and closing skills, with effective written and verbal communication that influences internal and external stakeholders.
• Preferred experience with Git, software development tools, application lifecycle management, or security/application security tools.
• You share our values and work in accordance with them, use GitLab in your daily work, and are able to travel if needed while following GitLab’s travel policy.
 About the team
 The Enterprise Sales team is responsible for driving growth, adoption, and long-term value for GitLab's AI-powered DevSecOps platform with our largest and most strategic customers. As a Major Account Executive on the FINS Enterprise team, you'll be part of a distributed, all-remote team that works asynchronously across regions and partners closely with GitLab's sales engineering, marketing, and customer success teams. We value transparency, collaboration, and a consultative approach, and we support one another through shared account planning, regular deal reviews, and knowledge sharing focused on enterprise customers across regulated and large-scale environments.

title: AI Deployment Strategist
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

This is a senior, executive-facing role for someone with 10+ years' experience. It is not an engineering or coding role. You will be the strategic voice of Snowflake's Frontier Engineering team with the C-suite of some of the largest enterprises in Europe and the Middle East: inspiring what AI can change in their business, leading the discovery that finds the problems worth solving, and shaping engagements our engineers deliver.




ABOUT THE TEAM



Snowflake's Frontier Engineering (also known as Forward Deployed Engineering) team embeds directly inside enterprise customers to design, build, and deploy production AI systems on the data they already trust. Our engineers are the people who build Snowflake itself. We work at risk: customers pay when they are happy with what we have delivered. And we do not do pilots that never ship.




WHAT YOU WILL DO
