 - Business-first fluency in AI and data. You connect AI to strategy and the P&L, and you understand why AI works best when it sits next to governed enterprise data. You speak the language of IT and data teams; you do not need to write code.

 - Discovery and scoping experience. You have led discovery and shaped complex, multi-stakeholder engagements into clear scopes and business cases, and you are honest about what will and will not be delivered.

 - 10+ years in enterprise technology, consulting or strategic advisory, including direct work with the C-suite - for example advising an executive team through a multi-year transformation, owning executive relationships on major accounts, or holding a CTO, CDO or Field CTO role.
   
   


WHAT WOULD SET YOU APART

title: Senior Data Analyst - Enterprise Risk
description:
Hello. We’re Teya.

Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better.

They are the cafés, restaurants, salons, shops and entrepreneurs that bring character to our high streets, create jobs and keep communities moving. Yet for too long, financial services has made life harder for them - with clunky tools, poor support and complexity that gets in the way of running a business.

Teya exists to change that.

We’re building a financial platform for local businesses across Europe - one built around simple tools, thoughtful design and real human support. Our Members rely on us to help them run their business with confidence, and that responsibility shapes the way we work.

We move fast. We care about quality. We stay close to the detail. And we believe great performance and genuine hospitality should go hand in hand.

If you want to build meaningful products, solve real problems and make a genuine difference for local businesses, we’d love to hear from you


SENIOR DATA ANALYST – ENTERPRISE RISK



THE ROLE

Teya is building its Enterprise Risk Management Framework (ERMF) and strengthening how risk information is brought together, analysed and reported across the business.

As Senior Data Analyst, you will play a key role in turning risk data into reliable measures, meaningful insights and actionable reporting. You'll work closely with the Head of Enterprise & Operational Risk and stakeholders across Credit, Fraud, AML, People, IT, Operations and Finance to understand the risks facing the business, identify the right data to monitor them, and develop effective reporting and early-warning capabilities.

This is a business-facing analytical role. Understanding risk, working effectively with risk owners and translating their requirements into practical data solutions will be just as important as your technical skills. You'll help ensure key risk indicators (KRIs) are meaningful, data is reliable, thresholds are appropriately informed by analysis, and reporting supports better risk oversight and decision-making.

You'll also help modernise how risk reporting is produced, using AI models and workflow automation to bring together internal data and relevant external information, identify emerging issues and reduce manual effort. The focus is on practical application, with robust validation, traceability and human oversight.

This is an opportunity to combine risk expertise, analytical problem-solving and emerging AI capabilities to help shape how a growing fintech business identifies, monitors and manages risk.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Develop risk data and reporting: Identify and map relevant data sources, using tools such as Snowflake to build repeatable datasets for KRIs across operational, credit, fraud, AML, people, capital, liquidity and other risk categories.

 - Partner with risk stakeholders: Work closely with the Head of Enterprise & Operational Risk and risk owners across the business to understand their priorities, clarify reporting requirements and translate risk management needs into practical analytical solutions.

 - Analyse and monitor risk indicators: Use SQL and Python to investigate trends, test assumptions, identify anomalies and understand changes in risk exposure. Help risk owners interpret findings and determine where further investigation or action may be needed.

 - Support KRI definitions and thresholds: Work with risk stakeholders to validate indicator definitions, assess data quality and analyse historical and current performance to inform threshold calibration. Help ensure indicators provide meaningful insight into the risks they are intended to monitor.

 - Build dashboards and management reporting: Develop clear, accessible dashboards using Tableau, Power BI or similar tools, supporting monthly ERMF reporting and management oversight.

 - Automate risk reporting with AI: Build and improve AI-enabled workflows that bring together internal data and relevant external signals, including regulatory updates, market developments, news and emerging threats. Help generate evidence-based reporting drafts for review by the Head of Enterprise & Operational Risk and CRO.

 - Develop early-warning capabilities: Help design and test approaches to monitor KRI movements and operational data throughout the month, highlighting unusual patterns and potential emerging risks with clear supporting evidence for investigation.

 - Support risk technology and integration: Translate ERMF and reporting requirements into practical data, integration and workflow specifications for Teya's governance, risk and compliance (GRC) solution, partnering with Risk, Data and Technology colleagues on implementation.

 - Improve data quality and governance: Document data sources, definitions, lineage, refresh frequencies, validation checks and limitations to ensure reporting is consistent, explainable and reliable.

 - Drive continuous improvement: Identify opportunities to simplify reporting, improve analytical processes and strengthen how risk information is used across the business.



WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - Experience in a data analytics, risk analytics or similar analytical role within a risk function, ideally covering enterprise, operational, credit, fraud or financial crime risk.

 - A practical understanding of how risk is identified, assessed and monitored, including how risk appetite, controls, risk drivers, KRIs and thresholds connect.

title: Technical CX Specialist, EMEA
description:
WHY HARVEY

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.







ROLE OVERVIEW

As a Technical Customer Experience (CX) Specialist, you will be frontline support within our global support team, reporting to a CX Manager. You’ll help legal, tax, and finance professionals at some of the world’s largest firms get the most out of Harvey, and you’ll own technical issues from first response through root cause. This isn’t a typical SaaS support role: Harvey moves fast, priorities shift often, and you’ll wear multiple hats as the product and team scale. We’re looking for someone who loves problem-solving, thrives with ambiguity, and pairs strong technical instincts with real empathy for enterprise customers.

Shift schedules are being finalized and may include hours outside standard local business hours to support our global customers. Specific working hours will be discussed during the interview process and confirmed before an offer is accepted.







WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Serve as the first point of contact for customer support inquiries, delivering empathetic, accurate, and timely resolutions.

 - Juggle multiple competing priorities and tasks, ensuring a high level of service and responsiveness.

 - Own technical issues across topics like AI output quality, login and SSO, authentication and tokens, REST API integrations, and error logs, working each to root cause by confirming scope, ruling out configuration and environment, and knowing why a fix will work before sending it.

 - Investigate with Datadog (including RUM session replay), Omni, Snowflake, and Auth0, and use Claude Code and the Datadog MCP integration to get to answers faster.

 - Maintain a high standard of reliability and accountability, ensuring consistent coverage and follow-through during assigned shifts.

 - Collaborate with team members to troubleshoot complex issues, escalating them appropriately when needed.

 - Maintain a deep understanding of our products and services to provide knowledgeable support.

 - Document customer interactions and feedback to aid in continuous improvement of our services.

 - Work closely with other departments to resolve customer issues and contribute to the overall customer experience.

 - Collaborate effectively as part of a team while confidently owning and executing tasks independently.

 - Stay informed of new product features and updates to provide accurate and current support.

 - Contribute to the development and refinement of support processes and materials, such as FAQs and knowledge base articles.



WHAT YOU HAVE

 - 3+ years proven experience in a technical support role, in a fast-paced environment providing “white glove” or “premium support” to large enterprise customers for AI-driven products

 - Exceptional empathy and a genuine desire to help and connect with customers.

 - Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to think creatively and resolve complex issues.

 - Excellent organisational skills, capable of managing multiple tasks and priorities effectively.

 - Comfortable operating with ambiguity in a fast-moving environment, with a track record of taking ownership

 - Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to convey complex information in an understandable manner.

 - Understanding of APIs, and ability to explain complex API concepts to both technical and non-technical customers.

 - Familiarity with customer support tools and CRM systems; experience with Zendesk, Salesforce is a plus.

 - Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and build positive working relationships across departments.

 - A passion for learning and personal growth, with a commitment to staying informed about industry trends and best practices.

 - Availability to participate in an on-call rotation outside scheduled working hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays, in accordance with the company’s on-call policy.

title: Design System Lead
description:
Design System Lead

Location: Bristol/London, UK (hybrid, three days a week in the office)
Team: UX
Contract: Permanent
Reporting To: Head of UX

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in the UK. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities


About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.


What you’ll do

 - Shape the future of the design system and the global Agent Experience product as an equal partner to engineering, product, and delivery

 - Create and deliver the design strategy for the system in direct partnership with the engineering lead, holding joint accountability for its direction

 - Set and uphold the design and UX quality bar across every contribution, including accessibility, comfortable challenging engineers and designers alike, and being challenged in return

 - Run the contribution process end to end, so teams beyond our own can propose, design, and ship into the system, from first proposal through to full adoption

 - Design, prototype, and ship components yourself, including using AI-assisted tools to move from Figma to production code, built to WCAG 2.2 AA from the start

 - Coach and develop the designers and engineers who build with the system, raising the bar for how people use and contribute to it

 - Represent the design system to stakeholders across the business, advocating for its value and shaping how the wider company understands and invests in it

 - Champion good design and accessibility thinking in architecture and technical decisions, working alongside senior engineering leaders as a peer

What you’ll bring 
Ideally you’ll have/be

 - Deep experience designing, building, and evolving a design system at scale, tokens, component APIs, documentation, and governance

 - Strong design and UX judgement, starting from the user, with genuine comfort challenging and being challenged by engineers and other designers

 - Practical knowledge of WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility standards, with real empathy for designing for users with accessibility needs, not just compliance

 - Confidence working in code, using AI-assisted tools to take a component from design intent through to shipped reality

 - Experience running a contribution or change process across multiple teams or apps, from proposal to full migration

 - A track record setting and delivering technical and design strategy jointly with engineering, iteratively, through genuine ambiguity, not from a finished plan

 - Strong communication skills, able to hold your opinions loosely, and to raise what matters even when it’s inconvenient, across engineering, product, and the wider business

 - Experience mentoring, coaching, and developing other designers

 - A bias to action, comfortable building momentum in the face of real uncertainty

Where you'll work

We offer flexible working, with an expectation of 3 days a week in the office. This gives us the best of both: real time together to collaborate and build relationships, with the flexibility to work in the way that suits you best the rest of the week.


Our Values

 - Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

 - Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

 - Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

 - Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

 - Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

Our Perks

 - Time off and family: 26 days’ holiday, plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period

 - Health and security: Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme, free mortgage advice and eye tests

 - Pay and flexibility: Discretionary bonus, a Flex Fund of 5% [of salary] to spend on the benefits you want most, retail discounts through Perks at Work

 - Growth and setup: Personal learning budget, home office budget

 - Climate: Furthr, our climate action app

Come as you are

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

Find out more on our careers page https://www.kaluza.com/careers/ and LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/kaluza/. Our Applicant Data Protection Policy is here https://www.kaluza.com/applicant-data-protection-notice/.

Our Global Structure 
Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
 About the Role
 Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Commercial team sits at the centre of Deliveroo’s marketplace—shaping how we serve restaurants, grocers, and new verticals worldwide. From negotiating key partnerships to unlocking new revenue streams and crafting data-led growth strategies, we take on big challenges that move the business forward. If you thrive in fast-paced, commercial environments and want to influence the future of a global brand—this is the team for you.
 We are looking for an Emirati Commercial Account Executive . This is a role based in Dubai, UAE, supporting our Kuwait business. Your role will consist of supporting the SMB Team Account Managers with their portfolio of managed accounts, in collaboration with the SMB Team lead. In addition, you will support the wider commercial team by gathering and working with data, including any projects, sprints, and campaigns.
 About the Team
 Get to know our SMB team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.
 The SMB team manages a portfolio of partners and moves fast. You'll be the person who makes that speed possible. You'll create the views that break complex data and content into something clear, so Account Managers know where to act and what to fix, and can spend their time on the conversations that matter.
 You'll work alongside the SMB Team Lead and the Account Managers, and support the wider commercial team on projects, sprints, and campaigns where good data decides the outcome.
 What You’ll Be Doing 
 Here’s what your day-to-day might look like: 
• Create views that help the team move fast and turn complex information into clear next steps
• Support Account Managers with day-to-day partner operations, menus, and growth strategies
• Keep partner records accurate and up to standard, because great decisions start with data you can trust
• Support commercial strategy projects, from data entry and analysis to execution

description:
About Flexport: 
 At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. 
 The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.
 The opportunity: 
 The Enterprise Account Executive (ENT) is responsible for driving complex, high-value enterprise deals and establishing long-term strategic partnerships with large customers. This role owns advanced, multi-stakeholder sales cycles that often span regions, business units, and decision layers. The ENT AE operates with a high degree of autonomy, shaping deal strategy, influencing executive stakeholders, and orchestrating cross-functional teams to deliver differentiated, value-driven solutions.
 Your responsibilities as an Account Executive, Enterprise include, but are not limited to the following:
 Pipeline & Opportunity Ownership
• Own and close high-value, complex enterprise opportunities, consistently meeting or exceeding individual quotas.
• Build a strategic pipeline through self-prospecting, account planning, and SDR partnership.
• Proactively identify whitespace, expansion potential, and multi-entity opportunities within target accounts.
• Maintain forecasting, opportunity hygiene, and deal governance in Salesforce (SFDC).
 Strategic Discovery & Solution Architecture
• Lead executive-level discovery to understand enterprise supply chain strategy, risk posture, and long-term business objectives.
• Navigate complex buying groups across procurement, ops, finance, IT, and senior leadership.
• Design integrated, multi-product Flexport solutions aligned to customer priorities and business outcomes.
• Position Flexport as a strategic partner through compelling value narratives, business cases, and solution roadmaps.
 Deal Strategy, Negotiation & Closing
• Own end-to-end deal strategy for complex opportunities, including stakeholder mapping, decision criteria, and close plans.
• Lead advanced commercial negotiation, pricing, contracts, and non-standard deal structures.
• Orchestrate internal stakeholders (Ops, Finance, Legal, Product) to progress deals efficiently
 Onboarding, Expansion & Relationship Leadership
• Own the onboarding motion, ensuring enterprise customers are set up for scalable success.
• Establish and maintain trusted relationships with senior and executive customer stakeholders.
• Identify expansion opportunities together with Account Management to drive sustained growth.
• Serve as a point of escalation and strategic advisor during the customer lifecycle.
 Enterprise Leadership & Market Impact
• Act as a senior commercial voice in enterprise pursuits, sharing market insight and customer feedback internally.
• Contribute to enterprise sales best practices, deal reviews, and peer coaching.
• Represent Flexport with credibility and confidence in high-stakes customer interactions.
 You should have:
• 5+ years of experience managing complex, enterprise-level sales cycles with consistent quota attainment.
• Proven ability to close large, multi-stakeholder deals with long sales cycles and high deal complexity.
• Strong executive presence with the ability to influence senior decision-makers.
• Advanced discovery, negotiation, and value-based selling skills.

description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.



Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:



 - Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

 - Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

 - Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register http://app.n8n.cloud/register.



We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

BUILD STRATEGIC ACCOUNT PLANS

 - Build and execute account strategies for organisations with 5,001 or more employees in the United Kingdom and Ireland.

 - Open doors with outbound campaigns aimed at CTOs, CIOs and engineering and platform leaders.

 - Turn community adoption inside large companies into sponsored, funded opportunities.


LEAD COMPLEX, MULTI-THREADED DEALS

 - Run deep discovery, quantify business impact and build an executive-level business case.

 - Map and align decision makers across engineering, IT, security, legal and procurement.

 - Partner with Solutions Engineers, Partnerships and Customer Success to prove value and de-risk adoption.


CLOSE AND EXPAND AT SCALE

 - Own the cycle through security, legal and procurement, typically over three to six months or more.

 - Negotiate six-figure deals with confidence and keep clear commercial control.

 - Plan expansion across business units and use cases, and share what you learn with Product and leadership.

title: Business Development Lead
description:
ACCURX IS SOLVING HEALTHCARE PRODUCTIVITY FOR THE NHS.

For decades, the NHS has struggled with fragmented systems that make simple tasks feel impossible. At Accurx, we’re changing that by building a single, system-wide platform that helps every patient get gold-standard, efficient, and joined-up care.

What started as a way for GPs to text a patient has now evolved into an all-in-one digital toolkit used by 98% of GP practices.

Our platform now powers Total Triage https://www.accurx.com/primary-care to manage patient demand, and Self-Book, https://www.accurx.com/booking which lets patients schedule their own appointments in seconds. We’ve automated routine care with Patient Questionnaires https://www.accurx.com/questionnaires for long-term conditions, while Accumail https://www.accurx.com/accumail finally allows staff-to-staff communication to happen instantly across different care settings. We’re now pushing the boundaries of the consultation itself with Accurx Scribe https://www.accurx.com/scribe, our AI-powered note-taker that drafts medical notes in real-time.

We’re not just shipping features. We’re giving clinicians their time back and ensuring every patient journey is as smooth as it should be.







SOUNDS MEGA, RIGHT? HERE'S WHERE YOU COME IN...

As our Business Development Lead for the North, you’ll be a player-coach driving mid-market sales across PCNs, GP practices and federations: closing deals yourself while building and coaching a high-performing outbound team as we launch new products across the region.

Based in London, with regular travel across the North of England.


 - Build an outbound engine: Set up high-volume cadences and buyer-signal plays to scale adoption across the North

 - Lead from the front: Close your own key deals while coaching a team of BDAs and BDMs to hit team targets

 - Grow new products: Drive expansion across our product suite, including Scribe, plus a few things we can’t share yet that will change how primary care works

 - Turn data into direction: Map the market, forecast pipeline and set clear commercial priorities

 - Stay close to users: Get out to regional events and webinars, and talk directly with primary care teams

 - Put AI to work: Use tools like Notion AI to sharpen targeting, capture insights and automate admin, so your team spends more time with users

 - Work across teams: Partner with Marketing, BD and Customer Success to convert deals and grow the region
   


YOU SHOULD APPLY IF...

 - You’ve carried a number: You have an SDR, AE or sales management background and a track record of hitting targets

 - You love developing people: You have some experience managing or coaching salespeople, and you hold the bar high

 - You know outbound at scale: You’re hands-on with structured cadences and high-volume mid-market pipelines

 - You’re fluent in data: You can turn spreadsheets and datasets into decisions and pitches

 - You can forecast: You set targets and build pipeline forecasts your team can trust

 - You get stuff done: You move with urgency and build repeatable processes in a fast-changing startup

 - Bonus points if you know the sector: You’ve sold into the NHS, primary care or the public sector 




WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?

You’ll join a high-performing team on a mission to solve healthcare productivity, building a platform used by around 300k NHS staff every week, supporting the care of over 50 million NHS patients every year. We set a high bar, move fast, and give people the ownership and support to do the best work of their careers

 - £75,000 - £95,000 salary, plus a discretionary recognition bonus for exceptional performance and impact, nominated by managers and awarded by our leadership team

 - Equity: £30,000 in equal share options, so you share in the value you help create

 - Benefits to suit you: adjust your healthcare cover, your pension or life insurance, whatever stage you’re at in life

 - Built for collaboration: We are an office-first culture and ask that you’re in our (dog-friendly) Shoreditch office for a minimum of 3 days a week

 - Close to our users: Regular hackathons, plus dedicated time to visit GP practices and other healthcare settings to see first-hand how our products are used

 - Time off: You’ll get 28 days of holiday (plus bank holidays) and up to 4 weeks to work from anywhere per year

 - Support at home: We offer enhanced parental leave, fertility support and parental loss support

 - We have our very own chefs: Free healthy breakfasts, snacks and lunches, plus a weekly sweet treat

title: Account Manager
description:
ABOUT US:
AI NEEDS A NEW INFRASTRUCTURE LAYER. WE'RE BUILDING IT AT MODAL.

Every era of computing brought new workloads that previous infrastructure couldn't support: mainframes, databases, and the cloud. Each time, the company that rebuilt the layer underneath defined the decade. AI is no different, except it touches everything instead of one slice, and the window to build the layer underneath it is open right now.


Our customers include category-defining companies like Ramp https://modal.com/blog/how-ramp-built-a-full-context-background-coding-agent-on-modal, Cognition, DoorDash, and Suno. They rely on Modal for instant GPU access, sub-second container starts, and native storage, so it's simple to serve low-latency inference, fine-tune models, and access production-ready sandboxes at scale.


We've passed $1B in annualized run rate, up 15x from a year ago. In October 2026 we raised a $750M Series D led by Accel at a $15.75B valuation.


Our team includes creators of popular open-source projects (e.g.,Seaborn https://github.com/mwaskom/seaborn,Luigi https://github.com/spotify/luigi), academic researchers, international olympiad medalists, and experienced engineering and product leaders with decades of experience.




THE ROLE

This is a commercial role with a revenue target. You’ll be measured on retention and expansion across your accounts. While you won’t be delivering the technical recommendations and implementation, the work is technical by nature. Our customers are engineers running GPU workloads, inference, and batch jobs in production, and you’ll be a credible partner in those conversations.

The profile we’re hiring is a technical account manager. You’ve worked at companies that are deeply technical and consumption in nature. You bring the commercial instincts to grow revenue from an existing base and enough technical depth to know which conversation actually matters. And you can work credibly with everyone from a CxO to a Developer.

What the role is

 - An early seat. You’re helping build the AM function with us, not joining one that already runs. The account plans, expansion motions, and customer cadence this team figures out are what we scale to every AM we hire after you

 - A technical customer-facing role. You’ll work directly with Developers and ML teams on what they’re building and how Modal fits. You translate and triage the deeper technical work to FDEs and Product when it’s needed

 - A book of business. You’ll own a set of accounts and be responsible for the revenue that comes from them. Expect to be meeting with customers in your first few days because the best playbooks are built from real experiences

What the role is not

 - A traditional post-sales role. You’re measured on revenue, not health scores

 - An on-call support function. You’re not fixing bugs or triaging tickets. You’re growing accounts

 - A technical delivery role. You’re not implementing for the customer. You know where the technical work goes and you pull in the right people

 - A fully built motion. Much of this is still being built. If you spot gaps in process, tooling, or a playbook, you help build them

 - A single-lane job. Our priorities go customer → company → team → self. We focus on delivering maximum impact vs. “this is my job”

 


WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON:

 - Build Modal’s account management function and iterate on it as we scale the business

 - Own and deliver on a revenue target across your book of accounts

 - Grow an account’s first use case, expand into a second, and drive standardization across the Modal platform

 - Get fluent enough in Modal to engage confidently with engineering teams on their workloads, and know when to pull in FDEs, Support, or Product

 - Work with Sales, Solutions Architects, FDEs, Support, and Product to grow accounts and feed customer signal back into the roadmap

 - Travel to customers as needed to support key accounts and find expansion opportunities

 


YOU MAY BE A FIT IF:

 - You’ve owned a revenue target or supported one in a highly technical, consumption business.

 - You work autonomously with Developers through CxOs and understand the core parts of the developer tech stack.

 - You’re hands on building with AI tools, not just consuming workflows that were built for you.

 - You treat your book of business and your projects as your own. You’re highly organized, bringing stability, predictability, and pace to your work, and you’re comfortable taking action without waiting for direction.

 - You’d rather start something today than pick it up tomorrow. You move fast, take the learnings, and iterate on them.

 - You’re low ego, easy to work with, and highly accountable. You ask for feedback, you act on it, and you’d rather be corrected early than right late. Internal teams love working with you.

If you don’t match every point above but the role sounds like yours, we’d still like to hear from you.



NICE-TO-HAVE:

 - Experience as a Technical Account Manager, Solutions Engineer, Solutions Consultant, or similar type role

 - Certification as an engineer (ex. Computer Science Degree, Professional Bootcamps)

 - Early GTM hire experience at a fast-growing startup

 - You’ve sat close to GPU spend, model training, or inference workloads

title: Senior Operations Representative Compliance
description:
Our Global Structure 
Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
 About the team
 We’re looking for a talented individual to join our Rider Onboarding and Compliance Team. This is a bustling and vibrant team that helps applicants become riders to ensure we have enough riders in the fleet to supply customer demand and proactively ensure riders remain in service and compliant during their time with Deliveroo. This is the perfect opportunity to join an exciting, fast-growing business and expand your operational abilities.
 About the role
 You will report to the Rider Compliance Team Lead and collaborate with the Rider Compliance Team to proactively ensure riders remain in-service and compliant by effectively and efficiently managing compliance pipelines. In collaboration with the Rider Compliance Senior team, you will be responsible for reducing rider downtime resulting from compliance processes and ensuring Deliveroo is compliant with local laws at all times
 What you'll be doing:
 Accurately load riders to compliance sweeps to ensure we have valid and compliant rider information and documentation
 Monitor the rider compliance flows to ensure minimal friction in the process 
 Provide SME compliance knowledge to Deliveroo team to ensure we successfully launch in new markets and our fleet remains compliant
 Manage vendor compliance queues to ensure that compliance cases are reviewed and actioned efficiently
 Develop and provide SME market-specific compliance knowledge to our vendors and internal teams
 Respond to internal and external compliance escalations
 Ensure the Rider Compliance Team process and training documentation is up-to-date
 Provide comprehensive training to new starters and our vendors
 Collaborate with the Compliance Team to identify opportunities for reducing inefficiencies within our processes
 Collaborate with the broader Rider Compliance Team to achieve KPIs and targets 
 Proactively identify, investigate and take appropriate actions to mitigate rider compliance risk within our fleet or processes
 Requirements
 You are proficient in written and spoken English
 You are an excellent and confident communicator
 You are highly organised
 You are detail-oriented
 You are a strong team player
 You are happy working in a fast-paced environment and can easily adapt to change
 You are self-motivated and eager to learn
 You are curious and can challenge processes that aren’t working -- you get to the bottom of things
 You are familiar with G-Sheets or Excel (can maintain complex spreadsheets).
 Experience using Salesforce
 Why Deliveroo
 Our mission is to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. We are transforming the way the world eats and shops by making access to food and products more convenient and enjoyable. We give people the opportunity to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.
 We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of the most rapidly expanding industry in the world. We are still a small team, making a very large impact, looking to answer some of the most interesting questions out there. We move fast, value autonomy and ownership, and we are always looking for new ideas.
 Workplace & Benefits
 At Deliveroo we know that people are the heart of the business and we prioritise their welfare. Benefits differ by country, but we offer many benefits in areas including healthcare, well-being, parental leave, pensions, and generous annual leave allowances, including time off to support a charitable cause of your choice. Benefits are country-specific, please ask your recruiter for more information.
 Diversity, Equity and Inclusion 
At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

title: Strategy & Solutions Lead
description:
About us:

Causaly is redefining how humans acquire knowledge and develop insights in biomedicine. Our AI-powered platform enables researchers and decision-makers to discover and interpret evidence from millions of scientific publications, clinical trials, regulatory documents, and other complex data sources in minutes.

We are building the world’s most advanced biomedical knowledge platform, powered by a high-precision Knowledge Graph and GenAI capabilities. Our technology is already used by leading biopharmaceutical organizations to accelerate drug discovery, improve safety, and drive better decision-making.

Backed by top-tier investors including ICONIQ, Index Ventures, Pentech, and Marathon, we are scaling rapidly and expanding our product suite and market presence. 

About the role

Causaly is hiring a Strategy and Solutions Lead to incubate and validate new growth opportunities at the intersection of AI, data, product, and our pharma and biotech customers across R&D and commercial functions.

This role focuses exclusively on new territory — new capabilities, solution lines, integrations, or market segments — where customer demand goes beyond what our product supports out of the box. The mandate is to turn ambiguous enterprise demand into scalable, repeatable solution plays grounded in real pharma workflows, drive executive decision-making, and then hand those plays into BAU teams once validated.

You will work directly with Causaly’s executive leadership and lead discussions with senior stakeholders across pharma R&D and commercial functions, as well as their data and technology teams, to shape strategic partnerships, solution architecture, and product decisions. You will operate with significant autonomy, owning opportunities from the first strategic conversation through to executive decision and handoff.

Key responsibilities

Own strategic “new territory” decisions

 - Own intake and shaping of strategic enterprise opportunities that require new capabilities, integrations, packaging, or market positioning.

 - Drive executive decisioning on whether to pursue, park, or decline opportunities, with clear rationale, options, and business and technical implications.

 - Maintain a clear boundary between incubation work and BAU; ensure this team is only engaged where something new must be created.

Lead senior R&D and commercial conversations and translate demand into scalable solution paths

 - Lead high-stakes discussions with senior stakeholders across pharma R&D (e.g. Discovery, Translational Science, Clinical Development) and commercial functions (e.g. Portfolio Strategy, New Product Planning, Medical Affairs, Market Access).

 - Ground discovery in customers’ end-to-end workflows and decision points (e.g. target identification and validation, Target Product Profile development, candidate selection, indication expansion, lifecycle management) to define target state, success criteria, and constraints.

 - Translate ambiguous asks into a solution concept and delivery path, including where Causaly creates value in the workflow, scope boundaries, sequencing, timelines, risks, dependencies, and mutual commitments.

 - Shape expectations and commercial framing to ensure scalable commitments (what is standard, what is configurable, what requires investment, and what is out of scope).

Design and steer technical solutions

 - Work with customer architecture, data, IT, and AI teams in working-level depth on Causaly’s platform capabilities, APIs, data model, and integration patterns (e.g. with internal data lakes, knowledge management systems, and enterprise AI tooling), going beyond high-level positioning to a solution design both sides can build against.

 - Drive the solution design for new plays, including integration approach, data flows, security, and deployment model, and work alongside Causaly’s Engineering and Data teams through build, testing, and deployment, without being the engineer writing production code.

 - Pressure-test technical feasibility early: review architectures, spot integration and data risks, and make informed calls on what can be configured, what needs to be built, and what effort it will take.

 - Shape and evaluate technology partnerships (e.g. data providers, cloud and AI platforms, systems integrators), including strategic rationale, technical fit, integration approach, and joint solution design.

 - Represent Causaly’s platform and roadmap credibly in executive and technical forums, clearly positioning what the platform does today, what is configurable, and where it is heading.

Build repeatable solution playbooks (incl. Private Data & integrations)

 - Turn recurring demand into solution playbooks anchored in specific R&D and commercial workflows, including:

 - Offering definition, use cases, and packaging

 - Qualification and fit criteria

 - Scoping templates and success plans

 - Delivery blueprints, reference architectures, and enablement assets

 - Standardise complex offerings (e.g. Private Data, enterprise integrations, and AI workflows on customer data) into productised motions with clear patterns, governance, and pilot-to-rollout pathways.

 - Partner with Product, Engineering, and Data to define feasibility options and reference architectures, and surface clear product and investment recommendations.

Validate plays through lighthouse execution

 - Co-sponsor a small number of lighthouse opportunities with Sales to validate new solution plays.

 - Orchestrate early cross-functional work (pilot design, governance, decisioning) with the explicit goal of making the play transferable and repeatable, not owning delivery long-term.

Institutionalise and hand off into BAU

 - Drive clean handoff of validated plays into BAU (Sales, CS, Delivery, Product), including training, assets, decision trees, and ownership clarity.

 - Maintain a structured feedback loop into Product on product candidates, investment needs, and learned constraints from enterpris

Small businesses are the backbone of the economy, and we’re here to help them win. We’ve built a platform that uses clever data to get them the funding they need in minutes, not weeks.

THE ROLE ⚡

📍 London (Hybrid) | 🤝 3 days in the office | 💰 Competitive Salary + Benefits



Bringing together our RevOps & AI automations team, you will be improving capabilities for all of the customer facing teams. You’ll work across a mix of AI and traditional GTM tools to help our sales teams work faster and more effectively than ever before.



 - Own the KPI suite, the dashboards and the weekly performance reporting for Sales, Service and Collections. Set the analytics standard across the customer-facing teams, and ensure that every metric earns its place and drives business outcomes.

 - Own the RevOps build roadmap and act as both product manager and builder on it: AI-assisted quality assurance and coaching tooling, call transcription and conversational intelligence on Amazon Connect Contact Lens, and the automations that take manual work off managers. 

 - With your unique perspective across the customer-facing teams, you will identify and prioritise initiatives for the team that drive real business value. 

 - Identify and execute operational efficiency gains across sales and contact-centre processes.

 - Drive team adoption of tools and best practices to directly increase conversion and productivity.

 - Act on customer insight and drive improvements to customer journeys across the teams. This isn't just producing the reports, you will own the next action and the outcome.

 - Lead a high-performing RevOps team while scaling the function into strategic new focus areas across the revenue engine.




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR 🌱

 - A track record of unlocking actionable insights that drive revenue growth, with the ability to translate data into business strategy.

description:
Our Global Structure 
Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
 The Team 
 Deliveroo is on a mission to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders.
 Our Grocery & Retail team manages Deliveroo’s Grocery and non-food Retail businesses. We work closely with our partners and cross-functional teams to drive growth, strengthen the customer proposition and improve business performance.
 As the scale and complexity of Grocery & Retail continues to grow, the Strategy & Performance function plays a central role in setting market strategy, leading business planning, embedding strong performance management and ensuring we continue to improve the customer experience.
 The Role 
 The Head of Strategy & Performance, New Verticals - Middle East is responsible for setting the strategic direction of Deliveroo’s Grocery and non-food Retail business and ensuring we translate that strategy into measurable growth and performance.
 This is a high-impact leadership role with significant exposure to senior local and global stakeholders, sitting at the centre of some of the most important decisions shaping the future of Grocery & Retail in the Middle East. You will work closely with the Director of Grocery & Retail and wider leadership team across strategy, business planning, performance, customer value proposition and high-priority cross-functional initiatives.
 You will lead two core functions: Strategy & Performance and Category Management, setting their direction, building strong teams and bringing together data, customer insight and commercial context to determine where we should focus, what needs to change and how we deliver against our ambitions. Through Category Management, you will shape the customer proposition across key levers including conversion, selection, catalogue quality, pricing, promotions and merchandising, ensuring priorities translate into tangible improvements across the customer journey.
 The role combines big-picture strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You will need to be equally comfortable defining long-term priorities, diagnosing why the business is performing the way it is, influencing senior stakeholders and getting into the details to unblock complex initiatives.
 You will directly manage the Strategy & Performance Manager and Senior Category Manager, with the wider Category Management team also sitting within your organisation.
 Roles & Responsibilities: 
• Own Grocery & Retail strategy and planning: Set the strategic direction for Grocery and non-food Retail, lead annual and quarterly planning, identify and size the biggest growth opportunities, and partner closely with Finance to translate strategic priorities into financial plans, business cases and clear targets.
• Drive business performance: Own the overall performance framework for Grocery & Retail, ensuring leadership understands what is driving performance and where action is required. Set the direction for WBRs, MBRs and performance diagnostics, and build a strong culture of accountability and follow-through.
• Shape the customer proposition and Category Management agenda: Own the overarching CVP strategy and set the direction for Category Management across key levers including selection, availability, pricing, promotions, merchandising, catalogue quality and conversion. Ensure priorities are grounded in customer behaviour, commercial performance and competitor insights.
• Lead high-impact strategic initiatives: Take ownership of complex, cross-functional opportunities and problems that do not naturally sit within one team, from initial diagnosis and strategic direction through to alignment, delivery and handover into BAU.
• Lead and develop high-performing teams: Lead the Strategy & Performance and Category Management functions, directly managing the Strategy & Performance Manager and Senior Category Manager. Set clear priorities, coach and develop the team, and build the capabilities, tools and operating models needed for both functions to scale effectively.
• Influence senior stakeholders and shape decisions: Act as a strategic partner to the Director of Grocery & Retail and wider leadership team, representing Grocery & Retail in key local and central discussions and shaping decisions on the business’s most important strategic priorities.
 Qualifications: 
• 6+ years of experience in Strategy & Operations, strategy, consulting, investment banking, commercial, growth or business operations, ideally in a high-growth technology, marketplace or startup environment; experience in on-demand delivery, Grocery, Retail or digital category management is a strong advantage.
• Strong commercial and analytical judgement, with the ability to understand business performance, diagnose root causes and make clear recommendations grounded in data and commercial context.
• Strong ability to structure ambiguity, taking broad or loosely defined business problems, framing the problem clearly, identifying the right questions and translating them into a practical strategy and execution plan.
• Strong influencer and relationship builder, able to bring senior and cross-functional stakeholders on the journey, communicate in a way that resonates with different audiences and drive alignment without relying on formal authority.
• Proven end-to-end execution capability, including mobilising the right teams and resources, securing investment or headcount where needed, removing blockers and driving complex initiatives through to measurable outcomes.
• Proven people leadership experience, with the ability to set clear direction, develop high-performing teams, coach managers and build the capabilities and ways of working needed

description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.



Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:



 - Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

 - Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

 - Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register http://app.n8n.cloud/register.



We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.



Your main goal will be to empower n8n enterprise users to treat automation as software, enabling them to develop, deploy, and scale mission-critical workflows with absolute confidence.



To do so, you’ll own product strategy and execution for n8n’s Enterprise team, focused on application lifecycle management, developer tools, and production-grade workflow operations:




WORKFLOW LIFECYCLE MANAGEMENT

 - Define how teams move workflows from development to production with clear environment separation and promotion paths.

 - Shape capabilities for workflow version history, rollback, branching, and conflict resolution.

 - Build product experiences that help engineering teams safely manage changes across mission-critical automations.
   
   


ENTERPRISE DEVELOPER EXPERIENCE

 - Own Git-based source control workflows that make n8n fit naturally into modern software development practices.

 - Work closely with Engineering and Design to deliver powerful yet intuitive tools for technical teams.

 - Translate complex developer workflows into product experiences that feel reliable, scalable, and easy to adopt.
   
   


PRODUCTION OPERATIONS AND OBSERVABILITY

 - Build visibility into workflow performance, usage, and reliability across environments and instances.

 - Define how enterprise teams manage external secrets, variables, and configuration across deployments.

 - Help customers operate n8n at scale through multi-instance management and cross-instance visibility.
   
   


PRODUCT DISCOVERY AND CROSS-FUNCTIONAL LEADERSHIP

 - Deeply engage with enterprise customers, engineering leaders, admins, and developers to understand their software delivery needs.

 - Prioritize ruthlessly across technical depth, usability, enterprise readiness, and long-term platform leverage.

 - Align Engineering, Design, Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and leadership through clear strategy, specs, and communication.
   
   


REQUIREMENTS




MUST-HAVES

 - Proven product management experience: You’ve shipped complex technical products in enterprise environments and can point to lessons learned that shaped your craft.

 - Strong developer empathy: You understand how engineering teams build, test, version, deploy, and operate software in production.

 - Thrive in ambiguity: You bring structure to fuzzy technical problems and prioritize clearly across many possible directions.

 - Exceptional product sense: You anticipate edge cases, second-order effects, and enterprise-grade reliability needs without needing perfect information.

 - Ownership and bias for action: You fix what’s broken, ship, learn, and iterate rather than over-plan.

 - Influence without authority: You align engineering, design, data, sales, solutions engineering, customer success, and docs through clarity and trust.

 - Technical product judgment: You’re comfortable making tradeoffs across usability, scalability, security, reliability, and implementation complexity.


NICE-TO-HAVES

 - Git and source control experience: You’ve worked on or closely with products involving Git, branching, versioning, pull requests, or conflict resolution.

 - Enterprise security experience: You understand secrets management, environment variables, access control, or secure configuration patterns.

 - Observability experience: You’ve worked on products involving monitoring, usage insights, performance visibility, or operational dashboards.

 - Coding or SQL skills: You can code, write SQL, or go deep enough technically to partner effectively with engineers on architecture-level discussions.

 - Remote work experience: You’re familiar with remote-first work environments and can collaborate effectively across time zones.

 - Entrepreneurial or early-stage experience: You’ve worn many hats and can navigate in many areas at once.



Why join us?

At n8n, your work won’t disappear into a slide deck. You’ll shape how engineering teams build, version, deploy, and operate mission-critical automations at scale — turning n8n into the platform where automation is treated with the same rigor as software. You’ll join a fast-growing, remote-first team with high autonomy, strong technical ambition, and direct visibility into enterprise customer impact.

Sound like a challenge you’re excited to take on?

Apply now — and help us build the future of automation.



n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.

 AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit www.alpha-sense.com . Come join us. 
 Location: Eastern or Central Time Zone (Remote); NYC preferred (Hybrid) 
 Reports To: Sales Director by Vertical 
 About the Team: 
 The extraordinary AlphaSense Sales team is split into two parts: Financial Services and Corporates. The Financial Services Sales Team focuses on sales to hedge funds, asset management, investment banking, and private equity. The Corporate Sales team is verticalized with a focus on the Fortune 1000 in the following sectors: Life Sciences, Technology, Media, and Telecom, Energy and Industrials, Consulting, and Consumer Packaged Goods. Both the Financial Services and Corporate sales teams have Enterprise and Mid-Market sales professionals, and there is an additional corporate team of sales professionals focused exclusively on Investor Relations. 
 About the Role: 
 We are looking for an experienced, entrepreneurial, driven and accomplished new business sales professional to join our growing Corporate Sales team. With a track record of sales success, you’ll focus on selling to top Fortune 1000 companies, specifically the largest and most matrixed organizations. This role offers a high level of ownership within your book of business, driving the overall account strategy in partnership with SDR’s and sales leadership. This is an opportunity to join a high growth company and sell an award winning product that is experiencing rapid adoption across all industry verticals. The person in this role will make a major contribution in the company’s growth and future success. 
 Who You Are: 
• An experienced seller! You have previous experience owning a book of new business, ideally selling into enterprise clients. You have a strong track record of success in a SaaS sales environment and can clearly communicate a drive to understand our customers and sales cycle. 
• You understand Sales is both art and science, and clearly can articulate your version of the “science of sales”. 
• Hard-working and possess a ‘never give up’ attitude: We have a highly motivated team and a winning culture. We look for people who possess a natural tenacity and desire to succeed. 
• A Strong Communicator: You have the skills necessary to explain complex financial data and concepts to a non-financial audience. You’re a storyteller with the ability to communicate present and future value to folks at all levels within an organization. 
• A Hunter: You are constantly working to drive pipeline through your own efforts, in addition to the support of our SDR and Marketing teams. 
• Intellectually Curious: You know the right questions to ask and how to uncover business challenges at all levels of an organization. 
• Coachable: You will have the opportunity to advance your career through robust training and development programs at AlphaSense. An openness to feedback and desire for constant improvement is key to success here. 
• Tenacious: You thrive in environments where you can be creative to get things done! 
 What You’ll Do: 
• Take responsibility for the end-end sales processes in your territory, targeting folks in Corporate Strategy, Competitive Intelligence, Business Development, Investor Relations, and M&A. 
• Research opportunities, prospect, initiate discussions, build relationships, conduct demos, manage product trials, and most importantly: close deals! This is an end-to-end new business sales role and no task is too small or too large. 
• Partner with our SDR team to create prospecting plans and drive pipeline. 
• Forecast accurately and develop the necessary pipeline to meet/exceed quota. 
• Work closely with our Product Specialist team during trials to ensure client engagement and ultimate purchase. 
• Work closely with Account Management to ensure customer health throughout the contract term, as well as closing down sourced upsell and cross-sell opportunities. 
• Gather and distribute product feedback from clients and prospects to the sales and product teams to help us continually enhance our product offerings.

WE’RE ON A MISSION TO BACK THE UK’S SMALL BUSINESSES LIKE NO ONE ELSE 🚀

Small businesses are the backbone of the economy, and we’re here to help them win. We’ve built a platform that uses clever data to get them the funding they need in minutes, not weeks.



At Funding Circle, we have the restless energy of a fintech start-up with the stability of a public company. It’s a unique mix that gives Circlers the autonomy to take ownership and the scale to make an impact that truly counts.



We’re a high-performing team that chooses to lift each other up. We challenge, we champion, and we have each other’s backs -  because we know that when we stand together, we move faster and build better.



The impact is real: Last year alone, the businesses on our platform generated £7.2bn for the UK economy 📈 Come and join a mission that matters!

[Read our Impact Report https://www.fundingcircle.com/uk/impact] | [See our Trustpilot https://uk.trustpilot.com/review/fundingcircle.com]




THE ROLE ⚡

📍 London (Hybrid) | 🤝 3 days in the office | 💰 Competitive Salary + Benefits

 

You’ll make a real difference for our customers and your team from day one. We believe the fastest way to learn is by doing, so we give you the ownership to run with things and see the results of your work in real-time.

 

 - Managing daily payment runs across our bespoke internal systems, handling both inbound and outbound transactions (Direct Debits, Open banking, Card payments, Faster payments, and bank transfers).

 - Spotting unusual payment patterns and irregular account behaviour— applying an immediate solution while working with our tech teams on permanent system fixes.

 - Mastering the end-to-end flow of money across our various products (including Term Loans and FlexiPay), knowing exactly how to handle and route payment exceptions.

 - Carrying out daily operational checks and authorising internal and external transactions correctly, ensuring our data aligns perfectly to prevent any breaks between internal ledgers and bank accounts.

 - Working closely with the AML and Financial Crime teams —supplying the AML team with the transaction data they need for daily checks, and ensuring preventative measures are actioned at the request of the Fraud team.

 - Keeping our processes fully compliant with regulatory standards, focusing on FCA guidelines and CASS (Client Money) rules.

 - Liaising with teams across the business, including Capital Market Operations, Collections, and Customer Success.

 - Answering payment queries from internal colleagues and external colleagues clearly and efficently.

 


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR 🌱

We value deep expertise, but a growth mindset and good energy are what really make our team click. We’re a group that chooses to lift each other up and think smart every day.

 

 - A sharp eye for detail: A meticulous approach to checking figures and ledgers in a fast-paced environment where minor mistakes have a direct financial impact.

 - Comfortable with data: Happy looking at transactional data to spot trends, anomalies, or system drops, using Excel or basic data dashboards.

 - Practical problem-solving: The ability to track down ambiguous payment exceptions and handle manual workarounds calmly when things don't go to plan.

 - Operations experience: Background working in a high-volume transactional environment (e.g. Fintech, payment processing, retail banking, or busy financial administration).

 - CASS or Client Money awareness: A good baseline understanding of safeguarding client funds and working within an FCA-regulated environment.

 - Able to proactively identify ways to use Generative AI to streamline your daily tasks and improve your personal productivity

 - Confident using approved AI tools safely and effectively to enhance your output and find a better way of working

We’re building a place where everyone truly feels they belong. Even if your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every requirement, we'd still love to hear from you.




WHY JOIN US? 💜

We back you to build an incredible career and by joining us, you'll be part of one of The Sunday Times Best Companies to Work For 2026! As a flexible-first employer, we use a "best of both" approach. We’ll see you in our London office to collaborate – with barista coffee and subsidised Just Eat lunches on us!

Our Circler Proposition focuses on five areas:

 - Flexibility: We provide a benefit allowance you can tailor to your own life and family.

 - Health: This includes private medical and dental, health assessments, and access to a digital GP.

 - Wealth: We offer life assurance, share schemes, and financial coaching.

 - Development: You get a dedicated annual learning allowance to help you level up.

 - Lifestyle: We have electric car and cycle-to-work schemes, plus season ticket loans.

We also have award-winning parental leave policies. We're here to support you through the big life moments, from fertility treatments to new additions to the family.




READY TO JOIN A MISSION THAT MATTERS? WE’D LOVE TO CHAT!

title: Account Executive, Corporate Global Sales (EMEA)
location: London, Greater London, England, United Kingdom
description:
About AlphaSense: 
 AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit www.alpha-sense.com . Come join us. 
 About the Team: 
 The AlphaSense Corporate Sales team is verticalized, with a focus on the world's largest companies across Life Sciences, Technology, Media and Telecom, Energy and Industrials, and Consumer Packaged Goods. The newly formed Global Accounts team sits at the intersection of our regional and strategic teams. It is built around multinational corporates with a material presence on both sides of the Atlantic, where a combined account strategy delivers the most value to our customers and company.
 Account Executives on the Global Accounts team work in cross-region pairs, with an Americas-based and an EMEA-based AE jointly owning a shared set of accounts. Together, you will build one territory vision, partner on account strategy and business cases, and drive adoption bottom up and top down across both regions.
 About the Role: 
 We are looking for an experienced, entrepreneurial, and accomplished seller to join our Global Accounts team as an Account Executive based in EMEA. You will be the primary owner for a book of multinational accounts headquartered or led from EMEA that have significant teams, users, and buying centers in the Americas. You will partner day to day with your Americas-based counterpart, who leads the accounts headquartered in the Americas and the regional relationships on the accounts you lead, to grow AlphaSense across the whole organization.
 This is a high-ownership, end-to-end role. You will combine a strategic account planning motion (executive relationships, business cases, multi-stakeholder and multi-region deal cycles) with the hands-on work of growing large accounts and opening new ones. You will proactively prospect into new accounts and business units, not just manage inbound interest.
 Success in this role is built on people. You will identify and develop champions across business units, functions, and regions, and equip them to advocate for AlphaSense internally. You will be expected to get in front of customers: onsite visits, executive briefings, and team workshops, in partnership with your Americas-based counterpart, are a core part of how we earn trust and accelerate deals. You will turn that access into results through disciplined execution: clear mutual action plans, tight follow-through on trials and next steps, and a regular rhythm of account reviews with your partner and leadership.
 What You’ll Do: 
• Own the strategy and execution for your book of EMEA-led global accounts , partnering with your Americas-based counterpart on the accounts they lead where your presence and relationships can accelerate the deal.
• Build and maintain a joint account plan with your Americas-based partner for every shared account, aligned on stakeholders, whitespace, deal timing, and a single global business case.
• Build executive-level relationships and champions across Corporate Strategy, Competitive Intelligence, Business Development, M&A, and Investor Relations, and expand into new functions and business units.
• Grow your accounts through upsell, cross-sell, and new use cases, and open new accounts and business units alongside your existing book.
• Run the full sales cycle, from prospecting through demos, trials, and close, in partnership with our SDR, Product Specialist, and Account Management teams.
• Forecast accurately and build the pipeline needed to meet and exceed your quota.
• Become an expert on corporate customer needs and use cases, market dynamics, the competitive landscape, and product differentiation within your vertical.
• Gather and share product feedback from customers and prospects with the sales and product teams.
 Travel Expectations 
 Willingness to travel regularly for customer meetings, onsite engagements, and team collaboration is an expectation of this role. Flexibility to travel as needed to advance opportunities, strengthen customer relationships, and drive revenue growth is essential.
 Who You Are: 
• Thinks strategically. You put your time where there is real buying intent and access to decision-makers, and you build plans by working backwards from what success looks like for the customer.
• Builds relationships. You have a strong record of account mapping, multi-threading, and building relationships with senior executives and champions across large, matrixed organizations. You can explain complex business data and concepts to a non-research audience and tell the story of present and future value to people at all levels. [Additional European language skills are a plus.]
• Grows accounts. You have taken accounts from low five or six figures to much larger through expansion, cross-sell, and new use cases, ideally in a SaaS or comparable enterprise sales environment.
• Opens new doors. You crack open new accounts and new business units while still running a book, through your own proactive prospecting alongside the support of our SDR and Marketing teams.
• Brings grit and hustle. You stay with it and deliver consistently, quarter after quarter. You are coachable, intellectually curious, and thrive where you can
