title: Senior Product Manager - Fraud
location: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within Canada or United States
description:
Holds. Limits. Locks. Closures. The judicious use of these tools is designed to protect good customers. But if wielded maladroitly, good customers get entangled in unnecessary friction, burden our operations teams, and may become detractors and churn. At Mercury, we believe banking* should be empowering and seamless, not difficult, confusing, or stressful.
 As a Product Manager for Fraud, you’ll build products that enable Mercury to master these tools and deftly balance customer experience with fraud prevention. You'll develop a deep understanding of our customers, their accounts, and our money movement products to build systems that protect our customers and Mercury from fraud. You’ll work cross-functionally to build products for both end users and internal risk teams that enable Mercury to provide a seamless and safe banking* experience.
 We are looking for someone who can lead us in redefining how risk friction is used, measured, and optimized to unlock the seamless, magical banking* experience we believe is possible. 
 *Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC. 
 What You'll Do:
• Shape the strategy and roadmap for fraud prevention across your area, from account integrity or money movement to the decisions, controls, and experiences that protect customers
• Design and execute on the strategic vision to mitigate fraud and improve risk experience at Mercury - including holds, limit structures, step-up verification, and related friction points
• Craft user journeys that apply appropriate friction based on risk signals while minimizing disruption to good users
• Build operational and platform tooling to enable our risk and support teams to efficiently manage case volume, exceptions and high-touch cases
• Partner with data science to develop, deploy, and continuously improve ML models 
• Establish and track metrics that measure both risk effectiveness, operational, and customer experience impact
• Support the development of Mercury's risk capabilities to scale across our expanding product suite
 What You Bring:
• 7+ years of relevant product management experience, including experience within fraud or risk in banking or fintech environments
• Deep customer empathy and understanding of how risk friction impacts user experience, growth and retention
• Experience working with complex automated decisioning systems, rules, ML models, real-time data pipelines
• Proficiency with analytics. An ability to understand performance or rules and ML models, trade-offs with precision/recall and translate understanding into actionable insights and priorities for your teams
• Strong track record of cross-functional leadership, particularly in navigating tradeoffs between risk, compliance, and customer experience priorities
• Exceptional communication skills that allow you to translate complex risk concepts into actionable product strategies
• Comfort with ambiguity and ability to make balanced decisions with imperfect information
 Mercury values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. title: Senior Solution Manager, Customer Journey
description:
At Qualtrics, we create software the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high-performing teams, and design products people love. But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally. Building a category takes grit, determination, and a disdain for convention—but most of all it requires close-knit, high-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers. 
When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the microphone and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.
 Senior Solution Manager, Customer Journey 
 Why We Have This Role 
 At Qualtrics, our Customer Journey function ensures every customer experiences a connected, predictable path from first conversation through adoption, renewal, and expansion. As Senior Solution Manager, you will be the operational architect behind how new products and services reach the market and scale successfully. You will design the business and service processes that make offerings sellable, deliverable, and supportable, serving as the critical bridge connecting our field teams, customers, and Product Management. In this senior individual contributor role, you will lead through influence to bring structure to ambiguity and align cross-functional teams across the entire organization.
 How You’ll Find Success 
• Navigates Ambiguity: Takes initiative in complex, unstructured environments to map clear paths forward and build scalable operational standards.
• Influences Without Authority: Builds trust and drives alignment across senior stakeholders in Sales, Services, Customer Success, Product, and Operations.
• Process Architect Mindset: Obsessed with end-to-end workflow design—identifying handoff risks, reducing friction points, and optimizing quote-to-cash and delivery models.
• Evidence-Based Communicator: Synthesizes complex field and customer insights into concise, actionable feedback that influences product roadmaps and executive decisions.
• Systems & Strategic Thinker: Connects big-picture GTM strategy with hands-on asset creation (scoping tools, playbooks, SOW templates) to enable repeatable execution.
 How You’ll Grow 
• Expand your strategic impact by shaping end-to-end GTM readiness for next-generation enterprise SaaS products across global markets.
• Broaden your executive influence by partnering directly with cross-functional leadership across Sales, Product, Services, and Finance.
• Deepen your operational expertise in scaling enterprise customer lifecycles, engagement frameworks, and SaaS delivery models.
• Develop repeatable frameworks, playbooks, and standards that set the benchmark for product launches company-wide.
 Things You’ll Do 
• Accelerate GTM Product Readiness: Own and execute the end-to-end readiness plan that transitions new products and services from release to repeatable sales and delivery.
• Build Scalable Business & Service Workflows: Design and optimize customer lifecycle processes across quoting, provisioning, implementation, support, and renewal to eliminate operational friction.
• Enable Field Execution: Develop practical sales and delivery assets—including deal qualification guides, scoping tools, pricing references, SOW templates, and delivery playbooks.
• Drive Cross-Functional Alignment & Execution: Manage multi-team project plans, track readiness milestones, mitigate launch risks, and hold stakeholders accountable across Sales, Services, Legal, Deal Desk, and Finance.
• Influence Product Strategy: Establish feedback loops to gather customer and field insights, translating them into structured, evidence-based recommendations for Product Management.
 What We’re Looking For On Your Resume 
• Enterprise SaaS GTM Experience: 15+ years of extensive background in GTM operations, business readiness, services strategy, customer success operations, or product operations within a complex SaaS environment.
• Proven Cross-Functional Program Leadership: Demonstrated track record of managing complex launch plans, dependencies, and risks across multi-disciplinary teams.
• End-to-End Process Mapping: Proven ability to map and optimize complex workflows across quote-to-cash, implementation, and customer onboarding.
• Field & Sales Asset Development: Hands-on experience creating scoping tools, SOW templates, delivery methodologies, and field playbooks.
• Tool & Framework Familiarity: Background with enterprise frameworks and platforms such as Salesforce, Gainsight, Highspot, or similar customer success tools.
• Domain Knowledge (Bonus): Experience with experience management (CX), research technology, or partner/SI delivery models.
 What You Should Know About This Team 
• High-Impact Connective Tissue: We sit at the intersection of Product, Sales, and Operations—directly impacting how our business grows and how customers experience Qualtrics.
• Action-Oriented & Collaborative: We thrive on solving hard operational puzzles together and empowering each other to lead without red tape.
• Standard-Setters: We build the foundational frameworks and playbooks that turn one-off successes into scalable, repeatable global practices.
• Committed to Growth: We actively support continuous learning, professional development, and expanding your leadership footprint across the organization.
 Our Team’s Favorite Perks and Benefits 
• Global Wellness & Flexibility: Competitive time-off policies, flexible working arrangements, and wellness stipends to support work

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
ABOUT US

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

 - We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

 - We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

 - We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

The Role

We’re looking for a senior Product Manager to build user-facing products that impact hundreds of thousands of legal professionals. You’ll have the opportunity to join and lead one of the product teams shaping the core of the Legora platform, working across surfaces like our drafting products, tabular review, task management, and research and regulatory products.

Wherever you land, the mandate is the same: build 0-to-1 products that help revolutionize a legacy profession. You’ll do it inside an AI-native company growing at hyper speed, with the autonomy to take ideas from a blank canvas to products that thousands of lawyers rely on every day. This is a rare chance to define entirely new categories of legal software, not iterate on the old ones.

What You'll Do

 - Own the strategy, roadmap, and execution for one of our core user-facing product areas, such as drafting, tabular review, task management, or research and regulatory products.

 - Build 0-to-1 products and features from the ground up, taking ideas from concept to launch and iterating quickly based on real user feedback.

 - Partner closely with design and engineering to ship polished, AI-native experiences with a strong bar for craft.

 - Deeply understand how legal professionals work, and translate their needs into intuitive, opinionated product decisions.

 - Use AI as a core building block, shaping how legal professionals work with and trust AI in their day-to-day.

 - Run experiments, instrument the right metrics, and turn data and qualitative insight into a prioritized roadmap.

 - Move fast in a high-growth environment, balancing speed with quality and a relentless focus on user impact.


What You Bring

 - An experienced, senior Product Manager with a strong background building user-facing products at high-growth B2B SaaS companies.

 - A track record of building 0-to-1 products that have had a major impact on users.

 - Hands-on experience building AI-native products, where AI is a central part of the experience.

 - Strong product judgment and the ability to balance qualitative insight with quantitative rigor.

 - Excellent collaboration skills, with a history of partnering tightly with design, engineering, and other functions to ship products.

 - A genuine interest in revolutionizing a legacy profession and making complex software feel simple, fast, and enjoyable.

 - High standards, low ego, and a bias toward ownership and outcomes.

Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer

At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

 Global Genie Sales Leader 
 We are looking for a highly strategic and execution-oriented Genie Global Leader to lead a team of specialists responsible for growing the Databricks Genie business globally.
 Databricks Genie extends the Data Intelligence Platform into conversational AI through Genie One , delivering a true AI co-worker for non-technical business teams and leaders. By grounding query accuracy in business context through the Genie One Ontology , Genie One enables enterprise decision-makers to effortlessly query, analyze, and extract trusted insights directly from governed enterprise data using natural language. This role sits at the center of a major shift in enterprise architecture as organizations move away from fragmented stacks consisting of legacy BI tools, static dashboards, and separate AI interfaces toward a unified, conversational data platform powered by enterprise context.
 You will lead a team of specialists partnering with Account Executives, Solution Architects, and Sales Leadership to help customers modernize their business intelligence, democratize data access across non-technical users, and operationalize conversational AI in production analytics workflows. This role requires both strong sales leadership and the ability to establish and scale a new sales motion across a global field organization.
 This is a highly visible global role across Sales, Product, and Engineering, and will help define how Databricks engages business intelligence leaders, data leaders, and non-technical business stakeholders at scale.
 The impact you will have: 
• Drive Revenue Growth
• Build and exceed quarterly and annual consumption and booking targets for Genie
• Develop pipeline across legacy BI migration, AI-driven business intelligence, and enterprise-wide data access opportunities.
• Help customers replace or modernize legacy BI tools and point solutions by establishing Databricks as their primary conversational analytics platform
• Establish repeatable sales plays that drive land and expand adoption 
• Lead and Develop a Specialist Team
• Recruit, hire, and develop a high-performing team of Genie Sales Specialists
• Coach the team on complex deal strategy, technical qualification, and executive engagement
• Create a culture of accountability, customer focus, and operational excellence
• Partner with regional sales leadership to integrate specialists into account plans and territory strategies
• Strategic Customer and Partner Engagement
• Establish executive relationships with corporate executives, CIOs, CTOs, Chief Architects, platform leaders, and technical decision makers
• Position Databricks as an application data platform in addition to a data and AI platform
• Support strategic customers pursuing application modernization or real-time digital transformation initiatives
• Collaborate with cloud providers, SIs, and ISVs to accelerate adoption
• Influence Product and GTM Strategy
• Act as the voice of the field to Product and Engineering teams
Provide structured feedback on customer requirements, competitive dynamics, and market adoption patterns
• Partner with Product Marketing to refine messaging, positioning, and competitive differentiation
• Help shape Databricks’ long-term AI/BI and enterprise data intelligence platform strategy
 What we look for: 
• 15+ years of experience in enterprise software, SaaS, cloud platform, or developer platform sales
• 5+ years of experience leading high-performing enterprise sales or specialist teams
• Demonstrated success building new categories or scaling new product businesses
• Previous Sales experience in fast paced innovative start up companies in domains such as cowork, search and ai/bi and conversational ai.

title: Head of Strategy & Operations, Retail, New Verticals
description:
Our Global Structure 
Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
 The Role: 
 We are on a mission to revolutionise the retail e-commerce industry. We are a tech-driven company, committed to delivering innovative solutions that redefine the shopping experience for millions of customers worldwide. We are at the forefront of something massive, and we're looking for an experienced leader who can help us shape the future of retail e-commerce.
 Retail (non-food Shopping) is how Deliveroo and Wolt grow beyond restaurants and grocery. As the Head of Retail, Strategy & Operations , you will lead the direction of Deliveroo and Wolt’s newest vertical. Reporting to the Director of Strategy & Operations, New Verticals EMEA, you will shape our approach across commercial, operations, marketing and customer experience. This role owns the strategy and operating rhythm for the business: where we play, which retailers we need in each market, whether they succeed after launch, and whether revenue and profit are on the plan.
 This is an individual contributor (IC) role, meaning you won’t have any direct reports. You will set the agenda that Product, Commercial, Marketing, Operations, and country teams execute, and you will need to work cross-functionally with teams to ensure plans are delivered.
 The NV Strategy & Operations team is responsible for the end-to-end strategy and performance management of New Verticals EMEA as a whole, including target-setting, goals and OKRs, and the weekly and monthly business reviews. Within that, this role owns the Retail strategy.
 The role is hybrid in London, with 3 days per week in the office and potential for quarterly travel to offices in the US and EMEA as required.
 Responsibilities: 
• Define our future strategy for Retail, including "where we play" and "how we win" to grow revenue and drive customer acquisition.
• Identify future elements of our customer and partner value proposition and the required capabilities to deliver them in collaboration with the NV tech teams, and lead deployment of these across EMEA.
• Establish a roadmap to becoming the preferred delivery provider for our Retail partners. Develop an understanding of Retail partner needs and advocate for them across teams.
• Ensure detailed implementation plans are developed across markets and teams, with a strong follow-up on execution through robust tracking and issue resolution.
• Lead delivery of revenue growth by identifying partner growth levers for Retail and supporting local teams to deploy them across their partner portfolios.
• Manage the P&L and all financial investments to realise or exceed our annual financial goals. Set annual plans including resource allocation, budgets and market targets for the EMEA portfolio.
• Lead performance management and forecasting routines to ensure in-year delivery and course-correction to meet revenue and profit targets.
• Support negotiations with the largest partners and ensure teams approach all negotiations following our Retail commercial framework regarding rate structure and return on investment.
• Ensure that local teams can build joint business plans with the most important Retail partners. Collaborate with the global Merchant organisation on the partners with an international footprint.
• Create a compelling vision with a sense of unity and a desire to perform together. Provide reporting, best-practice guides, playbooks and training so teams can run the plan effectively.
• Foster collaboration throughout the organisation, understanding the benefit and importance of central / local collaboration.

• Structured: Brings structure to recurring processes and complex problems. Manages multiple workstreams across regions and follows actions through to closure.
• Influential and collaborative: Builds trust with stakeholders and functional leads. Challenges assumptions and pushes for clear decisions and owners, even when data is incomplete. Adapts their style to the audience and is a trusted advisor to senior partners and teams.
• Commercial and analytical: Connects customer, operational and financial metrics to explain performance. Understands the trade-offs between growth and profitability.
• Solution finding and strategy: Identifies commercial opportunities and issues in complex situations, and turns them into clear commercial choices . 
• Thought-leadership: Uses data and insight from across the market to shape a clear vision for the future that is recognised internally and externally as industry leading.
• Change Management: Role-models a continuous improvement mindset that embraces change and deploys best-practice approaches to win hearts and minds, so changes embed in the organisation.
• Community-Building: A team player who readily collaborates across teams and will sponsor or lead programmes that inspire an engaged, diverse, winning organisation.
 Experience & Skills:

• Experience in grocery, retail or quick commerce is preferred.
• Highly analytical mindset with strong modelling skills, and the ability to break down large data sets and turn them into actionable insights. Comfortable with P&L metrics.
• Experience running performance management processes, such as business reviews, KPI reporting and plan tracking, for senior audiences.

title: Account Executive II (Farmer)
description:
About Flexport: 
 At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. 
 The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.
 The opportunity: 
 The Sales team at Flexport is critical to our mission, fostering deep, lasting relationships that drive client success and accelerate global trade. As an Account Executive II (Farmer), you operate with independence. You own a portfolio of accounts and are the architect of their success — not just the executor of a plan. Your clients are growing in complexity: multiple trade lanes, operational nuance, and real expansion potential. You know Flexport's product suite well enough to connect client needs to solutions with confidence, and you drive revenue growth within your book without being directed. Senior leadership trusts your judgment on the accounts you own. This is where you move from learning the craft to mastering it.
 You will: 
 - Own the success and retention of a portfolio of Flexport clients, managing relationships independently and proactively — you identify problems before clients raise them.
 - Lead all client communications and strategic engagements, including QBRs/MBRs, without requiring support from senior teammates for routine situations.
 - Identify and execute cross-sell and upsell opportunities within your book of business, owning the commercial outcome end-to-end.
 - Collaborate cross-functionally with Operations, Product, Sales, and Implementation to solve client problems with urgency and creativity.
 - Analyze client performance data to spot trends, anticipate risks, and bring data-backed recommendations to every client conversation.
 - Develop a clear point of view on each client's business — not just their Flexport usage, but their supply chain strategy and where Flexport fits.
 - Work closely with Hunters from the beginning of the customer journey to ensure a seamless transition and long-term client success.
 You should have: 
 - 3+ years of experience in account management, direct sales, client success, or a similar client-facing role; logistics, supply chain, or SaaS background preferred.
 - Proven ability to independently manage a portfolio of accounts, with measurable retention and expansion results.
 - A demonstrated track record of identifying and closing cross-sell/upsell opportunities — you move deals forward without being pushed.
 - Strong communication and presentation skills; comfortable leading senior stakeholder conversations without support.
 - Data literacy: you pull insights from client metrics and use them to drive conversations and decisions.
 - A 'compliance first' attitude to keep our regulators happy and enthusiastic about Flexport since we operate in a heavily regulated industry.
 You will get:
 - Real ownership — your book of business is yours to win, grow, and protect.
 - A seat at the table on cross-functional client strategy work with Sales, Product, and Operations.
 - Access to a growing product suite and the training to position it effectively.
 - Competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and a hybrid work environment.
 The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire base salary for the position in the posting's respective region. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range displayed, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education and / or training. Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at Flexport, which also includes bonus, equity, and comprehensive benefit offerings such as medical, dental, and flexible time off. 
 The US base salary range for this position (this does not include bonus, equity and benefits):
 $67,000 — $92,400 USD

 At Flexport, our ability to fulfill our mission of making global commerce easy and accessible relies on having a diverse, dedicated and engaged workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical and mental disability, health status, marital and family status, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

 Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally. Building a category takes grit, determination, and a disdain for convention—but most of all it requires close-knit, high-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers.

Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the mic and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.

 Why We Have This Role 
 The Technical Customer Manager plays a pivotal part in Qualtrics' success by leading the design, delivery and ongoing success of customer’s experience programs, focused on driving measurable business impact. In this role, you will partner with customers throughout their lifecycle - from program delivery and onboarding to ongoing optimization, adoption and value realization. You will act as the primary technology trusted advisor for your portfolio, leading medium and large-scale software implementations and optimizing our technology to address individual challenges, ultimately building our customers into lifelong Qualtrics champions.

 You will find success by blending exceptional customer and project management skills with a focus on technical platform adoption, renewals, and expansion. You will lead project teams to deliver complex programs within our specific Industry Verticals and Region, ensuring your customers deepen and broaden their usage of the platform. By influencing customers to shape their feedback programs and being resourceful when facing challenges, you will drive leading indicators of success, value realization, and Net ARR growth.

• Develop commercial and portfolio leadership: By proactively monitoring account health and defining expansion strategies, you will move beyond standard project execution to directly drive portfolio performance, value realization, and account growth.
• Expand your cross-functional and industry footprint: You will act as the critical bridge collaborating internally with project managers, engineering, account executive and product teams, while deepening your specialized knowledge of significant industry shifts taking place in experience management.

• Portfolio Performance: Monitor portfolio performance using customer health, adoption, maturity and value realisation to proactively manage risk and identify growth opportunities
• Account Growth & Maturity: Define strategy to expand program adoption and maturity across our customer accounts, driving Net ARR and portfolio performance
• Strategic Project Management: Partner with customers to provide expertise leading to the alignment of project goals and timely execution
• Risk & Quality Management: Plan, monitor, and mitigate project risks while developing quality management plans aligned with business requirements
• Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate with internal teams to support your customer’s experience and maintain account health
 What We're Looking For On Your Resume

title: Associate Implementation Consultant
description:
UNLEASH AI INNOVATORS, SECURELY

Software is being rewritten in real time. AI agents are starting to write more code than humans do, at a speed no security team has ever had to match, and that single shift is opening up the biggest opportunity our industry has seen in a decade. We're not bracing for it, we're building the company that owns it.

Snyk is building the next generation security platform where security isn't a set of tools people operate.  It's a team of security agents working alongside your engineers, finding, fixing, and governing risk at the speed software is now built. These agents work alongside both the company build and the agents they adopt. Security stops being a queue of work waiting for people, and becomes a coordinated workforce companies direct and trust.

Job Summary

Snyk is hiring an Associate Implementation Consultant to help enterprise customers get started with the Snyk platform after the sale. You will support and deliver onboarding engagements, working with customer development and security teams to configure Snyk across their SDLC, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud infrastructure. This is an early-career role for someone with a technical foundation who wants to build a career in customer-facing application security, with hands-on work from your first weeks and structured coaching from experienced consultants along the way.

About the Team

The Customer Solutions team owns the technical success of Snyk's customers after the deal closes, from first onboarding session through full platform adoption. Implementation Consultants work alongside Technical Success, Support, Sales, and Product to turn a customer's security goals into a deployed, measurable program. As Snyk's install base continues to grow, this team is expanding to keep delivering a world-class onboarding experience at scale.

What You’ll Do

 - Deliver onboarding engagements for customers with well-defined requirements, following Snyk's onboarding methodology from kick-off through closure.

 - Support senior consultants on larger and more complex implementations, taking ownership of defined workstreams and learning how enterprise rollouts are planned and run.

 - Configure and integrate the Snyk platform with customer source control, CI/CD, container, and cloud environments, working from documented procedures and escalating questions early.

 - Join customer kick-offs, working sessions, and status reviews, and keep customer contacts informed on progress and next steps.

 - Answer customer questions about how Snyk works, and bring in senior consultants, Support, or Product when an issue needs deeper expertise.

 - Keep accurate project plans, notes, and handoff documentation so every engagement is easy for others to pick up.

 - Use Snyk's onboarding playbooks and templates, and suggest improvements when you find gaps.

 - Troubleshoot common integration and configuration issues, and document what you learn for the rest of the team.

 - Help customer teams understand developer-first security practices so they keep using Snyk after onboarding ends.

 - Build your skills through regular coaching, shadowing, and Snyk's technical training and certification programs.

 - 

What you’ll bring

 - 1+ years in technical consulting, professional services, technical support, or another customer-facing technical role, or equivalent hands-on experience such as an internship or relevant projects.

 - Foundational knowledge of the SDLC and modern DevOps practices, and curiosity about where security fits into both.

 - Familiarity with CI/CD and DevOps tooling (for example Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab, Azure DevOps, Kubernetes), with the motivation to go deeper.

 - Ability to manage your own tasks and deadlines across more than one customer project, with support from your team.

 - The ability to explain technical topics clearly to developers and other technical contacts, in writing and in conversation.

 - Genuine interest in application security and belief that a developer-first approach is the right way to solve it.

 - A collaborative, customer-first approach and a willingness to ask questions, take feedback, and learn quickly.

 - Working fluency with AI-assisted tools (Claude, Gemini, or similar) and comfort with how AI-generated code is changing what customers need to secure.

 - Strong written and verbal communication, plus an organized approach to problem solving.

 - Nice to have: basic proficiency in a scripting language such as Python, JavaScript, or another modern language.

 - Nice to have: prior experience in a support, solutions engineering, or technical account role for AppSec, CI, or DevSecOps products.

 - Nice to have: a security certification such as Security+, CSSLP, or CEH.

 - Nice to have: a Project Management Professional (PMP) or CAPM certification, or equivalent project management coursework.

 - Nice to have: a Computer Science degree or equivalent programming background, and exposure to enterprise-scale web technologies and microservices.


ABOUT SNYK

Snyk is committed to creating an inclusive and engaging environment where our employees can thrive as we rally behind our common mission to make the digital world a safer place. From Snyk employee resource groups, to global benefits that help our employees prioritize their health, wellness, financial security, and a work/life blend, we aim to support our employees along their entire journeys here at Snyk.




EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

Snyk is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

title: Product Manager, Pricing
description:
Our Global Structure 
Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
 We're looking for a Product Manager to own Pricing within our Growth team across Deliveroo and Wolt! This role operates across 40+ markets in EMEA, and sits at the heart of our marketplace: Our fee strategy directly shapes consumer conversion, order frequency, PnL outcomes - and connects deeply to rider earnings and merchant economics across the Globe. You'll be responsible for building a pricing strategy and experimentation roadmap that grows revenue and profitability sustainably, without compromising the customer experience.
 This is a very high-visibility role. You'll partner closely with Leadership, Data Science, Engineering, Finance, Marketing, and Operations to design, launch, and iterate on pricing experiments across all markets, from delivery fee and service fee algorithms to 0-1 new ventures. You'll be expected to build a strong testing culture, translate ambiguous commercial questions into a rigorous experimentation agenda, and communicate results and trade-offs clearly to senior stakeholders. 
 About the Team 
 Our ambition is simple: make our platform an affordable, daily habit for all users.
 The Pricing team builds the systems and experiences that touch every single order — from delivery options to promotions, fees, and entirely new pricing models. Operating across 40+ markets, our work sits at the intersection of customer value, growth, and marketplace economics.
 Small changes at this scale can change how customers perceive us, how often they order, and the economics of the entire marketplace. We bring together consumer psychology, experimentation, data science, economics, and product craft to answer one deceptively difficult question: How do we make every order feel like great value while driving sustainable growth? 
 What You’ll Do 
• Own the end-to-end strategy and roadmap for a portfolio of global pricing products.
• Identify and launch major growth opportunities across affordability, conversion, frequency, revenue, and profitability.
• Drive 0 to 1 big bets through validation, launch, then scale them 100X.
• Partner deeply with Data Science and ML Engineering to design pricing algorithms, experiments, and scalable platform capabilities.
• Develop hypotheses, launch experiments, interpret results, and turn learnings into product strategy.
• Define the metrics and decision frameworks used to evaluate customer value, growth, and marketplace economics.
• Communicate strategy, results, and tradeoffs to senior leaders across DoorDash.
 What We’re Looking For 
 You might be a great fit if you:
• Have significant product management experience building complex consumer, marketplace, growth, or monetization products.
• Are deeply analytical and comfortable using experimentation and data to make high-stakes product decisions.
• Are comfortable working closely with Data Science and ML Engineering on algorithmic or optimization problems.
• Can turn ambiguous commercial questions into clear and executable product hypotheses and roadmaps.
• Can operate as a “conductor” — aligning technical, operational, and business stakeholders and stitching together strategy, execution, and influence across teams.
 Why Join Us? 
 At Deliveroo and Wolt, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving.
 We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

title: Expansion Specialist, Bids & Business Development
description:
The Role
 The UK is making a wholesale shift to AI: government, from the AI Opportunities Action Plan through to the tools the Incubator for AI is putting in front of civil servants, and enterprises racing to put AI to work. Scale wants to play a foundational role in building the reliable AI applications both will run on. Our work spans building custom AI applications that reach millions of users, generating high-quality training data for custom LLMs, and providing upskilling and AI advisory services. We're building our UK business from a standing start, and we need someone with a lot of energy to help it move.
 As an Expansion Specialist, you'll help grow Scale's UK business, partnering with technical stakeholders to identify and win opportunities across public sector (central government and defence & security) and enterprise. Public sector is the main focus, but we're a small UK team and you'll flex onto enterprise opportunities where they matter. The role is UK-focussed to start, with scope to extend into Europe and the Middle East as the team grows. You'll sit at the centre of our go-to-market effort, combining business development groundwork with the bids and tender work that turns an opportunity into a contract. You'll work in a dynamic and often unstructured environment, and you'll learn how big AI programmes get sold and delivered into government and large organisations, working right next to the people doing it.
 This is a technical, commercially minded role. It's a good fit if you're curious about AI and data, can explain technical ideas in simple, precise language, and want real responsibility early.
 What you'll do
• Work with the UK Public Sector Lead, UK leadership, government relations and the wider team on go-to-market strategy across central government, defence & security, and enterprise
• Research target departments and enterprise accounts, map who matters, and build target lists, outreach and pipeline
• Break into UK enterprise: pick the sectors and accounts worth going after, get in front of commercial buyers, and run deals that sit outside public procurement
• Build relationships and partnerships that open routes to new opportunities, from government and ecosystem partners to delivery and channel partners
• Help customers across government and enterprise find impactful AI use cases and shape their vision for AI
• Run framework applications and tenders end to end (PQQs, RFIs, RFPs), and get to know UK public sector procurement properly (G-Cloud, the Digital Marketplace, the main CCS frameworks)
• Develop pitches, proposals and executive-level documents backed by clear business cases, and adapt how we pitch and contract for enterprise, where buyers and cycles look very different from government
• Sit in on customer meetings, answer questions as they come up, and turn them into clear next steps that move an opportunity towards a signed deal
• Take on whatever the market needs. Roles are loose when a team is this small.
 What we're looking for
• At least 5 years in business development, bids, consulting, strategy or advisory, ideally with some 0-to-1 or market-entry exposure. Public sector experience is a plus, not a must.
• A real interest in AI and data, and the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences
• Someone who knows how to use AI tooling well to move faster and work more efficiently across research, analysis and drafting, without compromising on quality
• Seriously organised, good with detail, and able to keep several things moving at once
• Excellent writing, especially to a deadline, including executive-level materials
• Good commercial instincts: you can uncover a customer's challenge and help build the case for how AI addresses it
• The ability to earn trust and build strong working relationships with colleagues and stakeholders
• Plenty of energy, comfort with ambiguity and pace, and no job feels beneath you
• You care about what AI could do for government, public services and industry
• Currently hold, or are eligible for Security Clearance
 Nice to have
• UK public sector procurement, frameworks or tenders
• Experience selling or supporting AI products or services
• Comfortable with CRM and performance reporting tools
• A technical or analytical background
 Why join
 You'd be in at the very start of Scale's UK business, as a founding member of the team. You'll learn how frontier AI is sold and delivered into government and enterprise, work directly with senior people, and get real responsibility fast. It's a strong base for a career in strategy, commercial, product or delivery.
 PLEASE NOTE: Our policy requires a 90-day waiting period before reconsidering candidates for the same role. This allows us to ensure a fair and thorough evaluation of all applicants.

 At Scale, our mission is to develop reliable AI systems for the world's most important decisions. Our products provide the high-quality data and full-stack technologies that power the world's leading models, and help enterprises and governments build, deploy, and oversee AI applications that deliver real impact. We work closely with industry leaders like Meta, Ernst & Young, Mayo Clinic, Time Inc., the Government of Qatar, and U.S. government agencies including the Army and Air Force. We are expanding our team to accelerate the development of AI applications.

title: Global Events Lead
description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a highly motivated Events Lead to own planning and execution of ElevenLabs' flagship events. Your work will deepen ElevenLabs' brand presence, create high-impact moments with customers and prospects, and generate high-quality pipeline in partnership with our GTM teams.

You'll own the full lifecycle of our flagship owned events - summits, experiential activations, marquee sponsorships, and signature brand moments. This role is focused on our flagship event portfolio, distinct from regional field marketing and third-party conference attendance.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Develop and execute flagship event plans aligned with business objectives across key markets

 - Own owned/branded flagship events, and marquee sponsorships (e.g. F1, major industry summits) end to end

 - Collaborate cross-functionally with sales, marketing, product, and GTM teams for seamless execution

 - Analyze event performance and provide recommendations for future improvements

 - Build and maintain relationships with sponsors, partners, agencies, and production vendors across North America
   


REQUIREMENTS

 - 8+ years events experience, with at least three in tech/enterprise flagship event marketing

 - Track record of producing large-scale, high-profile branded events end to end

 - Deep knowledge of the tech ecosystem and executive/enterprise audiences

 - Experience working with premium event agencies and production partners

 - Based in NYC or SF preferred

This strategic role sits in Marketing but requires cross-functional working across Commercial, Customer Analytics, Finance and Product. The ideal candidate is a hands-on operator with a blend of creative thinking and quantitative rigour, alongside a proven track record in optimising promotional performance.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 

 - 

 - Design and manage a comprehensive annual promotional and rewards calendar (e.g., discounts, spend and saves, credit cashback, loyalty rewards) targeted specifically at a variety of customer segments (e.g. low purchase intent, inactive, high-value)

 - Oversee the entire go to market planning of a promotion, from initial concept, modelling/sizing and creative brief through execution across all channels (e.g. promo setup, testing setup, on-site messaging, email, push) and final reporting

 - Work with customer analytics to define and refine customer segments, ensuring promotions are highly personalised and targeted at the optimal time in their lifecycle to drive incrementality

 - Manage the annual budgeting and quarterly re-forecast process, working with customer analytics and finance to ensure both reporting and prediction frameworks are robust, focused on key metrics including promotional usage, incremental revenue and ROI

 - Lead the ideation and cross-functional execution of optimisation plans across Analytics, CRM, creative, on-site experience and messaging, as well as brand new offers and rewards to be tested

title: Product Operations Manager
description:
ABOUT US

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

 - We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

 - We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

 - We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

About us
At Legora, we’re changing how lawyers work. Our AI-native platform helps legal teams research, review, draft, and collaborate. We build closely with our clients and ship quickly across a growing number of markets.

The role

We’re hiring a Product Operations Manager to join our team and be part of the machine that facilitates product release management for the whole company and our clients.

You’ll own the operating system around releases for a specific product area: what is shipping, when it is ready, who needs to act, and what happens after launch. You’ll also improve how customer feedback and product data reach Product teams, so decisions are based on useful evidence rather than scattered requests.

You’ll need to be exceptionally comfortable with ambiguity and bring a practical, problem-solving mindset. You’ll jump into unfamiliar challenges, learn fast, and turn unclear problems into concrete next steps without waiting for a perfect brief or a ready-made playbook.

This is a hands-on individual-contributor role reporting to the Head of Product Operations. You’ll work across Product, Engineering, Support, Product Marketing, Engagement, and customer-facing teams in the US and Europe.

What you’ll do

 - Run release planning and readiness for major launches. Keep scope, owners, dependencies, risks, documentation, communications, and rollout decisions clear.

 - Maintain the company-facing view of the product roadmap and releases, and make sure partner teams have accurate information as plans change.

 - Build and maintain a reliable product-feedback process. Turn requests, support issues, and customer observations into evidence Product teams can prioritise and act on.

 - Track product and release health after launch. Use adoption data, operational metrics, and qualitative feedback to flag problems and recommend next steps.

 - Maintain the product knowledge layer across Notion, documentation as code, and other internal sources of truth. Improve the workflows and automation that keep it current.

 - Use agentic tooling and lightweight code to remove operational friction. Build scripts, ship small fixes, and support analysis without waiting for a dedicated Engineering cycle.

Who you are

 - You have 4+ years of experience in product operations, program management, business operations, consulting, technical program management, or a related role.

 - You have run complex launches or programs across Product, Engineering, or go-to-market teams.

 - You bring structure to unclear problems, make ownership explicit, and keep work moving when priorities change.

 - You communicate clearly with technical and non-technical teams and can influence without formal authority.

 - You are conversant in how software ships: you can work in a codebase, understand pull requests, and use agents to ship small fixes or analysis. You do not need to be a software engineer, but you should be comfortable working in code either directly or via agents.

 - Experience with enterprise software, release management, support operations, or product analytics is helpful. Legal experience is not required.

What’s in it for you

 - Broad ownership of how Legora launches and operates its product.

 - Direct collaboration with Product, Engineering, and go-to-market leaders across regions.

 - The chance to build systems that will shape how the company works as it scales.

 - Competitive compensation, benefits, and participation in Legora’s option program.

Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer

At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Senior CRM Executive - Lifecycle
description:
Our Global Structure 
Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
 About the team 
 This position will be part of the central CRM & Ops team, composed of 18+ specialists, dedicated to driving and executing global strategic initiatives to grow and retain our New Customer base. Collectively, the team is targeted on growing orders, expanding our subscriber base, improving engagement metrics to retain Deliveroo customers. Serving as the voice of the customer, the CRM & Ops team does this by enhancing personalised user experiences, activating best-in-class campaigns, and putting relevancy at the heart of everything. 
 The Role 
 As a Marketing Manager within the Lifecycle CRM & Ops team you are the voice of Deliveroo when speaking with our customers across the globe. You'll operate under a hybrid work model, spending a minimum of three days a week at our London HQ.
 Reporting into the Senior Marketing Manager on the New Customer squad, and working closely with stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Global CRM, Marketing Promotions, and Data Science, You’ll be a technical, commercially minded CRM marketer who is hands-on in the tooling: building Lifecycle journeys, setting up experiments and audiences, and configuring promotions and in-app merchandising. You’ll have end-to-end ownership of the New Customer Lifecycle, from journey design and build through to measurement and ROI. You’ll also use personalisation and AI to make journeys more relevant. Your primary focus will be on creating customer-centric journeys that are highly relevant, using the right channels at the right time to deliver meaningful business impact, while working with local markets as you scale your initiatives internationally. 
 What you'll be doing 
• Collaborate with multiple stakeholders to support growing the new customer base by combining data-driven insights with CRM best practice to initiate and deliver programs internationally 
• Build and configure multi-channel journeys (email, push, in-app), including audience logic, triggers, testing and QA
• Design and build multi-variant Lifecycle experiments
• Create promotions for new customer acquisition and retention, ensuring accurate setup, targeting and tracking
• Manage in-app merchandising placements, working with Product and Marketing Promotions
• Deliver personalisation at scale, and test where AI can improve content and efficiency
• Own operational delivery, optimisation, reporting of campaigns and weekly trading
• Proactively monitor and report on campaigns to stakeholders & propose/manage changes and optimisations where necessary
• Collaborate with the New Customer Lifecycle Manager and Marketing Promotions teams to develop the global CRM new customers lifecycle strategy
• Collaborate with stakeholders on key projects to create and implement test strategies that optimises performance of new & existing campaigns
• Be comfortable with data targeting, segmentation & analysis - pulling it, manipulating it and interpreting it, whilst using marketing technology to help achieve customer touchpoints faster and more efficiently than ever before
• Drive innovative ideas and solutions in response to business and customer needs
• Provide regular communication with stakeholders, such as the central marketing team, product and engineering teams and local markets, to ensure workloads & deadlines are managed efficiently (we love Slack channels for everything)
• Conduct post campaign reporting, pulling out the most interesting lessons and using these to guide your future ideas
 Requirements 
• Bachelor's Degree (Marketing or Business preferred) or strong relevant experience
• A minimum of 3+ years CRM experience
• Can work in a fast-paced environment and prioritise workload
• Attention to detail and campaign deadlines are adhered to, maintaining high standards of accuracy
• Highly computer literate with:
• HTML familiarity (ability to understand where changes need to be made)
• Liquid logic 
• Technical knowledge in CRM automation development
• Good communication skills and ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders groups
• Data visualisation tools & reporting experience (Looker preferred)
• CRM deployment experience (Braze or similar is a plus!)
 Why Deliveroo 
 Our mission is to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. We are transforming the way the world eats and shops by making access to food and products more convenient and enjoyable. We give people the opportunity to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.
 We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of the most rapidly expanding industry in the world. We are still a small team, making a very large impact, looking to answer some of the most interesting questions out there. We move fast, value autonomy and ownership, and we are always looking for new ideas.
 Workplace & Benefits 
 At Deliveroo we know that people are the heart of the business and we prioritise their welfare. Benefits differ by country, but we offer many benefits in areas including healthcare, well-being, parental leave, pensions, and generous annual leave allowances, including time off to support a charitable cause of your choice. Benefits are country-specific, please ask your recruiter for more information..

title: Solution Manager, Customer Journey
description:
At Qualtrics, we create software the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high-performing teams, and design products people love. But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally. Building a category takes grit, determination, and a disdain for convention—but most of all it requires close-knit, high-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers. 
When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the microphone and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.
 Solution Manager, Customer Journey (Individual Contributor) 
 Why We Have This Role 
 At Qualtrics, our Customer Journey team ensures every client experiences a predictable, high-value path from their initial evaluation through adoption, renewal, and expansion. As Senior Solution Manager, you will serve as the operational architect bridging product innovation with field reality. You'll partner directly with Product Management, Sales, Professional Services, Customer Success, and Operations to design the end-to-end business workflows that make new offerings sellable, deliverable, and supportable at enterprise scale.
 How You’ll Find Success 
• Operate as an architect of clarity: Cut through ambiguity to turn complex go-to-market concepts into concrete, repeatable execution plans.
• Lead through influence: Align cross-functional leaders across GTM and Product without direct reporting authority, driving shared accountability.
• Think in systems and lifecycles: Map customer handoffs across quote-to-cash, delivery, and renewal to eliminate operational friction points before they occur.
• Synthesize signal from noise: Distill qualitative field feedback and customer experiences into structured, data-backed insights that shape product roadmaps.
• Deliver with enterprise rigor: Balance strategic program architecture with hands-on asset creation, from SOW frameworks to scoping methodologies.
 How You’ll Grow 
• Executive cross-functional mastery: Deepen your ability to drive strategic decision-making across Product, Engineering, Sales, and Post-Sales leadership.
• Category-defining operational design: Build and standardize GTM frameworks that scale an enterprise SaaS ecosystem operating at multi-billion-dollar scale.
• Product strategy leadership: Expand your direct influence on product vision and release strategy by grounding roadmaps in real-world delivery data.
 Things You’ll Do 
• Accelerate time-to-market for new offerings: Own end-to-end GTM readiness programs, establishing clear launch gates and operational milestones so regional teams can sell and deliver seamlessly on Day 1.
• Eliminate post-sale friction: Map and implement customer journey workflows across provisioning, implementation, and support to reduce handoff risks and improve onboarding velocity.
• Equip the field for repeatable execution: Build practical field assets, including scoping guides, statement of work (SOW) templates, packaging matrices, and delivery playbooks in partnership with Enablement and Product Marketing.
• Direct product evolution using field evidence: Establish systematic feedback loops between delivery teams and Product Managers to prioritize features that drive sustained customer adoption and expansion.
• Standardize scalable frameworks: Turn single-product launch successes into reusable playbooks, operational standards, and governance models adopted across global teams.
 What We’re Looking For On Your Resume 
• Demonstrated track record leading go-to-market readiness, business operations, services strategy, or product operations within a multi-product enterprise SaaS environment.
• At least 8 years of experience designing end-to-end business workflows across the customer lifecycle (sales quoting, delivery handoffs, provisioning, and renewals).
• Proven capability managing complex cross-functional programs across distributed teams with clear risk mitigation and executive milestone tracking.
• Hands-on portfolio of field-enablement deliverables, such as implementation methodologies, scoping calculators, SOW templates, or delivery playbooks.
• Familiarity with enterprise go-to-market platforms (e.g., Salesforce, Gainsight, Highspot) and partner/SI delivery models.

• We build the connective tissue: We sit at the intersection of business strategy and technical execution, making sure our company's biggest product bets succeed in the real world.
• Bias toward action over bureaucracy: We value lightweight, repeatable systems over red tape; our frameworks exist to empower client-facing teams to move faster.
• High autonomy with built-in trust: You own your programs end-to-end, with the freedom to design solutions and the direct support of a collaborative team of peers.
• Impact measured by customer outcomes: Our success is directly tied to how effortlessly our customers adopt and expand their use of Qualtrics software.

title: Senior Account Executive - Financial Crime Compliance
description:
LIFE AT UIPATH

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?




YOUR MISSION

We are seeking a highly accomplished Senior Account Executive to drive new business and expand existing relationships across our Financial Crime Compliance (FCC) solution suite — including AML, KYC, Customer Due Diligence (CDD), sanctions screening, and fraud prevention technology — within financial services enterprise accounts. This role is ideal for a seasoned sales professional who combines deep domain expertise in financial crime and regulatory compliance with a proven track record of closing complex, high-value enterprise deals.

The successful candidate will own the full sales cycle — from prospecting through close — engaging C-level and senior compliance, risk, and technology stakeholders at banks, fintechs, payment providers, and other regulated financial institutions across UK&I.

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO AT UIPATH

Enterprise Sales Execution

• Own and drive the full sales cycle for enterprise financial services accounts, from lead qualification to contract close.

• Build and manage a robust pipeline of net-new logos and expansion opportunities within existing accounts.

• Consistently meet or exceed quota and revenue targets for AML/FCC compliance solutions.

• Develop and execute account-based sales strategies for top-tier banks, fintechs, payment providers, and financial institutions.

Domain-Driven Selling

• Leverage deep knowledge of AML, KYC, CDD/EDD, transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, adverse media screening, entity resolution, case management, and regulatory reporting to credibly engage compliance and risk stakeholders.

• Translate complex regulatory requirements and financial crime trends (e.g., sanctions evasion, mule accounts, digital assets, AI-driven financial crime, beneficial ownership transparency) into clear business value propositions.

• Serve as a trusted advisor to prospects and customers, speaking fluently to regulatory pain points and compliance program needs.

• Understanding of positioning AI driven solutions across business, IT and transformation teams.

Executive & Stakeholder Engagement

• Build and maintain relationships with senior executives, Chief Compliance Officers, Heads of Financial Crime, risk leaders, and technology decision-makers.

• Lead executive briefings, discovery sessions, and strategic account reviews.

• Partner with customers throughout the buying journey to align solution capabilities to business and regulatory outcomes.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner closely with Sales Engineering, Product, Marketing, and Customer Success to deliver tailored solutions and ensure smooth handoffs post-sale.

• Provide market and customer feedback to Product teams to inform roadmap and competitive positioning.

• Contribute domain expertise to RFP responses, competitive evaluations, and proposal development.

Pipeline & Forecast Management

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date pipeline, forecast, and account data in CRM.

• Provide regular, reliable forecasting to sales leadership.

• Identify and mitigate deal risk through proactive account management.

 


WHAT YOU'LL BRING TO THE TEAM

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or related field (or equivalent experience).

• 10+ years of enterprise sales experience selling software/technology solutions into financial services (banks, fintechs, payment providers, insurers, or capital markets firms).

• Extreme depth of knowledge in Financial Crime Compliance — AML, KYC/CDD, sanctions screening, fraud detection, transaction monitoring, and regulatory risk.

• Demonstrated history of success consistently meeting or exceeding sales quotas in complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles.

• Proven ability to sell to and influence senior executives, compliance leaders, risk officers, and technology buyers.

title: New Business Enterprise Account Executive (Public Sector)
description:
SLSQ128R110
 Do you want to help solve the world’s toughest problems with Data and AI? That’s what we do every day at Databricks.
 Reporting to the Head of Public Sector - Growth, you’ll partner with a team of accomplished Data, AI and industry specialists. Your mission is to drive the adoption of Databricks across a select group of Public Sector organisations. We’re looking for a proven Enterprise Account Executive to deliver net-new strategic business, bringing an informed point of view on Data and Advanced Analytics. Your insight will shape winning strategies and together with our teams and partners enable you to deliver exceptional value to customers. 
 The impact you will have: 
• Assess your accounts and develop a strategy to engage all buying centres, driving deals forward and shortening decision cycles
• Use AI tools every day to speed up account research, prepare for meetings and plan deals. You'll build with the Databricks platform yourself, so you understand what customers experience.
• Use a solution-led approach to create meaningful value for new logo accounts
• Identify and close quick wins while managing longer, complex sales cycles
• Own a defined list of prospects in UKI and build strategies targeting all critical stakeholders. Build and self-source your own pipeline, and run the full sales cycle from first prospecting to close, keeping your pipeline clean and well maintained
• Support broader customer transformation goals through strategic partnerships, well-scoped services, training, and targeted Executive engagement
• Build strong value throughout the sales process to guide successful negotiation
• Orchestrate cross-functional teams to maximise impact across your ecosystem
• Own the consumption narrative, using demand plans to surface high-value use cases in each account
• Stay customer-centric by delivering both technical and business outcomes through the Databricks Intelligence Platform
• Comfortable joining technical conversations alongside Solutions Architects, and able to position Databricks clearly against competitors (technical knowledge can be developed)
 What we look for: 
• Strong new business development background with a track record of closing and exceeding quota in Public Sector accounts. including building territories and winning new logos, not just managing an inherited book. 
• Experience navigating Public Sector procurement frameworks and mechanisms
• A Builder + AI First mindset: you actively use AI tools to improve your productivity and the quality of your work, and you can show examples beyond simply knowing about them

• Eligibility for SC clearance (existing clearance is an advantage)

 Databricks is the Data and AI company.  Prior experience at an open-source or developer‐centric infrastructure company.
