title: Product Manager, Interactive Avatars (Staff/Principal-level - SDKs, APIs)
description:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US. 

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.




ABOUT THE ROLE

For years, avatars have been something you watch. You write a script, we render a video, someone presses play. That model has taken AI video a long way but it has a ceiling. A video can't answer a question. It can't read the room. It can't role-play a tough conversation and adapt when you push back.

We're changing that. Interactive Avatars listen, talk, and respond in real time; inside your product, your website, or your internal tools. You bring the logic and the language model; we power the avatar layer: the speech, the expression, the listening, the sense that there's someone actually there.

It's early. Interactive Avatars has just come out of closed beta, and the teams building on it are pushing it into places we didn't expect - AI sales reps, always-on support agents, interactive trainers, onboarding guides. We're hiring a Product Manager to own it and take it from beta to a platform that thousands of developers build on.

This is a role with real scope. You'll help define what a real-time avatar API should be, the surface developers integrate against, the experience end users feel, and the commercial model that makes it a business. You'll work directly with the engineering and research teams building the real-time avatar stack, and with the design partners already live in the beta.

 


THE PROBLEM YOU'RE SOLVING

Today, a developer who wants a lifelike, real-time avatar in their product has to stitch together a streaming pipeline, a rendering layer, an agent, and a set of hard real-time problems - latency, interruption handling, listening behavior, expressiveness, consistency across sessions, most of which have nothing to do with the product they're actually trying to build.

We have the avatar technology and a working early version. What we need is a PM who can turn that into an API a developer can integrate in an afternoon, trust in production, and build a real business on top of, all while holding a quality bar high enough that the experience feels human, not uncanny.

 


WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

 - Owning the end-to-end Interactive Avatar API. This is the developer-facing surface (SDK, integration patterns, docs), the real-time experience quality, and the path from closed beta to general availability, and defining what the roadmap looks like over the coming cycles

 - Getting close to the developers and teams building on the beta: understanding how they integrate, where the API fights them, which real-time behaviors make or break the experience, and what "production-ready" means to them

 - Translating that understanding into a clear product direction. What to build, in what order, and why, and keeping the team aligned as the strategy evolves

 - Working closely with the engineering and research teams building the real-time avatar stack; contributing clear specs, sound judgment on trade-offs (quality vs. latency vs. cost), and the context that helps them build the right thing the first time

 - Partnering with go-to-market and commercial teams to define how the API is packaged, priced, and sold - a real-time API has a fundamentally different business model from batch video, and shaping that is part of the job

 - Defining and tracking the metrics that tell us whether the product is working across adoption, integration success, real-time quality, reliability, and the commercial signals that prove it's a business


WHO YOU ARE

You've owned a developer-facing product before like an API, an SDK, or a platform and you know that the product is the developer experience. You understand that adoption is won or lost in the first hour of integration, and that trust is won or lost the first time something breaks in production. You build accordingly.

You're comfortable in a space where the roadmap isn't fully formed. You don't need a clean brief to get started. You can talk to developers, watch them integrate, synthesize what you see, and come back with a point of view. You're also honest about what you don't know and willing to update when the evidence changes.

You care about the detail, and you can hold a quality bar for something subjective and hard: a real-time avatar either feels present and responsive or it feels off, and the difference lives in latency, interruption handling, expressiveness, and consistency. You know how to make that bar concrete and defend it.

You think commercially. A new API isn't just a technical surface. It's a business, and you have instincts (or scar tissue) around how developer products get adopted, packaged, and monetized.




REQUIREMENTS:

 - 5+ years in product, with direct experience owning a developer-facing API, SDK, or platform product. The vertical doesn't matter, the platform depth does

 - Comfortable operating in an early-stage, 0→1 environment where discovery and delivery happen in parallel and the roadmap is still being shaped

 - Strong technical fluency: you can hold a credible conversation with engineers about real-time systems, latency, and integration trade-offs, and make good calls without needing every answer handed to you

 - Strong written communication: you can write a spec, a strategy doc, or an API design rationale that others can act on without a foll

We help energy companies overcome today's challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future. Leveraging Data, AI, and real-time decision-making we turn energy complexity into growth opportunities for our partners.

By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable and affordable.

With teams across Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

Where in the world of Kaluza will I be working

You will be specifically working with the team building out our contact centre solution and the Kaluza Agent Experience (KAE). Our Customer Care platform powers AI-driven, cost-efficient service operations for global energy retailers, enabling personalised customer experiences across contact centres, digital channels, and case management.

This role is mission-critical to Kaluza’s vision. You will lead the product strategy, delivery, and client outcomes for Kaluza’s Customer Care solutions for ENGIE France, while contributing to the evolution of our Global Core capabilities.

What will I be doing?

As the Customer Care Product Manager, you are accountable for the outcomes delivered by your product. You will ensure design and engineering teams have absolute clarity on priorities and scope to drive meaningful results for end users and commercial value.

You will:

 - Lead Product Strategy: Own the Customer Care product strategy and roadmap for Kaluza clients in France, balancing Global Core reuse with specific French localisation requirements.

 - Build High-Value Solutions: Develop our suite of tools for the Contact Centre Solution, including CCaaS (Contact Centre as a Service) and Case Management, to enable efficient, high-value conversations.

 - Drive AI Innovation: Utilise the latest AI technology to automate and personalise the customer experience and champion agent productivity tools.

 - Foster Client Partnerships: Act as the senior product counterpart to client stakeholders (such as ENGIE), leading workshops and translating their needs into scalable capabilities.

 - Execute & Optimise: Lead cross-functional teams (engineering, design, data, and commercial) to ensure efficient delivery, removing blockers and resolving cross-team dependencies.

 - Deliver Operational Excellence: Define and track key contact centre metrics such as AHT, FCR, CSAT, and NPS to ensure solutions deliver measurable cost-to-serve improvements.

Is this the job for me?

You are the right person for us if you:

 - Have significant product leadership experience in enterprise SaaS and have worked in agile product organisations.

 - Possess deep knowledge of contact centre operations and agent workflows.

 - Have experience working with French enterprise clients and a strong understanding of localisation requirements, including language and regulation.

 - Are skilled at stakeholder management at the executive level, with the ability to manage trade-offs between speed and long-term value.

 - Are data-oriented, with an adeptness for using operational metrics to assess product performance and drive continuous improvement.

 - Have a background in energy retail or utilities (this will set you apart!).

 - Are excited by AI-driven automation, including voice bots and agent assist technology.

Kaluza Values

Here at Kaluza we have five core values that guide us as a business:

Play to win, Solve the real problem, Build trust every day, Own the outcome, Go further together

 

We want the best people

We’re keen to meet people from all walks of life — our view is that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We want to build teams which represent a variety of experiences, perspectives and skills, and we recognise talent on the basis of merit and potential.

We understand some people may not apply for jobs unless they tick every box. But if you're excited about joining us and think you have some of what we're looking for, even if you're not 100% sure, we'd still love to hear from you.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

 

What you’ll do


As the QA Lead across Data you will  work closely with the Data Org, setting the testing approach and quality standards for its products and platforms.

You will be the quality partner for data delivery teams, advising on testing and quality assurance across the software delivery lifecycle. You will work with Data Engineering, Product teams, and clients to make sure changes meet the defined quality bar before they reach client environments.

This is an individual contributor role with no line management responsibilities. You will influence through expertise, relationships, and evidence.


 - Define and own the test strategy and test plans for the Data Org, deciding what is tested and how, based on risk, criticality, and impact to the business and clients.

 - Create and deliver test plans for complex data systems, covering functional, transformation, schema, and ETL/migration testing, plus end-to-end coverage across data and engineering teams.

 - Set the quality gates that determine whether a change is fit to be promoted to client environments, and assess release readiness against milestones.

 - Ensure defects are logged, triaged, prioritised, and tracked to resolution in accordance with Quality standards, and drive root-cause analysis on recurring or high-impact issues.

 - Select and maintain the tools and frameworks used for testing, with automated checks running in CI/CD.

 - Work with delivery teams, programme teams, and clients to support queries on test data and releases, and to maintain client confidence through clear, professional communication.

 - Influence engineers, data analysts, and leadership to adopt a test-first mindset and own the quality of their products, and hold a firm line on quality standards.

 - Report on test progress, quality trends, and risks to technical and non-technical stakeholders, and raise delivery risks and blockers early.

 - Maintain documentation of quality standards, test coverage, and decisions, with transparency on known issues and risks.

 - Act as the subject matter expert on data testing and data quality practices, including data quality checks (completeness, accuracy, consistency, uniqueness, validity, timeliness).



What you’ll bring

 - Proven QA and testing experience: Strong knowledge of QA strategies, processes and methodologies, including defining and executing test plans, test cases and test scripts for complex software applications.

 - Agile, test-first delivery: Experience in cross-functional Agile teams with a test-first mindset, managing priorities, scope and risk to maximise testing impact across distributed engineering organisations.

 - Data testing and SQL: Working knowledge of data testing methods (data quality checks, schema validation, transformation testing, ETL/migration testing), plus SQL proficiency for querying and profiling large datasets to diagnose quality issues.

 - Quality metrics and reporting: Experience building quality metrics, dashboards and reporting for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

 - Collaboration and communication: Strong stakeholder management and verbal and written communication skills, working with development, product and client teams at all levels of management, including client engagement.

 - Influence and coaching: Ability to influence and negotiate across engineering, product and leadership, hold a firm line on quality standards, and coach engineers and product managers to own the quality of their products.

 - Client Delivery: experience working directly with client teams to define and report quality metrics, and to introduce quality improvement plans.

 - Nice to have: Test automation framework experience; defining quality gates in CI/CD or release pipelines; AI tools for identifying and fixing data issues; data testing and observability tooling; familiarity with data governance, data contracts and GDPR; and Python and visualisation tools (e.g. Power BI, Looker).

 - Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

 - Growth and setup: Personal learning budget, home office budget

 - Climate: Furthr, our climate action app

description:
Product Manager - Agent Experience 

Location: Paris preferred, open to London  (hybrid, three days a week in the office)
Team: Customer care
Language: Fluency in French & English
Contract: Permanent 
Reporting To: Lead Product Manager



Please note: This role is open in Paris or London, and requires an existing right to work in the country where you’d be based (the EU for Paris, the UK for London). We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities..

Please submit your CV in English.


About Kaluza

Kaluza https://www.kaluza.com/ is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.


What you’ll do

 - Own the Roadmap: Lead the end-to-end strategy for Kaluza Agent Experience (KAE) within the European market—grounded in global product goals but sharpened by local client needs and agent behaviors. Driving core operational metrics (AHT, FCR, CSAT, AI adoption, onboarding)ensuring capabilities improve agent/customer outcomes.

 - Drive Journey Design & UX Consistency: Act as guardian of agent UX across KAE to ensure coherence across the experience. Partnering with UX and domain teams to apply shared patterns consistently, reduce agent cognitive load, and maintain alignment and compliance with the design system as new automation and assistive/AI capabilities are introduced.

 - Lead Integrations & Client Onboarding: Drive technical and product integrations with third-party platforms and oversee spinning up new KAE instances end-to-end for incoming clients from discovery through go-live.

 - Ensure Accessibility & Compliance: Champion EU accessibility regulations by design, translating regulatory and market-specific needs into actionable engineering requirements.

 - Engage Clients & Drive Value: Serve as the trusted expert for clients on agent experience, advocating for platform-first configuration over bespoke builds

 - Hands-on Delivery & Enablement: Maintain active involvement across the entire Product Development Life Cycle (PDLC)—from agent discovery sessions to feedback loops—and produce materials to support successful client adoption.
   
   (Note: Travel to client sites e.g., Brussels, is expected at roughly 1–3 trips a month initially, tapering to 1–2 times a quarter.)


What you’ll bring 
Ideally, you’ll have:

 - Contact Centre & UX Expertise: Deep experience owning end-to-end user journeys for high-frequency operational tools (e.g., agent desktops), with hands-on craft in user research, journey mapping, and usability testing with agents and supervisors.

 - EU Accessibility & Platform Integration: Strong working knowledge of EU accessibility standards alongside proven experience integrating products with complex third-party platforms and vendor ecosystems.

 - Client Delivery & Market Expansion: Successful track record implementing or localizing a product for external enterprise clients, taking solutions from zero to live through discovery, configuration, and change management.

 - Data-Informed Judgement & Influence: Demonstrated ability using operational metrics (AHT, FCR, CSAT, agent effort) to defend product decisions, coupled with a platform-first mindset that prioritizes existing capabilities over custom code.

 - Bilingual Capability: Full professional bilingual fluency (written and spoken) in both English and French.


What will set you apart 

 - Experience leveraging AI tools, machine learning capabilities, or LLM integrations within product workflows to enhance platform intelligence and automation directly into customer service desktop environments.

 - Prior experience within SaaS platforms, the energy sector, or large-scale utility migrations.

 - Hands-on experience to scale UI consistency across different product teams.


Where you'll work
We offer flexible working, with an expectation of 3 days a week in the office. This gives us the best of both: real time together to collaborate and build relationships, with the flexibility to work in the way that suits you best the rest of the week.


Our Values

 - Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

 - Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

 - Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

 - Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.
   Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.


Our Perks

 - Financial & Insurance: Discretionary bonus, Alan Mutuelle Health Insurance, x3 Life & Death insurance (Prévoyance) via Alan, and standard Sécurité Sociale contributions (pension, family allowance, unemployment insurance)

 - Allowances: 50% commuting expense reimbursement, €200 Home Working Allowance, and €150 Learning Fund

 - Time Off & Flexibility: 25 days holiday + bank holidays + RTT days, Moments That Matter Leave, Compassionate Leave, two paid Volunteering Days, Flexible Working, and Career Break eligibility


Come as you are

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
 What Is The Role 
 As a Hunter Inside Account Executive, you will be a pivotal part of Elastic’s growth focusing on selling, managing, and growing net-new accounts within our Commercial segment. Our Hunter Virtual Sales Reps are individual contributors, focused on building new business, within a set of net-new accounts. Within this role you will have the opportunity to engage and partner with large Commercial accounts solving critical business needs for those customers while positioning our suite of products across (Search, Observability, and Search). Are you someone who is a go-getter that has to drive to excel in a fast-growing segment of new accounts? If so, we’d love to hear from you!
 What You Will Be Doing 
• Develop and build a territory plan for ~500 accounts that you will actively own, call, and manage in a defined territory
• Focusing entirely on Whitespace Accounts 
• Create a strategic prospecting strategy that you will execute daily to gain introductions, solve business challenges, and effectively position our technology
• Identify and qualify new opportunities leveraging your own creativity, inbound lead flow, personal prospecting efforts, contacts, existing accounts and partners
• Work cross-functionally with our sales development, marketing, partner, product and customer service teams to deliver outstanding results
• Negotiate pricing and contractual terms as required to close the sale
• Accurately forecast profitable and predictable territory performance and required resources through adherence of our sales process
 What You Bring 
• 2+ years of full-cycle sales experience, with a focus on hunting or creating new accounts
• Strong ability to plan and execute strategies related to driving pipeline in whitespace accounts
• A collaborative and inventive approach to problem-solving
• The desire and ability to operate and thrive in an ambitious, self-starting environment
• Technologically adept and business acumen focused with outstanding communication both written and oral, negotiation and presentation skills
 Bonus Points

 If you’re driven to build your own pipeline, master complex deal cycles, and help customers unlock the power of Search AI, we’d love to talk. Apply today!

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. You will be the commercial lead for our major European partners and our UK Land programmes, and for new partner, prime and Land accounts across the UK and Europe. You will own these relationships, grow live pilots into multi-year programmes and partnerships, and coordinate our Growth, Solutions and Forward Deployed Engineering teams to deliver. You will be based in London and spend regular time with customers across the UK and with our partners in Europe.

 - Drive continuity through award and delivery, manage escalations, and find follow-ons, renewals and adjacent programmes

 - Open new partner, prime and Land accounts across the UK and Europe, finding new budget lines, programmes and contacts

 - Shape the scope of technical deals with our Solutions Engineers rather than selling off a price sheet

 - Work within export-control, classification and data-sovereignty constraints in every engagement

 - A consultative, solution-selling approach and enough technical literacy to be credible with engineers

 - A live network across UK Land and European defence primes and programmes

 - Strong organisational discipline: account plans, meeting notes, follow-up tracking and CRM (Salesforce) hygiene

 - High energy, a natural networking instinct, and comfort with ambiguity and rejection

 - Bachelor's degree or equivalent military experience


TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS

 - Regular travel to Europe and to customer sites across the UK.


SECURITY REQUIREMENTS

 - Must have the ability to obtain UK Security Clearance (SC)

title: Site Operations Associate (UAE National)
description:
Our Global Structure 
Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
 Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Site Operations team powers the physical side of our marketplace through HOP (our rapid grocery delivery service) and Editions (our network of delivery-only kitchens). From launching new sites to ensuring operational excellence across markets, we combine retail and hospitality expertise with operational rigour. If you thrive in hands-on environments and want to help redefine how food and groceries reach customers—come join us on the ground.
 We’re looking for an Emirati UAE Site Operations Associate to join our Deliveroo Dubai HQ team. In this role, you’ll help us: Support role for the 3P site operations team. You keep third-party sites in a healthy day-to-day state, and you keep the team’s weekly rhythm running behind that.
 What You’ll Be Doing 
 You’ll be joining the Supporting Non Picker 3P site operations - Retail & Grocery operations team. On a set cycle you work through partner menus and admin pages, spot opening-hours problems, item unavailability, and live-order issues, and troubleshoot or coordinate with the team to resolve them. Alongside that you look after routine admin: report pulling, live ops support, key event ops support
 Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:
 Site checks 
• Cycle through partner menus and admin pages on a set rota, covering the sites and brands the team is responsible for.
• Check opening hours against the agreed schedule. Flag sites that are closed when they should be open, or showing the wrong hours.
• Check item and menu availability. Flag items, categories, or whole menus that are unavailable without a known reason, and note how widespread the issue is.
• Watch live orders during key events. Flag orders that are stuck, late to be accepted, or piling up at a site.
• Log/flag technical issues and troubleshoot / work with the teams to resolve them
• Re-check after a fix is claimed, and close the item only when the menu, hours, or order state actually looks right.
• Escalate anything that is affecting live orders, or anything you cannot classify from the checklist, to the lead straight away.
 Weekly data and reporting 
• Pull the agreed Looker reports on a set schedule and drop them into the team’s working files.
• Update weekly trackers with the latest numbers, using the existing templates and checks.
• Flag missing data, broken filters, or numbers that do not match the usual pack, and raise them before the review.
• Keep a log of what was refreshed, when, and from which report.
 Decks and reviews 
• Build first drafts of weekly and monthly decks from the updated data and a standard outline.
• Drop in charts, tables, and commentary placeholders so the lead can add the narrative.
 Admin and coordination 
• Attend meets and align on priority partners and work for the week
• Keep shared drives, trackers, and inboxes tidy so anyone on the team can find the current file.
• Keep logs of resolved issues and pending ones
 Team support 
• Take well-defined tasks from the lead and site operations teammates and close them on time.
• Escalate anything unclear, live, or outside the usual process rather than deciding it yourself.
 What You’ll Need to Thrive 
 Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:
• Experience in F&B or Retail operations preferred
• Tech savvy and ability to use analytics software like Looker
• Positive learning attitude
• Solution based mindset
• Proactive communication and good interpersonal skills
 Why Join Us? 
 At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving. We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:
• 🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale 
 Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.
• 🌱 See your impact, fast 
 Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.
• 🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership 
 Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.
• 🌎 A culture built for builders 
 High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.
 We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.

description:

But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally. • Coordinate with systems integrators, channel partners, and federal contracting partners to accelerate growth across the defense ecosystem.
• Build compelling business cases and mission-focused value frameworks that align Qualtrics capabilities to strategic defense objectives.

• A validated top performer with a proven track record of breakthrough sales results.

description:
Who we are 
 Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. 
 Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. 
 About the role: 
 This is a dynamic, high energy role in which you will bring the Internet of Things to mid-sized customers, building Samsara's business and bringing the benefits of sensor data to customers. Typical sales will be $20k to $100k, and involve POCs, multiple stakeholders, managing trials, multi-faceted pricing negotiations, and selling to executives and CXOs.

• You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

• You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact. 
• You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work. 
• You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
• You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

• 2+ years experience in a full-cycle, closing sales role
• Experience independently closing new deals larger than $10,000 in annual revenue

title: FP&A Business Partner
description:
WHY FACULTY? 


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here https://faculty.ai/impact.



We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.



Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.



AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.


ABOUT THE ROLE



As a FP&A Business Partner at Faculty, you will play a key role in supporting the financial planning and strategic decision-making that underpins our continued growth.

Partnering closely with senior leaders and teams across the business, you will provide the financial insight, analysis, and modelling needed to support both UK and international growth. You will help shape our approach to planning and performance management, building robust financial models, evaluating opportunities and enabling informed decision-making across a wide range of future scenarios.

This is a highly commercial and collaborative role, with the opportunity to work across different areas of Faculty and help us understand the financial implications of the decisions we make as we scale.




WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING



 - Lead financial modelling, scenario planning, and strategic analysis to support business growth, identify risks, and evaluate UK and international opportunities.

 - Partner with senior stakeholders across commercial, delivery, operational, and other teams to provide financial insight and challenge that informs key business decisions.

 - Support business planning, budgeting, and forecasting, translating operational and commercial drivers into clear financial outcomes.

 - Analyse pricing, customer and project profitability, and commercial performance to identify opportunities for sustainable and profitable growth.

 - Monitor key business and financial metrics, identifying trends and delivering actionable recommendations to improve performance, efficiency, and profitability.

 - Support executive leadership with financial analysis, investment cases, and strategic decision-making across new and existing growth initiatives.

 - Develop financial models and business cases to assess new opportunities, investments, and different growth scenarios.

 - Drive continuous improvement in financial reporting, forecasting, and data analytics, using automation and technology to improve the quality, speed, and accessibility of financial insight.
   
   


WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



 - Highly analytical, with strong financial modelling and problem-solving skills.

 - Adept at tackling complex and ambiguous problems, turning data into clear, practical recommendations.

 - Strategic thinker who challenges assumptions and brings fresh ideas to the table.

 - Commercially minded, with a clear understanding of how financial and operational decisions drive business performance.

 - Strong business partner capable of building trusted relationships and communicating complex financial concepts clearly to stakeholders at all levels.

 - Comfortable working across different parts of a growing business while successfully balancing multiple priorities.

 - Proven ability to thrive in fast-paced environments and take ownership of delivering high-impact work.

 - Qualified or part-qualified (ACA, ACCA, CIMA), or possess equivalent experience in FP&A, commercial finance, or a related analytical role.






OUR INTERVIEW PROCESS

 1. Talent Team Screen (30 mins)

 2. Introduction Call with Hiring Manager (30 mins)

 3. Case Study Interview (45 mins)

 4. Meet with the Team (60 mins)
    
    




OUR RECRUITMENT ETHOS




We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.



If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours. 



A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

title: Product Manager - Products & Pricing
description:
Product Manager - Products and Pricing


Location: London, UK (hybrid, three days a week in the office)
Salary: £50,000 – £60,000
Team: Energy Commerce
Contract: Permanent 

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in the UK. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.

About Kaluza

Kaluza https://www.kaluza.com/ is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What you’ll do

 - Lead the localisation efforts for our products and pricing capabilities, ensuring they meet the specific commercial, regulatory, market, and cultural requirements of retailers in Europe.  This will include European localisations such as indexation and unbundled energy products as well as broader market promotions and discounts.

 - Deep dive into European energy market structures and regulations for designated countries, translating complex needs into detailed product specifications.  Understand the broader context of piercing and selling products in Europe and the required tooling, workflows and models to accelerate our retailers

 - Collaborate intensely with clients and in-country experts to understand their unique needs and requirements. You will be the first point of contact with the client for all domain specific needs.

 - Coordinate cross domain discovery and delivery for features that support key journeys, aligning requirements where needed (eg. billing, quoting and energy insights).

 - Define and manage detailed product requirements for features related to country-specific needs to support energy products and pricing.

 - Contribute to the Global Energy Commerce roadmap, when new acceleration opportunities are identified.

 - Work closely with engineering, UX, and QA teams to ensure the successful implementation and testing of localised billing functionalities.

 - Act as the go-to expert for global teams on specific European market nuances related to energy products and pricing and related customer journeys.
   
   (Note: Travel to client sites e.g., Brussels, is expected at roughly 1–3 trips a month initially, tapering to 1–2 times a quarter.)

What you’ll bring 

Ideally, you’ll have:

 - Proven experience as a Product Manager with a strong track record of successfully localising complex software products for international markets.

 - Able to establish and maintain great relationships with B2B clients, throughout the entire product lifecycle.

 - Solid understanding of the end-to-end energy lifecycle within a European context, with a particular focus on retailer commercial operations.

 - Direct experience with specific European energy markets, understanding their unique regulatory frameworks and requirements

 - Exceptional ability to translate abstract regulatory text or client requirements into clear, actionable requirements for development teams.

 - Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams (engineering, legal, operations, client success) to deliver localised solutions.

 - Experience working alongside multiple services/domains to deliver complex journeys.

 - Excellent communication skills, able to articulate technical and market complexities to various stakeholders, including clients.

What will set you apart 

 - Deep, hands-on experience with the French or Belgian energy retail markets, particularly concerning their energy products and pricing specificities.

 - Proficiency in a second European language relevant to key target markets (e.g., French).

 - Experience with large-scale data migration and integration projects involving legacy billing systems.

 - A background in energy commercial operations or regulatory affairs within a European energy retailer.

Where you'll work
We offer flexible working, with an expectation of 3 days a week in the office. This gives us the best of both: real time together to collaborate and build relationships, with the flexibility to work in the way that suits you best the rest of the week.

Our Values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

 - Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

 - Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

 - Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

 - Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.
   Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

Our Perks

 - Time off and family: 26 days’ holiday, plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period

 - Health and security: Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme, free mortgage advice and eye tests

 - Pay and flexibility: Discretionary bonus, a Flex Fund of 5% [of salary] to spend on the benefits you want most, retail discounts through Perks at Work

 - Growth and setup: Personal learning budget, home office budget

 - Climate: Furthr, our climate action app

We want the best people
We’re keen to meet people from all walks of life — our view is that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We want to build teams which represent a variety of experiences, perspectives and skills, and we recognise talent on the basis of merit and potential.

title: Revenue Operations
description:
ABOUT US:
AI NEEDS A NEW INFRASTRUCTURE LAYER. WE'RE BUILDING IT AT MODAL.

Every era of computing brought new workloads that previous infrastructure couldn't support: mainframes, databases, and the cloud. Each time, the company that rebuilt the layer underneath defined the decade. AI is no different, except it touches everything instead of one slice, and the window to build the layer underneath it is open right now.


Our customers include category-defining companies like Ramp https://modal.com/blog/how-ramp-built-a-full-context-background-coding-agent-on-modal, Cognition, DoorDash, and Suno. They rely on Modal for instant GPU access, sub-second container starts, and native storage, so it's simple to serve low-latency inference, fine-tune models, and access production-ready sandboxes at scale.


We've passed $1B in annualized run rate, up 15x from a year ago. In October 2026 we raised a $750M Series D led by Accel at a $15.75B valuation.


Our team includes creators of popular open-source projects (e.g.,Seaborn https://github.com/mwaskom/seaborn,Luigi https://github.com/spotify/luigi), academic researchers, international olympiad medalists, and experienced engineering and product leaders with decades of experience.




THE ROLE:

We’re seeking a Revenue Operations Manager with a strong track record, a builder’s mindset, and a bias for action to join our in-person team in London.

This is a high-impact, hands-on role. You’ll own the entire revenue operations function, from top-of-funnel lead routing through deal close and commission administration. You’ll work closely with our Head of Finance & People Ops and sales leadership to build the systems, dashboards, and processes that scale our go-to-market motion.




WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON:

 - Own the inbound lead routing process, partnering with Marketing to ensure proper attribution

 - Run territory management and strategy for geo-based decision-making

 - Support and strategize on every aspect of revenue operations in your territory

 - Own capacity forecasting strategy, including inputs, throughputs, and outputs, and serve as the conduit back to Finance in the US for effective capacity forecasting

 - Provide input and strategy on comp-based decisions and benchmarking

 - Support leadership on overall regional operations and finance strategy across all functions, including sales, presales, and ecosystem

 - Evaluate new tools on the market and be responsible for improving the efficiency and effectiveness of the sales team

 - Build and maintain dashboards, leaderboards, and pipeline reporting to give leadership real-time visibility

 - Monitor deal progression and hold reps accountable for CRM hygiene and accuracy

 - Support deal reviews at the pricing and negotiation stages, coordinating with outside counsel as needed

 - Own the closed-won process from signature through handoff to post-sale

 - Administer commission plans across the sales org, ensuring accurate and timely calculations and serving as the source of truth for comp-related questions




YOU MAY BE A FIT IF:

 - You have 3–7 years in Sales Operations or Revenue Operations at a high-growth, usage-based sales organization

 - You’ve built core GTM infrastructure before: lead routing, CRM architecture, pipeline reporting, commission administration, and deal desk

 - You have deep proficiency in CRM workflows, lifecycle stages, custom properties, and data hygiene

 - You’ve owned commissions end-to-end: building the model, calculating payouts, fielding rep disputes, and keeping it reconciled with Finance

 - You’ve run a deal desk, know what makes a contract clean, and catch errors before they become problems

 - You’re strong in Excel or Google Sheets: you can build a pipeline coverage model and know which metrics actually matter

 - You’ve earned trust with a sales team by making their lives easier while holding them accountable to process

 - You have a builder’s mentality: you identify gaps, propose solutions, and execute without being asked twice

 - You can zoom out and think strategically while staying close enough to the work to get your hands on the keyboard

 - You have an AI-forward mindset: you actively use AI in your work and are excited to pioneer its use in go-to-market operations

 - You have strong communication and collaboration skills and earn trust across Sales, Marketing, and Finance

 - You’re a player-coach: you’re not above the details, and you’re excited to own the work yourself

We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.



Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.



AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.




ABOUT THE ROLE



As a Lead Data Scientist at Faculty, you will drive the scientific direction and architectural rigour of upstream AI safety and evaluation standards. Partnering directly with Frontier Labs, you will lead the design of novel experiment frameworks, mentor technical teams, and ensure delivery excellence across high-stakes engagements.



Bridging deep scientific research with client strategy, you will champion robust methodologies, guide cross-functional teams, and advance Faculty’s thought leadership in practical AI safety.




WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:



 - Directing project teams to deliver cutting-edge upstream AI safety solutions and evaluation standards to Frontier Labs

 - Architecting core scientific experiment designs and robust software infrastructure for high-impact safety engagements

 - Guiding and mentoring data scientists, nurturing technical capabilities, and fostering an inclusive, high-performing team culture

 - Partnering with commercial leads and executive stakeholders to scope technical work, assess feasibility, and translate complex challenges into rigorous scientific frameworks

 - Advancing Faculty’s industry leadership by innovating novel evaluation methodologies, speaking at key forums, or publishing open-source research

 - Establishing and upholding scientific methodology, rigour, and engineering best practices across the full project lifecycle
   
   


WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR:



 - You bring extensive leadership experience in quantitative data science, upstream AI safety research, or academic research with exemplary experiment design methodology.

 - You possess advanced Python expertise alongside deep familiarity with scientific stacks (NumPy, Pandas), AI evaluation frameworks (e.g., Inspect AI), and agentic harnesses and sandboxing environments.

 - You demonstrate a passion for advancing evaluation standards across complex, specialised domains, including the application of novel research avenues, with exceptional technical rigour.

 - You excel at empowering others, sharing technical knowledge, and cultivating a collaborative environment where team members thrive.

 - You combine strong commercial acumen with the ability to articulate complex scientific strategies clearly to senior clients and external partners.

 - You drive strategic execution, scoping high-impact projects effectively to meet structured timelines without compromising quality.




THE INTERVIEW PROCESS



 1. Talent Team Screen (30 minutes)

 2. Introduction to the team (30 minutes)

 3. Take Home Technical Assessment

 4. Technical Interview (90 minutes)

 5. Commercial Interview (60 minutes)






OUR RECRUITMENT ETHOS




We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.



If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours. 



A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

title: QA Automation Lead
description:
Role: QA Automation Lead

Location:  London, Bristol

Level: C3

Team: Quality

Contract: Permanent 

Reporting To: Senior QA Manager

 

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in the UK. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.

 

About Kaluza

 

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

 

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

 

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

 

What you’ll do

The QA Automation Leads are part of a leadership team and they work closely with QA Leads and Staff Engineers to enable Development Engineers to test the code that they produce.

The QA Automation Leads will be an authority on test data creation, test tools, and test automation best practice. They will coach Engineers through test automation, provision tools, and automate controls to ensure the quality of code delivered to client-facing teams and clients.

They will work with the Quality Enablement Team to embed automation frameworks, as well as automation that will audit AI generated code and tests. They will be the conduit between Engineering teams using these tools and the Enablement Team.



The QA Automation Leads will support QA professionals in the Forward Deployed Engineering Teams in the creation and validation of End to End tests that involve their domains.

 

 - Coach and enable development engineers to write automated tests at service and domain level, and to test their own products and solutions.

 - Provide the tooling for creating test data, building test automation and reporting test results.

 - Partner with QA and development engineers in Forward Deployed Engineering teams to define and implement automated handovers between teams, and support their end-to-end testing.

 - Implement innovative automation of testing, defect management and release processes for Global Product Teams, using AI where it adds value.

 - Work with the Enablement Team to build intelligent automated testing solutions (such as testing the tests) and roll them out. 

 - Use AI tools and techniques to build, refine and scale internal testing tools and frameworks, and build AI-driven tools that remove bottlenecks in code and architecture and speed up test-and-deploy cycles.

 - Lead by example as a technical leader: champion best practice in test automation, AI code validation and agent tooling, write clean, testable code, perform code reviews and mentor mid-level and junior engineers.


What you’ll bring

 - Experience building, maintaining and enhancing test automation frameworks, using tools and languages such as Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Playwright or Cypress.

 - Strong software engineering fundamentals (design patterns, API design, data structures) in Python, TypeScript or similar, with experience automating tests using APIs.

 - Knowledge of improving test data management, users and scenarios for ease of testing, and of working with developers to review automated unit and integration tests.

 - Previous management experience, leading and coaching engineers across test cases

 - A solid understanding of the SDLC, Agile methology and QA process.

 - Experience using AI tools, such as LLM-based coding assistants and agent frameworks, as part of a pipeline, along with an understanding of prompt engineering and LLM evaluation techniques (faithfulness, relevance, LLM-as-a-judge), since traditional pass/fail assertions don’t translate well to AI agent testing.

 - Excellent communication and influencing skills, able to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences and to collaborate with multiple stakeholders towards a common goal.

 - Strong problem-solving skills and a solution-oriented mindset, with the willingness to speak up, highlight areas for improvement and suggest solutions.

Nice to have

 - Experience building or integrating AI agents, such as LangChain, AutoGen, custom agent frameworks or MCP-based tooling.

 - Experience working with or testing AI-generated code, models or agents, covering both deterministic validation (is the generated code correct?) and non-deterministic evaluation (is the AI’s behaviour acceptable?).

 - Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated testing into deployment workflows.

 - Knowledgade of Jira and test management tools such as XRay.




OUR VALUES

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

 - Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

 - Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

 - Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

 - Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

 - Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.



Our Perks

 - Time off and family: 26 days’ holiday, plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period

 - Health and security: Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme, free mortgage advice and eye tests

 - Pay and flexibility: Discretionary bonus, a Flex Fund of 5% [of salary] to spend on the benefits you want most, retail discounts through Perks at Work

 - Growth and setup: Personal learning budget, home office budget

 - Climate: Furthr, our climate action app

We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.
 The Team 
 The Product Incubation team is a highly specialized unit within Celonis Services that bridges the gap between Product & Engineering (P&E) and enterprise customer reality. Our mission is to guarantee the successful 0-to-1 deployment of Celonis's newest platform capabilities.
 We act as the forward scouts for the Celonis Customer organization (CCO). We collaborate closely with Product & Engineering during the alpha and private preview phases of new products, stress-test them in complex customer IT environments and build the foundational knowledge, reference architectures and playbooks that allow the rest of the Celonis Customer and Service organization to scale these innovations globally.

description:

Planhat OS is a model-agnostic AI operating system where people and agents work together across the entire customer lifecycle. At its heart is Pi, the world’s first multiplayer customer agent.  - High performance: you consistently exceed revenue targets. You're motivated by growth and impact, and you're always looking for a tougher challenge

Before joining Planhat our current Account Executives had experience such as:

 - Proven track records in selling powerful B2B SaaS products, usually at scrappy startups, often starting out as BDR/SDR and progressing quickly to AE

 - Running an effective sales cycle, defining and owning it, from prospecting to closing with VP and C-level executives

 - Revenue responsibility in sales or customer success, exceeding targets and overperforming at fast-growing software companies

 - A strong academic and/or competitive sports background, since this role takes a blend of grit, determination, and commercial acumen


TRAJECTORY

title: GTM Systems Lead
description:
ABOUT US

We're Team Granola 👋

Granola is an AI-powered notepad for people in back-to-back meetings. What started as a better way to take notes has become a shared workspace that helps teams capture, organize, and act on what matters.

We're building a product people genuinely love and are fortunate to work with many of the world's most ambitious companies. As we continue to grow, we're looking for a GTM Systems Lead to build the systems and data foundation that Sales, CS and leadership run on.



ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re hiring a GTM Systems Lead to own the technology behind Granola’s commercial team as we scale.

You’ll design, build and run the systems our Sales and CS teams rely on. Our current stack has served us well, but it needs to evolve as the team grows. You’ll take responsibility for how the tools fit together, what we build versus buy, and how information flows between them.

This is a hands-on role. You’ll set the direction of the stack and implement the technical changes that make it work. You’ll work closely with Sales, CS and Data, and report to the Head of RevOps. You won’t be limited to administering a CRM or building isolated automations: you’ll own how the whole system works.



WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Design and evolve the GTM stack. Decide how our Sales and CS systems should fit together, what to build versus buy, and what to prioritise as we grow.

 - Own the technical architecture of our CRM, Attio. Shape its data model, objects, workflows and integrations. You’ll be hands-on with configuration, particularly early on, but routine admin won’t be the sole focus of the role.

 - Build and maintain integrations. Make data flow reliably across Attio and our wider toolset, including Apollo, Cal.com http://Cal.com, Tally and Polytomic, and into the data systems used by the wider business.

 - Own the wider toolset. Assess new tools and vendors, improve or replace what isn’t working, and make sure the stack is useful, reliable and cost-conscious.

 - Find opportunities for automation and AI. Identify work that could be made easier for Sales and CS, and build or collaborate on solutions where they fit the priorities of the stack.

 - Keep systems dependable. Troubleshoot problems, establish sensible governance and documentation, and partner with IT on access and security.

 - Understand how teams work. Get close to Sales and CS workflows so the systems you build solve real problems, not just technical ones.


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - Experience designing, building and owning systems used by a growing commercial team. Relevant hands-on experience matters more to us than a particular number of years or experience with a specific CRM.

 - Sound judgement about system architecture, priorities and build-versus-buy decisions—and the ability to explain those decisions to non-technical colleagues.

 - Technical depth beyond administering tools: you’ve built integrations and are comfortable working with APIs, webhooks and code. Experience with SQL, Python or JavaScript would be useful.

 - An understanding of CRM data models, routing, enrichment and the operational work needed to keep data flowing reliably.

 - A willingness to get into the weeds. You’re comfortable doing the implementation yourself while also thinking about how the stack should develop over time.

 - Curiosity about AI-powered GTM workflows, with experience building them a plus rather than a prerequisite.

 - A collaborative, low-ego approach. You can work through messy requests with Sales, CS and Data, challenge assumptions constructively, and ship solutions people can use.

 - You don’t need to have used Attio or every tool in our stack. We’re more interested in what you’ve built, how you think about systems, and how you’d apply that experience here.


ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY

We are living in the most exciting time for tool builders since Engelbart's demo in 1968 and we want to assemble the best crew to build this future together. Our compensation philosophy is to hire the best people in the market and pay them accordingly with salary, variable, and equity.

Lastly, we think amazing talent comes from all kinds of life journeys and experiences. If what is written above speaks to you, whether you look like a fit on paper or not, please reach out.

We're heading in one direction, the future. We’d love you to join us.



The opportunity.

The Quantexa Academy is a key contributor to driving the self-sufficiency and enablement of Quantexa's customers and partners. We achieve this through online learning, instructor-led training and practical technical programmes that help Quantexa users configure, use and implement our award-winning Decision Intelligence Platform. We are looking for someone to join our Academy Team Lead team on a nine-month maternity cover, delivering high-quality technical learning experiences for our colleagues, customers and partners.

In this fixed-term maternity cover role, you will deliver engaging face-to-face and online training, support learners with technical and learning queries, assess learner work and contribute to the continued development of the Academy's technical curriculum. You will act as a key interface between the Academy, learners, clients and partners, working closely with colleagues across Education Services, Cloud, Delivery, Solution Engineering, Technology Account Partners and Alliances.


What You’ll Be Doing

 - Evaluate learner projects and assessments, applying fair and consistent marking criteria and providing timely, constructive feedback.

 - Act as a subject matter expert for the Design and Publish Pillar and contribute to projects and initiatives across Education Services.
   
   

What you’ll bring

Essential

 - Strong knowledge of data processing pipelines and big data technologies such as Spark, Hadoop and Elasticsearch, alongside proficiency in Scala, Java, Python or other object-oriented languages.

 - Experience delivering engaging technical training and live coding in both face-to-face and online environments, with the ability to explain complex concepts to learners of varying experience levels.

 - Quantexa Data Engineer Academy certified



Our perks and quirks.

What makes you Q will help you to realize your full potential, flourish and enjoy what you do, while being recognized and rewarded with our broad range of benefits.

We offer:

title: Technical SEO Specialist
description:
At Qualtrics, we create software the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high-performing teams, and design products people love. But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally. Building a category takes grit, determination, and a disdain for convention—but most of all it requires close-knit, high-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers. 
When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the mic and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.
 SEO Specialist 
 Why We Have This Role 
 People arrive at Qualtrics because they searched for an answer — how to understand what their customers actually want, why their best employees leave, whether a product will land before they build it. Whether they find us depends on whether our site can be crawled, indexed, understood, and cited. That is the work. We run a large site consisting of thousands of pages across multiple languages and regions. Search itself is changing rapidly. An answer surfaced inside an AI-generated response now matters as much as (if not more than) a blue link, and the signals that earn it are not all the same ones that mattered five years ago. This is a senior, individual-contributor role and the only one of its kind on the team. You will own technical search for Qualtrics including site health, structured data and entity signals, and the working relationship with web engineering. You will not be handed a playbook for the AI-search half of it. You will write it.
 How You’ll Find Success 
• You diagnose before you prescribe. You can read crawl data, log files, and Search Console together and tell a symptom from a cause.
• You get things shipped. A technical finding is worth nothing until it is in production. You write requirements engineers respect, you understand why their roadmap looks the way it does, and you argue priority on business impact.
• You quantify. You can put a number on what a fix is worth before you ask anyone to build it, and show what it returned afterward.
• You translate. You explain a problem to an engineer and its business consequence to a marketing leader in the same afternoon, and both leave clear.
• You work well without a playbook. The AI-visibility side of this role is genuinely still in motion. You are comfortable designing a measurement approach, being wrong about part of it, and revising.
 How You’ll Grow 
• You will own a function outright, which is the fastest way there is to build judgment about what actually matters.
• You will build our approach to visibility in AI-assisted search early enough that the work is formative rather than inherited.
• You will work across web engineering, web marketing and localization which is broad exposure for a specialist role.
• You will have the authority to set technical standards the wider marketing organization builds against, and a path toward broader search or web strategy leadership.
 Things You’ll Do 
 Site health and technical foundations 
• Own crawl and index health end to end including crawl budget, indexation directives, sitemaps, robots directives, orphaned pages, broken and redirecting internal links, and all error remediation.
• Own site architecture and internal linking as a system, how authority moves through the site, and whether the pages that matter are being prioritized.
• Run page performance as an ongoing program: monitor Core Web Vitals across page templates, diagnose LCP, INP, and CLS regressions, and drive prioritized actions with engineering.
• Lead technical SEO for migrations, rebrands, domain consolidations, and content deprecations including redirect mapping, pre-launch QA, and post-launch monitoring.
 Structured data and machine understanding 
• Own the structured data roadmap: audit coverage, prioritize by opportunity, and ship in phases.
• Build and maintain the entity model that connects our brand, products, people, and content into something a machine can resolve unambiguously.
• Make sure content hierarchy, markup, and metadata express what a page is actually about to both to search engines and to the retrieval layers behind AI-generated answers.
 International and multi-locale search 
• Own hreflang, canonical strategy, and localized site structure across languages and regions.
• Diagnose and resolve cross-locale cannibalization and duplication.
 AI and generative search visibility 
• Build our approach to visibility in AI-assisted search: how we are found, understood, cited, and represented in AI-generated answers.
• Set crawler policy for AI and LLM agents deliberately, balancing visibility against control.
• Track how retrieval and citation mechanics change, and adjust our technical approach before the impact shows up in traffic.
 Engineering and cross-functional partnership 
• Act as the technical SEO counterpart to web engineering: write specifications, size effort collaboratively, and shepherd work through the backlog to release.
• Embed SEO requirements into CMS templates, component libraries, and the standard pre-launch QA checklist so fixes become defaults.
• Review new page templates, JavaScript rendering behavior, and site releases before they ship.
• Set easy-to-follow, technical SEO standards for web marketing and web engineering partners.
 Measurement and reporting 
• Own technical SEO reporting including what changed, what it was worth and what is next.
• Build monitoring that catches regressions ear

Team: Engineering

Contract: Permanent



Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in the UK. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.



About Kaluza



Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.



Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.



With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.



The role

You’ll join the Kaluza Technology community: a large team of product-focused and data-led Product and Platform Engineers working at serious scale.



You can expect to work across many technologies, including AI, Claude Code, Typescript, AWS, Terraform, Kafka and Datadog. We believe our team members should have the possibility to be involved in all aspects of our delivery including development, design, support and testing to name a few. As a Tech Lead, you're one of the most experienced engineers in your team.



Engineers at Kaluza build with AI, and we mean that practically. From your first day you’ll have paid access to Claude Code, with a budget we don’t ration, and MCP access to the systems you need. Our tooling and conventions are evolving quickly, and you’ll have a heavy hand in defining how we build moving forward.



What you’ll do

 - Set the technical direction for your team: be accountable for the solution designs and architecture decisions, work with your team on technical strategy, and assist them through ambiguity over the longer term.

 - Work across the stack over time: depending on the team you’ll work across the interface people use, the services behind it, and the APIs between them, in whatever stack your team runs.

 - Build with AI coding agents as your default: break work down so agents can execute it, direct them, review what they produce as carefully as a colleague’s PR, and maintain the tests and guardrails that let agent-written code merge safely.

 - Own the health of your services: SLOs and SLAs, operational health reviews, post-mortems, and the in-hours support rota, with your turn on the on-call rota alongside the team.

 - Coach the engineers around you: technical guidance for a mix of junior and senior engineers, pairing, and code review that teaches as well as gates.

 - Connect your team to the rest of Kaluza: work with other Tech Leads and Principal Engineers on the wider architecture, and represent your team where platform decisions and engineering standards are made.



What you’ll bring

These are the practices and behaviours we see most in our best tech leads and value deeply, but we don’t expect everyone to tick every single box. If you’re excited by the role and can see yourself thriving here, we’d love to hear from you.



Ideally, you’ll have:

 - Experience leading technical change: you’ve taken a new service or a major architecture change from idea through to running in production, and you can say what you’d do differently.

 - A daily agentic development practice: you build with tools like Claude Code or Cursor, you can walk us through work you’ve shipped this way, and you have views on where agents help a team and where they get in the way.

 - Operational ownership: comfortable deploying with shared tooling, well-versed in SRE fundamentals like SLOs, disaster recovery and platform health monitoring, and used to owning your software in production, including out-of-hours on-call.

 - A coach’s instincts: you’ve mentored and grown engineers at different levels, and you make the people around you better.

 - Comfort with ambiguity and a bias to action: you can deliver against a technical strategy iteratively over months, and you’d rather ship a sound first step than wait for certainty.

 - Strong product sense: you ask why before building, and you can point to times when user feedback or metrics changed what you shipped.

 - Clear communication, especially in writing: designs, specs, PR descriptions and post-mortems that a teammate, a stakeholder or an agent can act on, and the stakeholder skills to work well with Product Managers, Principal Engineers and other Tech Leads.

 - Skills and hands-on experience: with many technologies, including AI, Typescript, AWS, Terraform, Kafka and Datadog.
   

Essential Criteria

 - Hands on experience with API development, Typescript back-end & AWS.

 - Strong application of system and architectural design across a range of deliveries.

 - Highly skilled in overseeing and delivering tangible end-to-end outcomes.



Our Values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

 - Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

 - Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

 - Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

 - Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

 - Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.



Our Perks

 - Time off and family: 26 days’ holiday, plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period

 - Health and security: Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme, free mortgage advice and eye tests

 - Pay and flexibility: Discretionary bonus, a Flex Fund of 5% [of salary] to spend on the benefits you want most, retail discounts through Perk
